sanskrit_iast: uktāni vaitānikāni gṛhyāni vakṣyāmaḥ |
meaning: उक्तानि वैतानिकानि गृह्यानि वक्ष्यामः ।
text: The (rites) based on the spreading (of the three sacred fires) have been declared; we shall declare the Grihya (rites).

sanskrit_iast: trayaḥ pāka yajñāḥ hutā agnau hūyamānā anagnau prahutā brāhmaṇa bhojane brahmaṇi hutāḥ |
meaning: त्रयः पाक यज्ञाः हुता अग्नौ हूयमाना अनग्नौ प्रहुता ब्राह्मण भोजने ब्रह्मणि हुताः ।
text: There are three (kinds of) Pakayagnas, the hutas, (i.e. the sacrifices) offered over the fire; over something that is not the fire, the prahutas; and at the feeding of Brahmanas, those offered in the Brahman.

sanskrit_iast: atha apy ṛca udāharanti | yaḥ samidha ya āhutī yo vedena iti |
meaning: अथ अप्य् ऋच उदाहरन्ति । यः समिध य आहुती यो वेदेन इति ।
text: And they quote also Rikas, 'He who with a piece of wood or with an oblation, or with knowledge ("veda").'

sanskrit_iast: samidham eva api śraddadhāna ādadhan manyeta yaja idam iti namas tasmai ya āhutyā yo vedena iti vidyayā eva apy asti prītis tad etat paśyann ṛṣir uvāca | ago rudhāya gaviṣe dyukṣāya dasmyam vacaḥ | ghṛtāt svādīyo madhunaś ca vocata iti | vaca eva ma idam ghṛtāc ca mahdunaś ca svādīyo asti prītiḥ svādīyo astv ity eva tad āha | ā te agna ṛcā havirhṛdā taṣṭam bharāmasi | te te bhavantu ukṣaṇa ṛṣabhāso vaśā uta iti | eta eva ma ukṣāṇaś ca ṛṣabhāś ca vaśāś ca bhavanti ya imam svādhyāyam adhīyata iti | yo namasā svadhvara iti namas kāreṇa vai khalv api na vai devā namas kāramati yajño vai nama iti hi brāhmaṇam bhavati |
meaning: समिधम् एव अपि श्रद्दधान आदधन् मन्येत यज इदम् इति नमस् तस्मै य आहुत्या यो वेदेन इति विद्यया एव अप्य् अस्ति प्रीतिस् तद् एतत् पश्यन्न् ऋषिर् उवाच । अगो रुधाय गविषे द्युक्षाय दस्म्यम् वचः । घृतात् स्वादीयो मधुनश् च वोचत इति । वच एव म इदम् घृताच् च मह्दुनश् च स्वादीयो अस्ति प्रीतिः स्वादीयो अस्त्व् इत्य् एव तद् आह । आ ते अग्न ऋचा हविर्हृदा तष्टम् भरामसि । ते ते भवन्तु उक्षण ऋषभासो वशा उत इति । एत एव म उक्षाणश् च ऋषभाश् च वशाश् च भवन्ति य इमम् स्वाध्यायम् अधीयत इति । यो नमसा स्वध्वर इति नमस् कारेण वै खल्व् अपि न वै देवा नमस् कारमति यज्ञो वै नम इति हि ब्राह्मणम् भवति ।
text: Even he who only puts a piece of wood (on the fire) full of belief, should think, 'Here I offer a sacrifice; adoration to that (deity)!' (The Rik quoted above then says), 'He who with an oblation'--and, 'He who with knowledge;' even by learning only satisfaction is produced (in the gods). Seeing this the Rishi has said, 'To him who does not keep away from himself the cows, to him who longs for cows, who dwells in the sky, speak a wonderful word, sweeter than ghee and honey.' Thereby he means, 'This my word, sweeter than ghee and honey, is satisfaction (to the god); may it be sweeter.' (And another Rishi says), 'To thee, O Agni, by this Rik we offer an oblation prepared by our heart; may these be oxen, bulls, and cows.' (Thereby he means), 'They are my oxen, bulls, and cows (which I offer to the god), they who study this text, reciting it for themselves (as their Svadhyaya).' (And further on the Rik quoted above says), 'He who (worships Agni) with adoration, offering rich sacrifices.' 'Verily also by the performing of adoration (the gods may be worshipped); for the gods are not beyond the performing of adoration; adoration verily is sacrifice'--thus runs a Brahmana.

sanskrit_iast: atha sāyam prātaḥ siddhasya haviṣyasya juhuyāt |
meaning: अथ सायम् प्रातः सिद्धस्य हविष्यस्य जुहुयात् ।
text: Now he should make oblations in the evening and in the morning of prepared sacrificial food,

sanskrit_iast: agnihotra devatebhyaḥ somāya vanaspataye agnīṣomābhyām inra agnibhyām dyāvā pṛthivībhyām dhanvantaraya indrāya viśvebhyo devebhyo brahmaṇe |
meaning: अग्निहोत्र देवतेभ्यः सोमाय वनस्पतये अग्नीषोमाभ्याम् इन्र अग्निभ्याम् द्यावा पृथिवीभ्याम् धन्वन्तरय इन्द्राय विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यो ब्रह्मणे ।
text: To the deities of the Agnihotra, to Soma Vanaspati, to Agni and Soma, to Indra and Agni, to Heaven and Earth, to Dhanvantari, to Indra, to the Visve devas, to Brahman.

sanskrit_iast: svāhā ity atha bali haraṇam |
meaning: स्वाहा इत्य् अथ बलि हरणम् ।
text: He says Svaha, and then he offers the Balis--

sanskrit_iast: etābhyaś ca eva devatābhyo adbhya oṣadhi vanaspatibhyo gṛhāya gṛha devatābhyo vāstu devatābhyaḥ |
meaning: एताभ्यश् च एव देवताभ्यो अद्भ्य ओषधि वनस्पतिभ्यो गृहाय गृह देवताभ्यो वास्तु देवताभ्यः ।
text: To those same deities, to the waters, to the herbs and trees, to the house, to the domestic deities, to the deities of the ground (on which the house stands),

sanskrit_iast: indrāya indra puruṣebhyo yamāya yama puruṣebhyo varuṇāya varuṇa puruṣebhyaḥ somāya soma puruṣebhya iti praditiśam |
meaning: इन्द्राय इन्द्र पुरुषेभ्यो यमाय यम पुरुषेभ्यो वरुणाय वरुण पुरुषेभ्यः सोमाय सोम पुरुषेभ्य इति प्रदितिशम् ।
text: To Indra and Indra's men, to Yama and Yama's men, to Varuna and Varuna's men, to Soma and Soma's men--these (oblations he makes) to the different quarters (of the horizon, of which those are the presiding deities).

sanskrit_iast: brahmaṇe brahma puruṣebhya iti madhye |
meaning: ब्रह्मणे ब्रह्म पुरुषेभ्य इति मध्ये ।
text: To Brahman and Brahman's men in the middle,

sanskrit_iast: viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ sarvebhyo bhūtebhyo divā cāribhya iti divā |
meaning: विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यो भूतेभ्यो दिवा चारिभ्य इति दिवा ।
text: To the Visve devas, to all day-walking beings--thus by day;

sanskrit_iast: naktam cāribhya iti naktam |
meaning: नक्तम् चारिभ्य इति नक्तम् ।
text: To the night-walking (beings)--thus at night.

sanskrit_iast: rakṣobhya ity uttarataḥ |
meaning: रक्षोभ्य इत्य् उत्तरतः ।
text: To the Rakshas--thus to the north.

sanskrit_iast: svadhā pitṛbhya iti prācīna āvītī śeṣam dakṣiṇā ninayet |
meaning: स्वधा पितृभ्य इति प्राचीन आवीती शेषम् दक्षिणा निनयेत् ।
text: Svadha to the fathers (i.e. Manes)'--with these words he should pour out the remnants to the south, with the sacrificial cord suspended over the right shoulder.

sanskrit_iast: atha khalu yatra kva ca hoṣyant syād iṣu mātra avaram sarvataḥ sthaṇḍilam upalipya ullikhya ṣaṭ lekhā udagāyatām paścāt prāg āyate nānā antayos tisro madhye tad abhyukṣya agnim pratiṣṭhāpya anvādhāya parisamuhya paristīrya purastād dakṣiṇataḥ paścād uttarata ity udak saṃstham tūṣṇīm paryukṣaṇam |
meaning: अथ खलु यत्र क्व च होष्यन्त् स्याद् इषु मात्र अवरम् सर्वतः स्थण्डिलम् उपलिप्य उल्लिख्य षट् लेखा उदगायताम् पश्चात् प्राग् आयते नाना अन्तयोस् तिस्रो मध्ये तद् अभ्युक्ष्य अग्निम् प्रतिष्ठाप्य अन्वाधाय परिसमुह्य परिस्तीर्य पुरस्ताद् दक्षिणतः पश्चाद् उत्तरत इत्य् उदक् संस्थम् तूष्णीम् पर्युक्षणम् ।
text: Now wherever he intends to perform a sacrifice, let him besmear (with cowdung) a surface of the dimension at least of an arrow on each side; let him draw six lines thereon, one turned to the north, to the west (of the spot on which the fire is to be placed); two (lines) turned to the east, at the two different ends (of the line mentioned first); three (lines) in the middle (of those two); let him sprinkle that (place with water), establish the (sacred) fire (thereon), put (two or three pieces of fuel) on it, wipe (the ground) round (the fire), strew (grass) round (it), to the east, to the south, to the west, to the north, ending (each time) in the north. Then (follows) silently the sprinkling (of water) round (the fire).

sanskrit_iast: pavitrābhyām ājyasya utpavanam |
meaning: पवित्राभ्याम् आज्यस्य उत्पवनम् ।
text: With two (Kusa blades used as) strainers the purifying of the Agya (is done).

sanskrit_iast: apracchinna agrāv anantar garbhau prādeśa mātrau kuśau nānā antayor gṛhītvā aṅguṣṭha upakaniṣṭhikābhyām uttānābhyām pāṇibhyām savituṣṭvā prasava utpunāmy achidreṇa pavitreṇa vasoḥ sūryasya raśmibhir iti prāg utpunāti sakṛn mantreṇa dvis tūṣṇīm |
meaning: अप्रच्छिन्न अग्राव् अनन्तर् गर्भौ प्रादेश मात्रौ कुशौ नाना अन्तयोर् गृहीत्वा अङ्गुष्ठ उपकनिष्ठिकाभ्याम् उत्तानाभ्याम् पाणिभ्याम् सवितुष्ट्वा प्रसव उत्पुनाम्य् अछिद्रेण पवित्रेण वसोः सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिर् इति प्राग् उत्पुनाति सकृन् मन्त्रेण द्विस् तूष्णीम् ।
text: Having taken two Kusa blades with unbroken tops, which do not bear a young shoot in them, of the measure of a span, at their two ends with his thumbs and fourth fingers, with his hands turned with the inside upwards, he purifies (the Agya, from the west) to the east, with (the words), 'By the impulse of Savitri I purify thee with this uninjured purifier, with the rays of the good sun'--once with this formula, twice silently.

sanskrit_iast: kṛta akṛtam ājya homeṣu paristaraṇam |
meaning: कृत अकृतम् आज्य होमेषु परिस्तरणम् ।
text: The strewing (of grass) round (the fire) may be done or not done in the Agya offerings.

sanskrit_iast: tathā ājya bhāgau pāka yajñeṣu |
meaning: तथा आज्य भागौ पाक यज्ञेषु ।
text: So also the two Agya portions (may optionally be sacrificed) in the Pakayagnas.

sanskrit_iast: brahmā ca dhanvantari yajña śūlagava varjam |
meaning: ब्रह्मा च धन्वन्तरि यज्ञ शूलगव वर्जम् ।
text: And the (assistance of a) Brahman (is optional), except at the sacrifice to Dhanvantari and at the sacrifice of the spit-ox (offered to Rudra).

sanskrit_iast: amuṣmai svāhā iti juhuyāt |
meaning: अमुष्मै स्वाहा इति जुहुयात् ।
text: Let him sacrifice with (the words), 'To such and such a deity svaha!'

sanskrit_iast: agnir indraḥ prajāpatir viśve devā brahmā ity anādeśe |
meaning: अग्निर् इन्द्रः प्रजापतिर् विश्वे देवा ब्रह्मा इत्य् अनादेशे ।
text: If there is no rule (as to the deities to whom the sacrifice belongs, they are) Agni, Indra, Pragapati, the Visve devas, Brahman.

sanskrit_iast: eka barhir idhma ājya sviṣṭakṛtaḥ syus tulya kālāḥ |
meaning: एक बर्हिर् इध्म आज्य स्विष्टकृतः स्युस् तुल्य कालाः ।
text: (Different Pakayagnas, when) offered at the same time, should have the same Barhis (sacrificial grass), the same fuel, the same Agya, and the same (oblation to Agni) Svishtakrit.

sanskrit_iast: tad eṣā abhiyajña gāthā gīyate | pāka yajñānt samāsādya eka ājyān eka barhiṣaḥ | eka sviṣṭakṛtaḥ kuryān nānā api sati daivata iti |
meaning: तद् एषा अभियज्ञ गाथा गीयते । पाक यज्ञान्त् समासाद्य एक आज्यान् एक बर्हिषः । एक स्विष्टकृतः कुर्यान् नाना अपि सति दैवत इति ।
text: With reference thereto the following sacrificial stanza is sung: 'He who has to perform (different) Pakayagnas, should offer them with the same Agya, the same [paragraph continues] Barhis, and the same Svishtakrit, even if the deity (of those sacrifices) is not the same.'

sanskrit_iast: udag ayana āpūryamāṇa pakṣe kalyāṇe nakṣatre caula karma upanayana godāna vivāhāḥ |
meaning: उदग् अयन आपूर्यमाण पक्षे कल्याणे नक्षत्रे चौल कर्म उपनयन गोदान विवाहाः ।
text: During the northern course of the sun, in the time of the increasing moon, under an auspicious Nakshatra the tonsure (of the child's head), the initiation (of a Brahmakarin), the cutting of the beard, and marriage (should be celebrated).

sanskrit_iast: sārvakālam eke vivāham |
meaning: सार्वकालम् एके विवाहम् ।
text: According to some (teachers), marriage (may be celebrated) at any time.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām purastāc catasra ājya āhutīr juhuyāt |
meaning: तेषाम् पुरस्ताच् चतस्र आज्य आहुतीर् जुहुयात् ।
text: Before those (ceremonies) let him sacrifice four Agya oblations--

sanskrit_iast: agna āyūṃsi pavasa iti tisṛbhiḥ prajāpate na tvad etāny anya iti ca |
meaning: अग्न आयूंसि पवस इति तिसृभिः प्रजापते न त्वद् एतान्य् अन्य इति च ।
text: With the three (verses), 'Agni, thou purifiest life' (Rig-veda I X, 66, 10 seq.), and with (the one verse), 'Pragapati, no other one than thou' (Rig-Veda X, 121, 10).

sanskrit_iast: vyāhṛtibhir vā |
meaning: व्याहृतिभिर् वा ।
text: Or with the Vyahritis.

sanskrit_iast: samuccayam eke |
meaning: समुच्चयम् एके ।
text: According to some (teachers), the one and the other.

sanskrit_iast: na eke kāṃcana |
meaning: न एके कांचन ।
text: No such(oblations), according to some (teachers).

sanskrit_iast: tvam aryamā bhavasi yat kanīnām iti vivāhe caturthīm |
meaning: त्वम् अर्यमा भवसि यत् कनीनाम् इति विवाहे चतुर्थीम् ।
text: At the marriage the fourth oblation with the verse, 'Thou (O Agni) art Aryaman towards the girls' (Rig-veda V, 3, 2).

sanskrit_iast: kulam agre parīkṣeta ye mātṛtaḥ pitṛtaś ca iti yathā uktam purastāt |
meaning: कुलम् अग्रे परीक्षेत ये मातृतः पितृतश् च इति यथा उक्तम् पुरस्तात् ।
text: Let him first examine the family (of the intended bride or bridegroom), as it has been said above, [paragraph continues] 'Those who on the mother's and on the father's side.'

sanskrit_iast: buddhimate kanyām prayaccet |
meaning: बुद्धिमते कन्याम् प्रयच्चेत् ।
text: Let him give the girl to a (young man) endowed with intelligence.

sanskrit_iast: buddhi rūpa śīla lakṣaṇa sampannām arogām upayacchet |
meaning: बुद्धि रूप शील लक्षण सम्पन्नाम् अरोगाम् उपयच्छेत् ।
text: Let him marry a girl that shows the characteristics of intelligence, beauty, and moral conduct, and who is free from disease.

sanskrit_iast: durvijñeyāni lakṣaṇāny aṣṭau piṇḍān kṛtva ṛtam agre prathamam jajña ṛte satyam pratiṣṭhitam | yad iyam kumāry abhijātā tad iyam iha pratipadyatām | yat satyam tad dṛśyatām iti piṇḍān abhimantrya kumārīm brūyād eṣām ekam gṛhāṇa iti |
meaning: दुर्विज्ञेयानि लक्षणान्य् अष्टौ पिण्डान् कृत्व ऋतम् अग्रे प्रथमम् जज्ञ ऋते सत्यम् प्रतिष्ठितम् । यद् इयम् कुमार्य् अभिजाता तद् इयम् इह प्रतिपद्यताम् । यत् सत्यम् तद् दृश्यताम् इति पिण्डान् अभिमन्त्र्य कुमारीम् ब्रूयाद् एषाम् एकम् गृहाण इति ।
text: As the characteristics (mentioned in the preceding Sutra) are difficult to discern, let him make eight lumps (of earth), recite over the lumps the following formula, 'Right has been born first, in the beginning; on the right truth is founded. For what (destiny) this girl is born, that may she attain here. What is true may that be seen,' and let him say to the girl, 'Take one of these.'

sanskrit_iast: kṣetrāc ced ubhayataḥ sasyād gṛhṇīyād annavaty asyāḥ prajā bhaviṣyati iti vidyād goṣṭhāt paśumatī vedi purīṣād brahma varcasviny avidāsino hradāt sarva sampannā devanāt kitavī catuṣpathād dvipravrājinī iriṇād adhanyā śmaśānāt patighnī |
meaning: क्षेत्राच् चेद् उभयतः सस्याद् गृह्णीयाद् अन्नवत्य् अस्याः प्रजा भविष्यति इति विद्याद् गोष्ठात् पशुमती वेदि पुरीषाद् ब्रह्म वर्चस्विन्य् अविदासिनो ह्रदात् सर्व सम्पन्ना देवनात् कितवी चतुष्पथाद् द्विप्रव्राजिनी इरिणाद् अधन्या श्मशानात् पतिघ्नी ।
text: If she chooses the (lump of earth taken) from a field that yields two crops (in one year), he may know, 'Her offspring will be rich in food.' If from a cow-stable, rich in cattle. If from the earth of a Vedi (altar), rich in holy lustre. If from a pool which does not dry up, rich in everything. If from a gambling-place, addicted to gambling. If from a place where four roads meet, wandering to different directions. If from a barren spot, poor. If from a burial-ground, (she will) bring death to her husband.

sanskrit_iast: alam kṛtya kanyām udaka pūrvām dadyād eṣa brāhmo vivāhas tasyām jāto dvādaśa avarān dvādaśa parān punāty ubhayataḥ |
meaning: अलम् कृत्य कन्याम् उदक पूर्वाम् दद्याद् एष ब्राह्मो विवाहस् तस्याम् जातो द्वादश अवरान् द्वादश परान् पुनात्य् उभयतः ।
text: (The father) may give away the girl, having decked her with ornaments, pouring out a libation of water: this is the wedding (called) Brahma. A son born by her (after a wedding of this kind) brings purification to twelve descendants and to twelve ancestors on both (the husband's and the wife's) sides.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtjije vitate karmaṇi dadyād alam kṛtya sa daivo daśa avarān daśa parān punāty ubhayataḥ |
meaning: ऋत्जिजे वितते कर्मणि दद्याद् अलम् कृत्य स दैवो दश अवरान् दश परान् पुनात्य् उभयतः ।
text: He may give her, having decked her with ornaments, to an officiating priest, whilst a sacrifice with the three (Srauta) fires is going on: this (is the wedding called) Daiva. (A son) brings purification to ten descendants and to ten ancestors on both sides.

sanskrit_iast: saha dharmam carata iti prājāpatyo aṣṭa avarān aṣṭa parān punāty ubhayataḥ |
meaning: सह धर्मम् चरत इति प्राजापत्यो अष्ट अवरान् अष्ट परान् पुनात्य् उभयतः ।
text: They fulfil the law together: this (is the wedding called) Pragapatya. (A son) brings purification to eight descendants and to eight ancestors on both sides.

sanskrit_iast: go mithunam dattvā upayaccheta sa ārṣaḥ sapta avarānt sapta parān punāty ubhayataḥ |
meaning: गो मिथुनम् दत्त्वा उपयच्छेत स आर्षः सप्त अवरान्त् सप्त परान् पुनात्य् उभयतः ।
text: He may marry her after having given a bull and a cow (to the girl's father): this (is the wedding called) Arsha. (A son) brings purification to seven descendants and to seven ancestors on both sides.

sanskrit_iast: mithaḥ samayam kṛtvā upayaccheta sa gāndharvaḥ |
meaning: मिथः समयम् कृत्वा उपयच्छेत स गान्धर्वः ।
text: He may marry her, after a mutual agreement has been made (between the lover and the damsel): this (is the wedding called) Gandharva.

sanskrit_iast: dhanena upatoṣya upayaccheta sa āsuraḥ |
meaning: धनेन उपतोष्य उपयच्छेत स आसुरः ।
text: He may marry her after gladdening (her father) by money: this (is the wedding called) Asura.

sanskrit_iast: suptānām pramattānām vā apaharet sa paiśācaḥ |
meaning: सुप्तानाम् प्रमत्तानाम् वा अपहरेत् स पैशाचः ।
text: He may carry her off while (her relatives) sleep or pay no attention: this (is the wedding called) Paisaka.

sanskrit_iast: hatvā bhittvā ca śīrṣāṇi rudatīm rudadbhyo haret sa rākṣasaḥ |
meaning: हत्वा भित्त्वा च शीर्षाणि रुदतीम् रुदद्भ्यो हरेत् स राक्षसः ।
text: He may carry her off, killing (her relatives) and cleaving (their) heads, while she weeps and they weep: this (is the wedding called) Rakshasa.

sanskrit_iast: atha khalu ucca avacā jana pada dharmā grāma dharmāś ca tān vivāhe pratīyāt |
meaning: अथ खलु उच्च अवचा जन पद धर्मा ग्राम धर्माश् च तान् विवाहे प्रतीयात् ।
text: Now various indeed are the customs of the (different) countries and the customs of the (different) villages: those one should observe at the wedding.

sanskrit_iast: yat tu samānam tad vakṣyāmaḥ |
meaning: यत् तु समानम् तद् वक्ष्यामः ।
text: What, however, is commonly accepted, that we shall state.

sanskrit_iast: paścād agner dṛṣadam aśmānam pratiṣṭhāpya uttara purastād uda kumbham samanvārabdhāyām hutvā tiṣṭhan pratyan mukhaḥ prān mukhyā āsīnāya gṛbhṇāmi te saubhagatvāya hastam ity aṅguṣṭham eva gṛhṇīyād yadi kāmayīta pumāṃsa eva me putrā jāyerann iti |
meaning: पश्चाद् अग्नेर् दृषदम् अश्मानम् प्रतिष्ठाप्य उत्तर पुरस्ताद् उद कुम्भम् समन्वारब्धायाम् हुत्वा तिष्ठन् प्रत्यन् मुखः प्रान् मुख्या आसीनाय गृभ्णामि ते सौभगत्वाय हस्तम् इत्य् अङ्गुष्ठम् एव गृह्णीयाद् यदि कामयीत पुमांस एव मे पुत्रा जायेरन्न् इति ।
text: Having placed to the west of the fire a mill-stone, to the north-east (of the fire) a water-pot, he should sacrifice, while she takes hold of him. Standing, with his face turned to the west, while she is sitting and turns her face to the east, he should with (the formula), 'I seize thy hand for the sake of happiness seize her thumb if he desires that only male children may be born to him;

sanskrit_iast: aṅgulīr eva strī kāmaḥ |
meaning: अङ्गुलीर् एव स्त्री कामः ।
text: Her other fingers, (if he is) desirous of female (children);

sanskrit_iast: roma ante hastam sāṅguṣṭham ubhaya kāmaḥ |
meaning: रोम अन्ते हस्तम् साङ्गुष्ठम् उभय कामः ।
text: The hand on the hair-side together with the thumb, (if) desirous of both (male and female children).

sanskrit_iast: pradakṣiṇam agnim uda kumbham ca triḥ pariṇayam japaty amo aham asmi sā tvam sā tvam asy amo aham | dyaur aham pṛthivī tvam sāma aham ṛk tvam | tāv ehi vivahāvahai prajām prajanayāvahai | sampriyau rociṣṇū sumanasyamānau jīveva śaradaḥ śatam iti |
meaning: प्रदक्षिणम् अग्निम् उद कुम्भम् च त्रिः परिणयम् जपत्य् अमो अहम् अस्मि सा त्वम् सा त्वम् अस्य् अमो अहम् । द्यौर् अहम् पृथिवी त्वम् साम अहम् ऋक् त्वम् । ताव् एहि विवहावहै प्रजाम् प्रजनयावहै । सम्प्रियौ रोचिष्णू सुमनस्यमानौ जीवेव शरदः शतम् इति ।
text: Leading her three times round the fire and the water-pot, so that their right sides are turned towards (the fire, &c.), he murmurs, 'This am I, that art thou; that art thou, this am I; the heaven I, the earth thou; the Saman I, the Rik thou. Come! Let us here marry. Let us beget offspring. Loving, bright, with genial mind may we live a hundred autumns.'

sanskrit_iast: pariṇīya pariṇīya aśmānam ārohayanti imam aśmānam āroha aśmā iva tvam sthirā bhava | sahasva pṛtanāyato abhitiṣṭha pṛtanyata iti |
meaning: परिणीय परिणीय अश्मानम् आरोहयन्ति इमम् अश्मानम् आरोह अश्मा इव त्वम् स्थिरा भव । सहस्व पृतनायतो अभितिष्ठ पृतन्यत इति ।
text: Each time after he has lead her (so) round, he makes her tread on the stone with (the words), 'Tread on this stone; like a stone be firm. Overcome the enemies; tread the foes down.'

sanskrit_iast: vadhv añjalā upastīrya bhrātā bhrātṛ sthāno vā dvir lājān āvapati |
meaning: वध्व् अञ्जला उपस्तीर्य भ्राता भ्रातृ स्थानो वा द्विर् लाजान् आवपति ।
text: Having 'spread under' (i.e. having first poured Agya over her hands), her brother or a person acting in her brother's place pours fried grain twice over the wife's joined hands.

sanskrit_iast: trir jāmadagnyānām |
meaning: त्रिर् जामदग्न्यानाम् ।
text: Three times for descendants of Gamadagni.

sanskrit_iast: pratyabhighārya haviḥ |
meaning: प्रत्यभिघार्य हविः ।
text: He pours again (Agya) over (what has been left of) the sacrificial food,

sanskrit_iast: avattam ca |
meaning: अवत्तम् च ।
text: And over what has been cut off.

sanskrit_iast: eṣo avadāna dharmaḥ |
meaning: एषो अवदान धर्मः ।
text: This is the rule about the portions to be cut off.

sanskrit_iast: aryamaṇam nu devam kanyā agnim ayakṣata | sa imām devo aryamā preto muñcātu na amutaḥ svāhā || varuṇam nu devam kanyā agnim ayakṣata | sa imām devo varuṇaḥ preto muñcātu na amutaḥ svāhā || pūṣaṇam nu devam kanyā agnim ayakṣata | sa imām devaḥ pūṣā preto muñcātu na amutaḥ svāhā ity avicchindaty añjalim srucā iva juhuyāt |
meaning: अर्यमणम् नु देवम् कन्या अग्निम् अयक्षत । स इमाम् देवो अर्यमा प्रेतो मुञ्चातु न अमुतः स्वाहा ॥ वरुणम् नु देवम् कन्या अग्निम् अयक्षत । स इमाम् देवो वरुणः प्रेतो मुञ्चातु न अमुतः स्वाहा ॥ पूषणम् नु देवम् कन्या अग्निम् अयक्षत । स इमाम् देवः पूषा प्रेतो मुञ्चातु न अमुतः स्वाहा इत्य् अविच्छिन्दत्य् अञ्जलिम् स्रुचा इव जुहुयात् ।
text: 'To god Aryaman the girls have made sacrifice, to Agni; may he, god Aryaman, loosen her from this, and not from that place, Svaha! 'To god Varuna the girls have made sacrifice, to Agni; may he, god Varuna, &c. 'To god Pushan the girls have made sacrifice, to Agni; may he, god Pushan, &c.'--with (these verses recited by the bridegroom) she should sacrifice (the fried grain) without opening her joined hands, as if (she did so) with the (spoon called) Sruk.

sanskrit_iast: apariṇīya śūrpa puṭena abhyātmam tūṣṇīm caturtham |
meaning: अपरिणीय शूर्प पुटेन अभ्यात्मम् तूष्णीम् चतुर्थम् ।
text: Without that leading round (the fire, she sacrifices grain) with the neb of a basket towards herself silently a fourth time.

sanskrit_iast: opya opya ha eke lājān pariṇayanti tathā uttame āhutī na samnipatataḥ |
meaning: ओप्य ओप्य ह एके लाजान् परिणयन्ति तथा उत्तमे आहुती न सम्निपततः ।
text: Some lead the bride round each time after the fried grain has been poured out: thus the two last oblations do not follow immediately on each other.

sanskrit_iast: atha asyai śikhe vimuñcati yadi kṛte bhavata ūrṇāstuke keśa pakṣayor baddhe bhavataḥ |
meaning: अथ अस्यै शिखे विमुञ्चति यदि कृते भवत ऊर्णास्तुके केश पक्षयोर् बद्धे भवतः ।
text: He then loosens her two locks of hair, if they are made, (i.e. if) two tufts of wool are bound round her hair on the two sides,

sanskrit_iast: pra tvā muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśād iti |
meaning: प्र त्वा मुञ्चामि वरुणस्य पाशाद् इति ।
text: With (the Rik),'I release thee from the band of Varuna' (Rig-veda X, 85, 24).

sanskrit_iast: uttarām uttarayā |
meaning: उत्तराम् उत्तरया ।
text: The left one with the following (Rik).

sanskrit_iast: atha enām aparājitāyām diśi sapta padāny abhyutkrāmayati iṣa eka pady ūrje dvipadī rāyas poṣāya tripadī māyobhavyāya catuṣpadī prajābhyaḥ pañcapady ṛtubhya ṣaṭpadī sakhā saptapadī bhava sā mām anuvratā bhava | putrān vindāvahai bahūṃs te santu jarad aṣṭaya iti |
meaning: अथ एनाम् अपराजितायाम् दिशि सप्त पदान्य् अभ्युत्क्रामयति इष एक पद्य् ऊर्जे द्विपदी रायस् पोषाय त्रिपदी मायोभव्याय चतुष्पदी प्रजाभ्यः पञ्चपद्य् ऋतुभ्य षट्पदी सखा सप्तपदी भव सा माम् अनुव्रता भव । पुत्रान् विन्दावहै बहूंस् ते सन्तु जरद् अष्टय इति ।
text: He then causes her to step forward in a northeastern direction seven steps with (the words), 'For sap with one step, for juice with two steps, for thriving of wealth with three steps, for comfort with four steps, for offspring with five steps, for the seasons with six steps. Be friend with seven steps. So be thou devoted to me. Let us acquire many sons who may reach old age!'

sanskrit_iast: ubhayoḥ samnidhāya śirasī uda kumbhena avasicya |
meaning: उभयोः सम्निधाय शिरसी उद कुम्भेन अवसिच्य ।
text: Joining together their two heads, (the bridegroom? the Akarya?) sprinkles them (with water) from the water-pot.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇyāś ca vṛddhāyā jīva patyā jīva prajāyā agāra etām rātrim vaset |
meaning: ब्राह्मण्याश् च वृद्धाया जीव पत्या जीव प्रजाया अगार एताम् रात्रिम् वसेत् ।
text: And she should dwell that night in the house of an old Brahmana woman whose husband is alive and whose children are alive.

sanskrit_iast: dhruvam arundhatīm sapta ṛṣīn iti dṛṣṭvā vācam visṛjeta jīva patnī prajām vindeta iti |
meaning: ध्रुवम् अरुन्धतीम् सप्त ऋषीन् इति दृष्ट्वा वाचम् विसृजेत जीव पत्नी प्रजाम् विन्देत इति ।
text: When she sees the polar-star, the star Arundhati, and the seven Rishis (ursa major), let her break the silence (and say), 'May my husband live and I get offspring.'

sanskrit_iast: prayāṇa upapadyamāne pūṣā tvā ito nayatu hasta gṛhya iti yānam ārohayet |
meaning: प्रयाण उपपद्यमाने पूषा त्वा इतो नयतु हस्त गृह्य इति यानम् आरोहयेत् ।
text: If (the newly-married couple) have to make a journey (to their new home), let him cause her to mount the chariot with the (verse), 'May Pushan lead thee from here holding thy hand' (Rig-veda X, 85, 26).

sanskrit_iast: aśmanvatī rīyate saṃrabhadhvam iy ardharcena nāvam ārohayet |
meaning: अश्मन्वती रीयते संरभध्वम् इय् अर्धर्चेन नावम् आरोहयेत् ।
text: With the hemistich, 'Carrying stones (the river) streams; hold fast each other' (Rig-veda X, 53, 8) let him cause her to ascend a ship.

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇa utkramet |
meaning: उत्तरेण उत्क्रमेत् ।
text: With the following (hemistich) let him make her descend (from it).

sanskrit_iast: jīvam rudanti iti rudatyām |
meaning: जीवम् रुदन्ति इति रुदत्याम् ।
text: (He pronounces the verse), 'The living one they bewail' (Rig-veda X, 40, 10), if she weeps.

sanskrit_iast: vivāha agnim agrato ajasram nayanti |
meaning: विवाह अग्निम् अग्रतो अजस्रम् नयन्ति ।
text: They constantly carry the nuptial fire in front.

sanskrit_iast: kalyāṇeṣu deśa vṛkṣa catuṣpatheṣu mā vidan paripanthina iti japet |
meaning: कल्याणेषु देश वृक्ष चतुष्पथेषु मा विदन् परिपन्थिन इति जपेत् ।
text: At lovely places, trees, and cross-ways let him murmur (the verse), 'May no waylayers meet us' (Rig-veda X, 85, 32).

sanskrit_iast: vāse vāse sumaṅgalīr iyam vadhūr iti īkṣakān īkṣeta |
meaning: वासे वासे सुमङ्गलीर् इयम् वधूर् इति ईक्षकान् ईक्षेत ।
text: At every dwelling-place (on their way) let him look at the lookers on, with (the verse), 'Good luck brings this woman' (Rig-veda X, 85, 33).

sanskrit_iast: iha priyam prajayā te samṛdhyatām iti gṛham praveśayet |
meaning: इह प्रियम् प्रजया ते समृध्यताम् इति गृहम् प्रवेशयेत् ।
text: With (the verse), 'Here may delight fulfil itself to thee through offspring' (Rig-veda X, 85, 27) he should make her enter the house.

sanskrit_iast: vivāha agnim upasamādhāya paścād asya anaḍuham carma āstīrya prāg grīvam uttara loma tasminn upaviṣṭāyām mananvārabdhāyām ā naḥ prajām janayatu prajāpatir iti catasṛbhiḥ pratyṛcam hutvā sam añjantu viśve devā iti dadhnaḥ prāśya pratiprayacched ājya śeṣeṇa vā anakti hṛdaye |
meaning: विवाह अग्निम् उपसमाधाय पश्चाद् अस्य अनडुहम् चर्म आस्तीर्य प्राग् ग्रीवम् उत्तर लोम तस्मिन्न् उपविष्टायाम् मनन्वारब्धायाम् आ नः प्रजाम् जनयतु प्रजापतिर् इति चतसृभिः प्रत्यृचम् हुत्वा सम् अञ्जन्तु विश्वे देवा इति दध्नः प्राश्य प्रतिप्रयच्छेद् आज्य शेषेण वा अनक्ति हृदये ।
text: Having given its place to the nuptial fire, and having spread to the west of it a bull's hide with the neck to the east, with the hair outside, he makes oblations, while she is sitting on that (hide) and takes hold of him, with the four (verses), 'May Pragapati create offspring to us' (Rig-veda X, 85, 43 seq.), verse by verse, and with (the verse), 'May all the gods unite' (Rig-veda X, 85, 47), he partakes of curds and gives (thereof) to her, or he besmears their two hearts with the rest of the Agya (of which he has sacrificed).

sanskrit_iast: ata ūrdhvam akṣāra alavaṇa aśinau brahmacāriṇāv alam kurvāṇāv adhaḥ śāyinau syātām trirātram dvādaśa rātram |
meaning: अत ऊर्ध्वम् अक्षार अलवण अशिनौ ब्रह्मचारिणाव् अलम् कुर्वाणाव् अधः शायिनौ स्याताम् त्रिरात्रम् द्वादश रात्रम् ।
text: From that time they should eat no saline food, they should be chaste, wear ornaments, sleep on the ground three nights or twelve nights;

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsaram vā eka ṛṣir jāyata iti |
meaning: संवत्सरम् वा एक ऋषिर् जायत इति ।
text: Or one year, (according to) some (teachers); thus, they say, a Rishi will be born (as their son).

sanskrit_iast: carita vrataḥ sūryāvide vadhū vastram dadyāt |
meaning: चरित व्रतः सूर्याविदे वधू वस्त्रम् दद्यात् ।
text: When he has fulfilled (this) observance (and has had intercourse with his wife), he should give the bride's shift to (the Brahmana) who knows the Surya hymn (Rig-veda X, 85);

sanskrit_iast: annam brāhmaṇebhyaḥ |
meaning: अन्नम् ब्राह्मणेभ्यः ।
text: 'Food to the Brahmanas;

sanskrit_iast: atha svastyayanam vācayīta |
meaning: अथ स्वस्त्ययनम् वाचयीत ।
text: Then he should cause them to pronounce auspicious words.

sanskrit_iast: pāṇi grahaṇa ādi gṛhyam paricaret svayam patny api vā putraḥ kumāry antevāsī vā |
meaning: पाणि ग्रहण आदि गृह्यम् परिचरेत् स्वयम् पत्न्य् अपि वा पुत्रः कुमार्य् अन्तेवासी वा ।
text: Beginning from the seizing of (the bride's) hand (i.e. from the wedding), he should worship the domestic (fire) himself, or his wife, or also his son, or his daughter, or a pupil.

sanskrit_iast: nitya anugṛhītaḥ syāt |
meaning: नित्य अनुगृहीतः स्यात् ।
text: (The fire) should be kept constantly.

sanskrit_iast: yadi tu upaśāmyet patny upavased ity eke |
meaning: यदि तु उपशाम्येत् पत्न्य् उपवसेद् इत्य् एके ।
text: When it goes out, however, the wife should fast: thus (say) some (teachers).

sanskrit_iast: tasya agnihotreṇa prāduṣ karaṇa homa kālau vyākhyātau |
meaning: तस्य अग्निहोत्रेण प्रादुष् करण होम कालौ व्याख्यातौ ।
text: The time for setting it in a blaze and for sacrificing in it has been explained by (the rules given with regard to) the Agnihotra,

sanskrit_iast: haumyam ca māṃsa varjam |
meaning: हौम्यम् च मांस वर्जम् ।
text: And the sacrificial food, except meat.

sanskrit_iast: kāmam tu vrīhi yava tilaiḥ |
meaning: कामम् तु व्रीहि यव तिलैः ।
text: But if he likes he may (perform the sacrifice) with rice, barley, or sesamum.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye svāhā iti sāyam juhuyāt sūryāya svāhā iti prātas tūṣṇīm dvitīye ubhayatra |
meaning: अग्नये स्वाहा इति सायम् जुहुयात् सूर्याय स्वाहा इति प्रातस् तूष्णीम् द्वितीये उभयत्र ।
text: He should sacrifice in the evening with (the formula), 'To Agni svaha!' in the morning with (the formula), 'To Surya svaha!' Silently the second (oblations) both times.

sanskrit_iast: atha pārvaṇa sthālī pākaḥ |
meaning: अथ पार्वण स्थाली पाकः ।
text: Now the oblations of cooked food on the (two) Parvan (i.e. the new and full moon) days.

sanskrit_iast: tasya darśa pūrṇa māsābhyām upavāsaḥ |
meaning: तस्य दर्श पूर्ण मासाभ्याम् उपवासः ।
text: The fasting (which takes place) thereat has been declared by (the corresponding rules regarding) the Darsapurnamasa sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: idhmā barhiṣoś ca samnahanam |
meaning: इध्मा बर्हिषोश् च सम्नहनम् ।
text: And (so has been declared) the binding together of the fuel and of the Barhis,

sanskrit_iast: devatāś ca upāṃśu jāya indra mahā indra varjam |
meaning: देवताश् च उपांशु जाय इन्द्र महा इन्द्र वर्जम् ।

sanskrit_iast: kāmyā itarāḥ |
meaning: काम्या इतराः ।

sanskrit_iast: tasyai tasyai devatāyai caturaś caturo muṣṭīn nirvapati pavitre antardhāya amuṣmai tvā juṣṭam nirvapāmi iti |
meaning: तस्यै तस्यै देवतायै चतुरश् चतुरो मुष्टीन् निर्वपति पवित्रे अन्तर्धाय अमुष्मै त्वा जुष्टम् निर्वपामि इति ।

sanskrit_iast: atha enān prokṣati yathā niruptam amuṣmai tvā juṣṭam prokṣāmi iti |
meaning: अथ एनान् प्रोक्षति यथा निरुप्तम् अमुष्मै त्वा जुष्टम् प्रोक्षामि इति ।
text: He then sprinkles them (those four portions of Havis with water) in the same way as he had poured them out, with (the formula), 'Agreeable to such and such (a deity) I sprinkle thee.'

sanskrit_iast: avahatāṃs triḥ phalī kṛtān nānā śrapayet |
meaning: अवहतांस् त्रिः फली कृतान् नाना श्रपयेत् ।
text: When (the rice or barley grains) have been husked and cleansed from the husks three times, let him cook (the four portions) separately,

sanskrit_iast: samopya vā |
meaning: समोप्य वा ।
text: Or throwing (them) together.

sanskrit_iast: yadi nānā śrapayed vibhajya taṇḍulān abhimṛśed idam amuṣmā idam amuṣmā iti |
meaning: यदि नाना श्रपयेद् विभज्य तण्डुलान् अभिमृशेद् इदम् अमुष्मा इदम् अमुष्मा इति ।
text: If he cooks them separately, let him touch the grains, after he has separated them, (and say,) 'This to this god; this to this god.'

sanskrit_iast: yady u vai samopya vyuddhāram juhuyāt |
meaning: यद्य् उ वै समोप्य व्युद्धारम् जुहुयात् ।
text: But if he (cooks the portions) throwing (them) together, he should (touch and) sacrifice them, after he has put (the single portions) into different vessels.

sanskrit_iast: śṛtāni havīṃṣy bhighārya udag udvāsya barhiṣy āsādya idhmam abhighārya ayam ta idhma ātmā jāta vedas tena idhyasva vardhasva ca iddha vardhaya ca asmān prajayā paśubhir brahma varcasena anna adyena samedhaya svāhā iti |
meaning: शृतानि हवींष्य् भिघार्य उदग् उद्वास्य बर्हिष्य् आसाद्य इध्मम् अभिघार्य अयम् त इध्म आत्मा जात वेदस् तेन इध्यस्व वर्धस्व च इद्ध वर्धय च अस्मान् प्रजया पशुभिर् ब्रह्म वर्चसेन अन्न अद्येन समेधय स्वाहा इति ।
text: The portions of sacrificial food, when they have been cooked, he sprinkles (with Agya, takes them from the fire towards the north, places them on the Barhis, and sprinkles the fuel with Agya with the formula, 'This fuel is thy self, Gatavedas; thereby burn thou and increase, and, O burning One, make us increase and through offspring, cattle, holy lustre, and nourishment make us prosper. Svaha!'

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīm āghārāv āghārya ājya bhāgau juhuyād agnaye svāhā somāya svāhā iti |
meaning: तूष्णीम् आघाराव् आघार्य आज्य भागौ जुहुयाद् अग्नये स्वाहा सोमाय स्वाहा इति ।
text: Having silently poured out the two Agharas (or Agya oblations poured out with the Sruva, the one from north-west to south-east, the other from south-west to north-east), he should sacrifice the two Agya portions with (the formulas), 'To Agni svaha! To Soma svaha!'--

sanskrit_iast: uttaram āgneyam dakṣiṇam saumyam |
meaning: उत्तरम् आग्नेयम् दक्षिणम् सौम्यम् ।
text: The northern one belonging to Agni, the southern one to Soma.

sanskrit_iast: vijñāyate cakṣuṣī vā ete yajñasya yad ājya bhāgau |
meaning: विज्ञायते चक्षुषी वा एते यज्ञस्य यद् आज्य भागौ ।
text: It is understood (in the Sruti), The two eyes indeed of the sacrifice are the Agya portions,

sanskrit_iast: tasmāt puruṣasya pratyan mukhasya āsīnasya dakṣiṇam akṣy uttaram bhavaty uttaram dakṣiṇam |
meaning: तस्मात् पुरुषस्य प्रत्यन् मुखस्य आसीनस्य दक्षिणम् अक्ष्य् उत्तरम् भवत्य् उत्तरम् दक्षिणम् ।
text: 'Therefore of a man who is sitting with his face to the west the southern (i.e. right) eye is northern, the northern (i.e. left) eye is southern.'

sanskrit_iast: madhye havīṃṣi pratyaktaram vā prāk saṃsthāny udak saṃsthāni vā |
meaning: मध्ये हवींषि प्रत्यक्तरम् वा प्राक् संस्थान्य् उदक् संस्थानि वा ।
text: In the middle (of the two Agya portions he sacrifices the other) Havis, or more to the west, finishing (the oblations) in the east or in the north.

sanskrit_iast: uttara purastāt sauviṣṭakṛtam |
meaning: उत्तर पुरस्तात् सौविष्टकृतम् ।
text: To the north-east the oblation to (Agni) Svishtakrit.

sanskrit_iast: madhyāt pūrva ardhāc ca haviṣo avadyati |
meaning: मध्यात् पूर्व अर्धाच् च हविषो अवद्यति ।
text: He cuts off (the Avadana portions) from the Havis from the middle and from the eastern part;

sanskrit_iast: madhyāt pūrva ardhāt paścārdhād iti pañca avattinām |
meaning: मध्यात् पूर्व अर्धात् पश्चार्धाद् इति पञ्च अवत्तिनाम् ।
text: From the middle, the eastern part and the western part (the portions have to be cut off) by those who make five Avadanas;

sanskrit_iast: uttara ardhāt sauviṣṭakṛtam |
meaning: उत्तर अर्धात् सौविष्टकृतम् ।
text: From the northern side the portion for Svishtakrit.

sanskrit_iast: na atra havīṃṣi pratyabhighārayati |
meaning: न अत्र हवींषि प्रत्यभिघारयति ।
text: Here he omits the second pouring (of Agya) over (what is left of) the sacrificial food.

sanskrit_iast: yad asya karmaṇo atyarīricam yad vā nyūnam iha akaram | agniṣ ṭat sviṣṭakṛd vidvāṃt sarvam sviṣṭam suhutam karotu me | agnaye sviṣṭakṛte suhutahute sarva prāyaś citta āhutīnām kāmānām samardhayitre sarva annaḥ kāmāṃt samardhaya svāhā iti |
meaning: यद् अस्य कर्मणो अत्यरीरिचम् यद् वा न्यूनम् इह अकरम् । अग्निष् टत् स्विष्टकृद् विद्वांत् सर्वम् स्विष्टम् सुहुतम् करोतु मे । अग्नये स्विष्टकृते सुहुतहुते सर्व प्रायश् चित्त आहुतीनाम् कामानाम् समर्धयित्रे सर्व अन्नः कामांत् समर्धय स्वाहा इति ।
text: 'What I have done too much in this ceremony, or what I have done here too little, all that may Agni Svishtakrit, he who knows it, make well sacrificed and well offered for me. To Agni Svishtakrit, to him who offers the oblations for general expiation, so that they are well offered, to him who makes us succeed in what we desire! Make us in all that we desire successful! Svaha!'

sanskrit_iast: barhiṣi pūrṇa pātram ninayet |
meaning: बर्हिषि पूर्ण पात्रम् निनयेत् ।
text: He pours out the full vessel on the Barhis.

sanskrit_iast: eṣo avabhṛthaḥ |
meaning: एषो अवभृथः ।
text: This is the Avabhritha.

sanskrit_iast: pāka yajñānām etat tantram |
meaning: पाक यज्ञानाम् एतत् तन्त्रम् ।
text: This is the standard form of the Pakayagnas.

sanskrit_iast: havir ucchiṣṭam dakṣiṇā |
meaning: हविर् उच्छिष्टम् दक्षिणा ।
text: What has been left of the Havis is the fee for the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: atha paśu kalpaḥ |
meaning: अथ पशु कल्पः ।
text: Now (follows) the ritual of the animal sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: uttarato agneḥ śāmitrasya āyatanam kṛtvā pāyayitvā paśum āplāvya purastāt pratyan mukham avasthāpya agnim dūtam iti dvābhyām hutvā sapalāśśyā ārdra śākhayā paścād upaspṛśed amuṣmai tvā juṣṭam upākaromi iti |
meaning: उत्तरतो अग्नेः शामित्रस्य आयतनम् कृत्वा पाययित्वा पशुम् आप्लाव्य पुरस्तात् प्रत्यन् मुखम् अवस्थाप्य अग्निम् दूतम् इति द्वाभ्याम् हुत्वा सपलाश्श्या आर्द्र शाखया पश्चाद् उपस्पृशेद् अमुष्मै त्वा जुष्टम् उपाकरोमि इति ।
text: Having prepared to the north of the fire the place for the Samitra fire, having given drink (to the animal which he is going to sacrifice), having washed the animal, having placed it to the east (of the fire) with its face to the west, having made oblations with the two Rikas, 'Agni as our messenger' (Rig-veda I, 12, 1 seq.), let him touch (the animal) from behind with a fresh branch on which there are leaves, with (the formula), 'Agreeable to such and such (a deity) I touch thee.'

sanskrit_iast: vrīhi yavamatībhir adbhiḥ purastāt prokṣaty amuṣmai tvā juṣṭam prokṣāmi iti |
meaning: व्रीहि यवमतीभिर् अद्भिः पुरस्तात् प्रोक्षत्य् अमुष्मै त्वा जुष्टम् प्रोक्षामि इति ।
text: He sprinkles it from before with water in which rice and barley are, with (the formula), 'Agreeable to such and such (a deity) I sprinkle thee.'

sanskrit_iast: tāsām pāyayitvā dakṣiṇam anu bāhum śeṣam ninayet |
meaning: तासाम् पाययित्वा दक्षिणम् अनु बाहुम् शेषम् निनयेत् ।
text: Having given (to the animal) to drink of that (water), he should pour out the rest (of it) along its right fore-foot.

sanskrit_iast: āvṛtā eva paryagni kṛtvā udañcam nayanti |
meaning: आवृता एव पर्यग्नि कृत्वा उदञ्चम् नयन्ति ।
text: Having carried fire round (it), performing that act only (without repeating a corresponding Mantra), they lead it to the north.

sanskrit_iast: tasya purastād ulmukam haranti |
meaning: तस्य पुरस्ताद् उल्मुकम् हरन्ति ।
text: In front of it they carry a fire-brand.

sanskrit_iast: śāmitra eṣa bhavati |
meaning: शामित्र एष भवति ।
text: This is the Samitra (fire).

sanskrit_iast: vapā śrapaṇībhyām kartā paśum anvārabhate |
meaning: वपा श्रपणीभ्याम् कर्ता पशुम् अन्वारभते ।
text: With the two Vapasrapani ladles the 'performer' touches the animal.

sanskrit_iast: kartāram yajamānaḥ |
meaning: कर्तारम् यजमानः ।
text: The sacrificer (touches) the performer.

sanskrit_iast: paścāt śāmitrasya prāk śirasam pratyak śirasam vā udak pādam saṃjñapya purā nābhes tṛṇam antardhāya vapām utkhidya vapām avadāya vapā śravaṇībhyām parigṛhya adbhir abhiṣicya śāmitre pratāpya agreṇa enam agnim hṛtvā dakṣiṇata āsīnaḥ śrapayitvā parītya juhuyāt |
meaning: पश्चात् शामित्रस्य प्राक् शिरसम् प्रत्यक् शिरसम् वा उदक् पादम् संज्ञप्य पुरा नाभेस् तृणम् अन्तर्धाय वपाम् उत्खिद्य वपाम् अवदाय वपा श्रवणीभ्याम् परिगृह्य अद्भिर् अभिषिच्य शामित्रे प्रताप्य अग्रेण एनम् अग्निम् हृत्वा दक्षिणत आसीनः श्रपयित्वा परीत्य जुहुयात् ।
text: To the west of the Samitra (fire) he (the Samitri) kills (the animal), the head of which is turned to the east or to the west, the feet to the north; and having placed a grass-blade on his side of the (animal's) navel, (the 'performer') draws out the omentum, cuts off the omentum, seizes it with the two Agnisrapanis, sprinkles it with water, warms it at the Samitra (fire), takes it before that fire, roasts it, being seated to the south, goes round (the two fires), and sacrifices it.

sanskrit_iast: etasminn eva agnau sthālī pākam śrapayanti |
meaning: एतस्मिन्न् एव अग्नौ स्थाली पाकम् श्रपयन्ति ।
text: At the same fire they cook a mess of food.

sanskrit_iast: ekādaśa paśor avadānāni sarva aṅgebhyo avadāya śāmitre śrapayitvā hṛdayam śūle pratāpya sthālī pākasya agrato juhuyāt |
meaning: एकादश पशोर् अवदानानि सर्व अङ्गेभ्यो अवदाय शामित्रे श्रपयित्वा हृदयम् शूले प्रताप्य स्थाली पाकस्य अग्रतो जुहुयात् ।
text: Having cut off the eleven Avadanas (or portions which have to be cut off) from the animal, from all its limbs, having boiled them at the Samitra (fire), and having warmed the heart on a spit, let him sacrifice first from the mess of cooked food (mentioned in Sutra 11);

sanskrit_iast: avadānair vā saha |
meaning: अवदानैर् वा सह ।
text: Or together with the Avadana portions.

sanskrit_iast: eka ekasya avadānasya dvir dvir avadyati |
meaning: एक एकस्य अवदानस्य द्विर् द्विर् अवद्यति ।
text: From each of the (eleven) Avadanas he cuts off two portions.

sanskrit_iast: āvṛtā eva hṛdaya śūlena caranti |
meaning: आवृता एव हृदय शूलेन चरन्ति ।
text: They perform the rites only (without corresponding Mantras) with the heart's spit (i.e. the spit on which the heart had been; see Sutra 12).

sanskrit_iast: caitya yajñe prāk sviṣṭakṛtaś caityāya balim haret |
meaning: चैत्य यज्ञे प्राक् स्विष्टकृतश् चैत्याय बलिम् हरेत् ।
text: At a Kaitya sacrifice he should before the Svishtakrit (offering) offer a Bali to the Kaitya.

sanskrit_iast: yady u vai videśastham palāśa dūtena |
meaning: यद्य् उ वै विदेशस्थम् पलाश दूतेन ।
text: If, however, (the Kaitya) is distant, (he should send his Bali) through a leaf-messenger.

sanskrit_iast: yatra vettha vanaspata ity etayā ṛcā dvau piṇḍau kṛtvā vīvadhe abhyādhāya dūtāya prayacced imam tasmai balim hara iti ca enam brūyāt |
meaning: यत्र वेत्थ वनस्पत इत्य् एतया ऋचा द्वौ पिण्डौ कृत्वा वीवधे अभ्याधाय दूताय प्रयच्चेद् इमम् तस्मै बलिम् हर इति च एनम् ब्रूयात् ।
text: With the Rik, 'Where thou knowest, O tree' (Rig-veda V, 5, 10), let him make two lumps (of food), put them on a carrying-pole, hand them over to the messenger, and say to him, 'Carry this Bali to that (Kaitya).'

sanskrit_iast: ayam tubhyam iti yo dūtāya |
meaning: अयम् तुभ्यम् इति यो दूताय ।
text: (He gives him the lump) which is destined for the messenger, with (the words), 'This to thee.'

sanskrit_iast: pratibhayam ced antarā śastram api kiṃcit |
meaning: प्रतिभयम् चेद् अन्तरा शस्त्रम् अपि किंचित् ।
text: If there is anything dangerous between (them and the Kaitya), (he gives him) some weapon also.

sanskrit_iast: nāvyā cen nady antarā plava rūpam api kiṃcid anena taritavyam iti |
meaning: नाव्या चेन् नद्य् अन्तरा प्लव रूपम् अपि किंचिद् अनेन तरितव्यम् इति ।
text: If a navigable river is between (them and the Kaitya, he gives him) also something like a raft with (the words), 'Hereby thou shalt cross.'

sanskrit_iast: dhanvantari yajñe brāhmaṇam agnim ca antarā purohitāya agne balim haret |
meaning: धन्वन्तरि यज्ञे ब्राह्मणम् अग्निम् च अन्तरा पुरोहिताय अग्ने बलिम् हरेत् ।
text: At the Dhanvantari sacrifice let him offer first a Bali to the Purohita, between the Brahman and the fire.

sanskrit_iast: upaniṣadi garbha lambhanam puṃsavanam anavalobhanam ca |
meaning: उपनिषदि गर्भ लम्भनम् पुंसवनम् अनवलोभनम् च ।
text: The Upanishad (treats of) the Garbhalambhana, the Pumsavana, and the Anavalobhana (i.e. the ceremonies for securing the conception of a child, the male gender of the child, and for preventing disturbances which could endanger the embryo).

sanskrit_iast: yady na adhīyāt tṛtīye garbha māse tiṣyeṇa upoṣitāyāḥ sarūpa vatsāyā gor dadhani dvau dvau tu māṣau yavam ca dadhi prasṛtena prāśayet |
meaning: यद्य् न अधीयात् तृतीये गर्भ मासे तिष्येण उपोषितायाः सरूप वत्साया गोर् दधनि द्वौ द्वौ तु माषौ यवम् च दधि प्रसृतेन प्राशयेत् ।
text: If he does not study (that Upanishad), he should in the third month of her pregnancy, under (the Nakshatra) Tishya, give to eat (to the wife), after she has fasted, in curds from a cow which has a calf of the same colour (with herself), two beans and one barley grain for each handful of curds.

sanskrit_iast: kim pibasi kim pibasi iti pṛṣṭā puṃsavanam puṃsavanam iti triḥ pratijānīyāt |
meaning: किम् पिबसि किम् पिबसि इति पृष्टा पुंसवनम् पुंसवनम् इति त्रिः प्रतिजानीयात् ।
text: To his question, 'What dost thou drink? What dost thou drink?' she should thrice reply, 'Generation of a male child! Generation of a male child!'

sanskrit_iast: evam trīn prasṛtān |
meaning: एवम् त्रीन् प्रसृतान् ।
text: Thus three handfuls (of curds).

sanskrit_iast: atha asyai maṇḍala agārac chāyāyām dakṣiṇasyām nāsikāyām ajītām oṣadhīm nastaḥ karoti |
meaning: अथ अस्यै मण्डल अगारच् छायायाम् दक्षिणस्याम् नासिकायाम् अजीताम् ओषधीम् नस्तः करोति ।
text: He then inserts into her right nostril, in the shadow of a round apartment, (the sap of) an herb which is not faded,

sanskrit_iast: prājāvat jīva putrābhyām ha eke |
meaning: प्राजावत् जीव पुत्राभ्याम् ह एके ।
text: According to some (teachers) with the Pragavat and Givaputra hymns.

sanskrit_iast: prājāpatyasya yat te susīme hṛdaye hitam antaḥ prajāpatau | manye aham mām tad vidvāṃsam mā aham pautram agham niyām iti |
meaning: प्राजापत्यस्य यत् ते सुसीमे हृदये हितम् अन्तः प्रजापतौ । मन्ये अहम् माम् तद् विद्वांसम् मा अहम् पौत्रम् अघम् नियाम् इति ।
text: Having sacrificed of a mess of cooked food sacred to Pragapati, he should touch the place of her heart with the (verse,) 'What is hidden, O thou whose hair is well parted, in thy heart, in Pragapati, that I know; such is my belief. May I not fall into distress that comes from sons.'

sanskrit_iast: caturthe garbha māse sīmanta unnayanam |
meaning: चतुर्थे गर्भ मासे सीमन्त उन्नयनम् ।
text: In the fourth month of pregnancy the Simantonnayana (or parting of the hair, is performed).

sanskrit_iast: āpūryamāṇa pakṣe yadā puṃsā nakṣatreṇa candramā yuktaḥ syāt |
meaning: आपूर्यमाण पक्षे यदा पुंसा नक्षत्रेण चन्द्रमा युक्तः स्यात् ।
text: In the fortnight of the increasing moon, when the moon stands in conjunction with a Nakshatra (that has a name) of masculine gender--

sanskrit_iast: atha agnim upasamādhāya paścād asya anaḍuham carma āstīrya prāg grīvam uttara loma tasminn upaviṣṭāyām samanvārabdhāyām dhātā dadātu dāśuṣa iti dvābhyām rākām aham iti dvābhyām nejameṣa prajāpate na tvad etāny anya iti ca |
meaning: अथ अग्निम् उपसमाधाय पश्चाद् अस्य अनडुहम् चर्म आस्तीर्य प्राग् ग्रीवम् उत्तर लोम तस्मिन्न् उपविष्टायाम् समन्वारब्धायाम् धाता ददातु दाशुष इति द्वाभ्याम् राकाम् अहम् इति द्वाभ्याम् नेजमेष प्रजापते न त्वद् एतान्य् अन्य इति च ।
text: Then he gives its place to the fire, and having spread to the west of it a bull's hide with the neck to the east, with the hair outside, (he makes oblations,) while (his wife) is sitting on that (hide) and takes hold of him, with the two (verses), 'May Dhatri give to his worshipper,' with the two verses, 'I invoke Raka' (Rig-veda II, 32, 4 seq.), and with (the texts), 'Negamesha,' and, 'Pragapati, no other one than thou' (Rig-Veda X, 121, 10).

sanskrit_iast: atha asyai yugmena śalāṭu grapsena treṇyā ca śalalyā tribhiś ca kuśa piñjūlair ūrdhvam sīmantam vyūhati bhūr bhuvaḥ svar om iti triḥ |
meaning: अथ अस्यै युग्मेन शलाटु ग्रप्सेन त्रेण्या च शलल्या त्रिभिश् च कुश पिञ्जूलैर् ऊर्ध्वम् सीमन्तम् व्यूहति भूर् भुवः स्वर् ओम् इति त्रिः ।
text: He then three times parts her hair upwards (i.e. beginning from the front) with a bunch containing an even number of unripe fruits, and with a porcupine's quill that has three white spots, and with three bunches of Kusa grass, with (the words), 'Bhur bhuvah, svar, om!'

sanskrit_iast: catur vā |
meaning: चतुर् वा ।
text: Or four times.

sanskrit_iast: vinā gāthinau saṃśāsti somam rājānam saṃgāyetām iti |
meaning: विना गाथिनौ संशास्ति सोमम् राजानम् संगायेताम् इति ।
text: He gives orders to two lute-players, 'Sing king Soma.'

sanskrit_iast: somo no rājā avatu mānuṣīḥ prajā niviṣṭa cakra asāv iti yām nadīm upavasitā bhavanti |
meaning: सोमो नो राजा अवतु मानुषीः प्रजा निविष्ट चक्र असाव् इति याम् नदीम् उपवसिता भवन्ति ।
text: (They sing) 'May Soma our king bless the human race. Settled is the wheel of N.N.'--(here they name) the river near which they dwell.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇyaś ca vṛddhā jīva patyo jīva prajā yad yad upadiśeyus tat tat kuryuḥ |
meaning: ब्राह्मण्यश् च वृद्धा जीव पत्यो जीव प्रजा यद् यद् उपदिशेयुस् तत् तत् कुर्युः ।
text: And whatever aged Brahmana woman, whose husbands and children are alive, tell them, that let them do.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣabho dakṣiṇā |
meaning: ऋषभो दक्षिणा ।
text: A bull is the fee for the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: kumāram jātam purā anyair ālambhāt sarpir madhunī hiraṇya nikāṣam hiraṇyena prāśayet pra te dadāmi madhuno ghṛtasya vedam savitrā prasūtam maghonām | āyuṣmān gupto devatābhiḥ śatam jīva śarado loke asann iti |
meaning: कुमारम् जातम् पुरा अन्यैर् आलम्भात् सर्पिर् मधुनी हिरण्य निकाषम् हिरण्येन प्राशयेत् प्र ते ददामि मधुनो घृतस्य वेदम् सवित्रा प्रसूतम् मघोनाम् । आयुष्मान् गुप्तो देवताभिः शतम् जीव शरदो लोके असन्न् इति ।
text: When a son has been born, (the father) should, before other people touch him, give him to eat from gold (i.e. from a golden vessel or with a golden spoon) butter and honey with which he has ground gold(-dust), with (the verse), 'I administer to thee the wisdom ('veda') of honey, of ghee, raised by Savitri the bountiful. Long-living, protected by the gods, live a hundred autumns in this world!'

sanskrit_iast: karṇayor upanidhāya medhā jananam japati medhām te devaḥ savitā medhām devī sarasvatī | medhām te aśvinau devāv ādhattām puṣkara srajāv iti |
meaning: कर्णयोर् उपनिधाय मेधा जननम् जपति मेधाम् ते देवः सविता मेधाम् देवी सरस्वती । मेधाम् ते अश्विनौ देवाव् आधत्ताम् पुष्कर स्रजाव् इति ।
text: Approaching (his mouth) to (the child's) two ears he murmurs the 'production of intelligence:' 'Intelligence may give to thee god Savitri, intelligence may goddess Sarasvati, intelligence may give to thee the two divine Asvins, wreathed with lotus.'

sanskrit_iast: aṃsāv abhimṛśaty aśmā bhava paraśur bhava hiraṇyam astṛtam bhava | vedo vai putra nāmā asi sa jīva śaradaḥ śatam iti indram śreṣṭhāni draviṇāni dhehy asme prayandhi maghavann ṛjīṣinn iti ca |
meaning: अंसाव् अभिमृशत्य् अश्मा भव परशुर् भव हिरण्यम् अस्तृतम् भव । वेदो वै पुत्र नामा असि स जीव शरदः शतम् इति इन्द्रम् श्रेष्ठानि द्रविणानि धेह्य् अस्मे प्रयन्धि मघवन्न् ऋजीषिन्न् इति च ।
text: He touches (the child's) two shoulders with (the verse), 'Be a stone, be an axe, be insuperable gold. Thou indeed art the Veda, called son; so live a hundred autumns'--and with (the verses), 'Indra, give the best treasures' (Rig-veda II, 21, 6), Bestow on us, O bountiful one, O speedy one' (Rig-veda III, 36, 10).

sanskrit_iast: nāma ca asmai dadyur ghoṣavad ādy antar antastham abhiniṣṭāna antam dvy akṣaram |
meaning: नाम च अस्मै दद्युर् घोषवद् आद्य् अन्तर् अन्तस्थम् अभिनिष्टान अन्तम् द्व्य् अक्षरम् ।
text: And let them give him a name beginning with a sonant, with a semivowel in it, with the Visarga at its end, consisting of two syllables,

sanskrit_iast: catur akṣaram vā |
meaning: चतुर् अक्षरम् वा ।
text: Or of four syllables;

sanskrit_iast: dvy akṣaram pratiṣṭhā kāmaś catur akṣaram brahma varcasa kāmaḥ |
meaning: द्व्य् अक्षरम् प्रतिष्ठा कामश् चतुर् अक्षरम् ब्रह्म वर्चस कामः ।
text: Of two syllables, if he is desirous of firm position; of four syllables, if he is desirous of holy lustre;

sanskrit_iast: yugmāni tv eva puṃsām ayujāni strīṇām |
meaning: युग्मानि त्व् एव पुंसाम् अयुजानि स्त्रीणाम् ।
text: But in every case with an even number (of syllables) for men, an uneven for women.

sanskrit_iast: abhivādanīyam ca samīkṣeta tan mātā pitarau vidyātām ā upanayanāt |
meaning: अभिवादनीयम् च समीक्षेत तन् माता पितरौ विद्याताम् आ उपनयनात् ।
text: And let him also find out (for the child) a name to be used at respectful salutations (such as that due to the Akarya at the ceremony of the initiation); that his mother and his father (alone) should know till his initiation.

sanskrit_iast: pravāsād etya putrasya śiraḥ parigṛhya japaty aṅgād aṅgāt sambhavasi hṛdayād adhi jāyase | ātmā vai putra nāmā asi sa jīva śaradaḥ śatam iti mūrdhani trir avaghrāya |
meaning: प्रवासाद् एत्य पुत्रस्य शिरः परिगृह्य जपत्य् अङ्गाद् अङ्गात् सम्भवसि हृदयाद् अधि जायसे । आत्मा वै पुत्र नामा असि स जीव शरदः शतम् इति मूर्धनि त्रिर् अवघ्राय ।
text: When he returns from a journey, he embraces his son's head and murmurs, 'From limb by limb thou art produced; out of the heart thou art born. Thou indeed art the self called son; so live a hundred autumns!'--(thus) he kisses him three times on his head.

sanskrit_iast: āvṛtā eva kumāryai |
meaning: आवृता एव कुमार्यै ।
text: The rite only (without the Mantra is performed) for a girl.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaṣṭhe māsy anna prāśanam |
meaning: षष्ठे मास्य् अन्न प्राशनम् ।
text: In the sixth month the Annaprasana (i.e. the first feeding with solid food).

sanskrit_iast: ājam anna adya kāmaḥ |
meaning: आजम् अन्न अद्य कामः ।
text: Goat's flesh, if he is desirous of nourishment,

sanskrit_iast: taittiram brahma varcasa kāmaḥ |
meaning: तैत्तिरम् ब्रह्म वर्चस कामः ।
text: Flesh of partridge, if desirous of holy lustre,

sanskrit_iast: ghṛta odanam tejas kāmaḥ |
meaning: घृत ओदनम् तेजस् कामः ।
text: Boiled rice with ghee, if desirous of splendour:

sanskrit_iast: dahdi madhu ghṛta miśram annam prāśayed anna pate annasya no dehy anamīvasya śuṣmiṇaḥ | pra pradātāram tāriṣa ūrjam no dhehi dvipade catuṣpada iti |
meaning: दह्दि मधु घृत मिश्रम् अन्नम् प्राशयेद् अन्न पते अन्नस्य नो देह्य् अनमीवस्य शुष्मिणः । प्र प्रदातारम् तारिष ऊर्जम् नो धेहि द्विपदे चतुष्पद इति ।
text: (Such) food, mixed with curds, honey and ghee he should give (to the child) to eat with (the verse), 'Lord of food, give us food painless and strong; bring forward the giver; bestow power on us, on men and animals.'

sanskrit_iast: āvṛtā eva kumāryai |
meaning: आवृता एव कुमार्यै ।
text: The rite only (without the Mantra) for a girl.

sanskrit_iast: tṛjīye varṣe caulam yathā kula dharmam vā |
meaning: तृजीये वर्षे चौलम् यथा कुल धर्मम् वा ।
text: In the third year the Kaula (i.e. the tonsure of the child's head), or according to the custom of the family.

sanskrit_iast: uttarato agner vrīhi yava māṣa tilānām pṛthak pūrṇa śarāvāṇi nidadhāti |
meaning: उत्तरतो अग्नेर् व्रीहि यव माष तिलानाम् पृथक् पूर्ण शरावाणि निदधाति ।
text: To the north of the fire he places vessels which are filled respectively, with rice, barley, beans, and sesamum seeds;

sanskrit_iast: paścāt kārayiṣyamāṇo mātur upastha ānaḍuham gomayam nave śarāve śamī parṇāni ca upanihitāni bhavanti |
meaning: पश्चात् कारयिष्यमाणो मातुर् उपस्थ आनडुहम् गोमयम् नवे शरावे शमी पर्णानि च उपनिहितानि भवन्ति ।
text: To the west (the boy) for whom the ceremony shall be performed, in his mother's lap, bull-dung in a new vessel, and Sami leaves are placed.

sanskrit_iast: mātuḥ pitā dakṣiṇata ekaviṃśati kuśa piñjūlāny ādāya |
meaning: मातुः पिता दक्षिणत एकविंशति कुश पिञ्जूलान्य् आदाय ।
text: To the south of the mother the father (is seated) holding twenty-one bunches of Kusa grass.

sanskrit_iast: brahmā vā etāni dhārayet |
meaning: ब्रह्मा वा एतानि धारयेत् ।
text: Or the Brahman should hold them.

sanskrit_iast: paścāt kārayiṣyamāṇasya avasthāya śīta uṣṇā apaḥ samanīya uṣṇena vāya udakena ihi iti |
meaning: पश्चात् कारयिष्यमाणस्य अवस्थाय शीत उष्णा अपः समनीय उष्णेन वाय उदकेन इहि इति ।
text: To the west of (the boy) for whom the ceremony is to be performed, (the father) stations himself and pours cold and warm water together with (the words), 'With warm water, O Vayu, come hither!'

sanskrit_iast: tāsām gṛhītvā nava nītam dadhi drapsān vā pradakṣiṇam śiras trir undaty aditiḥ keśān vapatv āpa undantu varcasa iti |
meaning: तासाम् गृहीत्वा नव नीतम् दधि द्रप्सान् वा प्रदक्षिणम् शिरस् त्रिर् उन्दत्य् अदितिः केशान् वपत्व् आप उन्दन्तु वर्चस इति ।
text: Taking of that (water), (and) fresh butter, or (some) drops of curds, he three times moistens (the boy's) head, from the left to the right, with (the formula), 'May Aditi cut thy hair; may the waters moisten thee for vigour!'

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇena keśa pakṣe trīṇi trīṇi kuśa piñjūlāny abhyātma agrāṇi nidadhāty oṣadhe trāyasva enam iti |
meaning: दक्षिणेन केश पक्षे त्रीणि त्रीणि कुश पिञ्जूलान्य् अभ्यात्म अग्राणि निदधात्य् ओषधे त्रायस्व एनम् इति ।
text: Into the right part (of the hair) he puts each time three Kusa bunches, with the points towards (the boy) himself, with (the words), 'Herb! protect him!'

sanskrit_iast: svadhite mā enam hiṃsīr iti niṣpīḍya lauhena kṣureṇa |
meaning: स्वधिते मा एनम् हिंसीर् इति निष्पीड्य लौहेन क्षुरेण ।
text: (With the words,) 'Axe! do no harm to him!' he presses a copper razor (on the Kusa blades),

sanskrit_iast: pracchinatti yena āvapat savitā kṣureṇa somasya rājño varuṇasya vidvān | tena brahmāṇo vapata idam asya āyṣmān jarad aṣṭir yathā asad iti |
meaning: प्रच्छिनत्ति येन आवपत् सविता क्षुरेण सोमस्य राज्ञो वरुणस्य विद्वान् । तेन ब्रह्माणो वपत इदम् अस्य आय्ष्मान् जरद् अष्टिर् यथा असद् इति ।
text: And cuts (the hair) with (the verse), 'The razor with which in the beginning Savitri the knowing one has shaved (the beard) of king Soma and of Varuna, with that, ye Brahmanas, shave now his (hair), that he may be blessed with long life, with old age.'

sanskrit_iast: pracchidya pracchidya prāg agrām śamī parṇaiḥ saha mātre prayacchati tān ānaḍuhe gomaye nidadhāti |
meaning: प्रच्छिद्य प्रच्छिद्य प्राग् अग्राम् शमी पर्णैः सह मात्रे प्रयच्छति तान् आनडुहे गोमये निदधाति ।
text: Each time that he has cut, he gives (the hairs) with their points to the east, together with Sami leaves, to the mother. She puts them down on the bull-dung.

sanskrit_iast: yena dhātā bṛhaspater agner indrasya ca āyuṣe avapat | tena ta āyuṣe vapāmi suślokyāya svastaya iti dvitīyam |
meaning: येन धाता बृहस्पतेर् अग्नेर् इन्द्रस्य च आयुषे अवपत् । तेन त आयुषे वपामि सुश्लोक्याय स्वस्तय इति द्वितीयम् ।
text: 'With what Dhatri has shaven (the head) of Brihaspati, Agni and Indra, for the sake of long life, with that I shave thy (head) for the sake of long life, of glory, and of welfare'--thus a second time.

sanskrit_iast: yena bhūyaś ca rātryām jyok ca paśyāti sūryam | tena ta āyuṣe vapāmi suślokyāya svastaya iti tṛtīyam |
meaning: येन भूयश् च रात्र्याम् ज्योक् च पश्याति सूर्यम् । तेन त आयुषे वपामि सुश्लोक्याय स्वस्तय इति तृतीयम् ।
text: 'By what he may at night further see the sun, and see it long, with that I shave thy (head) for the sake of long life, of glory, and of welfare'--thus a third time.

sanskrit_iast: sarvair mantraiś caturtham |
meaning: सर्वैर् मन्त्रैश् चतुर्थम् ।
text: With all (the indicated) Mantras a fourth time.

sanskrit_iast: evam uttaratas triḥ |
meaning: एवम् उत्तरतस् त्रिः ।
text: Thus three times on the left side (of the head).

sanskrit_iast: kṣura tejo nimṛjed yat kṣureṇa marcayatā supeśasā vaptā vapasi keśān | śuddhim śiro mā asya āyuḥ pramoṣīr iti |
meaning: क्षुर तेजो निमृजेद् यत् क्षुरेण मर्चयता सुपेशसा वप्ता वपसि केशान् । शुद्धिम् शिरो मा अस्य आयुः प्रमोषीर् इति ।
text: Let him wipe off the edge of the razor with (the words), 'If thou shavest, as a shaver, his hair with the razor, the wounding, the well-shaped, purify his head, but do not take away his life.'

sanskrit_iast: nāpitam śiṣyāt śīta uṣṇābhir adbhir ab artham kurvāṇo akṣaṇvan kuśalī kurv iti |
meaning: नापितम् शिष्यात् शीत उष्णाभिर् अद्भिर् अब् अर्थम् कुर्वाणो अक्षण्वन् कुशली कुर्व् इति ।
text: Let him give orders to the barber, 'With lukewarm water doing what has to be done with water, without doing harm to him, arrange (his hair) well.'

sanskrit_iast: yathā kula dharmam keśa veśān kārayet |
meaning: यथा कुल धर्मम् केश वेशान् कारयेत् ।
text: Let him have the arrangement of the hair made according to the custom of his family.

sanskrit_iast: āvṛtā eva kumāryai |
meaning: आवृता एव कुमार्यै ।
text: The rite only (without the Mantras) for a girl.

sanskrit_iast: etena go dānam |
meaning: एतेन गो दानम् ।
text: Thereby the Godanakarman (i.e. the ceremony of shaving the beard, is declared).

sanskrit_iast: ṣoḍaśe varṣe |
meaning: षोडशे वर्षे ।
text: In the sixteenth year.

sanskrit_iast: keśa śabde tu śmaśru śabdān kārayet |
meaning: केश शब्दे तु श्मश्रु शब्दान् कारयेत् ।
text: Instead of the word 'hair' he should (each time that it occurs in the Mantras) put the word 'beard.'

sanskrit_iast: śmaśrūṇi iha undati |
meaning: श्मश्रूणि इह उन्दति ।
text: Here they moisten the beard.

sanskrit_iast: śuddhim śiro mukham mā asya āyuḥ pramoṣīr iti |
meaning: शुद्धिम् शिरो मुखम् मा अस्य आयुः प्रमोषीर् इति ।
text: (The Mantra is), 'Purify his head and his face, but do not take away his life.'

sanskrit_iast: keśa śmaśru loma nakhāny udak saṃsthāni kurv iti sampreṣyati |
meaning: केश श्मश्रु लोम नखान्य् उदक् संस्थानि कुर्व् इति सम्प्रेष्यति ।
text: He gives orders (to the barber with the words), 'Arrange his hair, his beard, the hair of his body, and his nails, ending in the north.'

sanskrit_iast: āplutya vāg yataḥ sthitvā ahaḥ śeṣam ācārya sakāśe vācam visṛjeta varam dadāmi iti |
meaning: आप्लुत्य वाग् यतः स्थित्वा अहः शेषम् आचार्य सकाशे वाचम् विसृजेत वरम् ददामि इति ।
text: Having bathed and silently stood during the rest of the day, let him break his silence in the presence of his teacher, (saying to him,) 'I give an optional gift (to thee).'

sanskrit_iast: gomithunam dakṣiṇā |
meaning: गोमिथुनम् दक्षिणा ।
text: An ox and a cow is the sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsaram ādiśet |
meaning: संवत्सरम् आदिशेत् ।
text: Let (the teacher) impose (on the youth the observances declared below) for one year.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭame varṣe brāhmaṇam upanayet |
meaning: अष्टमे वर्षे ब्राह्मणम् उपनयेत् ।
text: In the eighth year let him initiate a Brahmana,

sanskrit_iast: garbha aṣṭame vā |
meaning: गर्भ अष्टमे वा ।
text: Or in the eighth year after the conception;

sanskrit_iast: ekādaśe kṣatriyam |
meaning: एकादशे क्षत्रियम् ।
text: In the eleventh a Kshatriya;

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśe vaiśyam |
meaning: द्वादशे वैश्यम् ।
text: In the twelfth a Vaisya.

sanskrit_iast: ā ṣoḍaśād brāhmaṇasya anatītaḥ kālaḥ |
meaning: आ षोडशाद् ब्राह्मणस्य अनतीतः कालः ।
text: Until the sixteenth (year) the time has not passed for a Brahmana;

sanskrit_iast: ā dvāviṃśāt kṣatriyasya |
meaning: आ द्वाविंशात् क्षत्रियस्य ।
text: Until the twenty-second for a Kshatriya;

sanskrit_iast: ā caturviṃśād vaiṣyasya |
meaning: आ चतुर्विंशाद् वैष्यस्य ।
text: Until the twenty-fourth for a Vaisya.

sanskrit_iast: ata ūrdhvam patita sāvitrīkā bhavanti |
meaning: अत ऊर्ध्वम् पतित सावित्रीका भवन्ति ।
text: After that (time has passed), they become patitasavitrika (i.e. they have lost their right of learning the Savitri).

sanskrit_iast: na enān upanayen na adhyāpayen na yājayen na ebhi vyavahareyuḥ |
meaning: न एनान् उपनयेन् न अध्यापयेन् न याजयेन् न एभि व्यवहरेयुः ।
text: No one should initiate such men, nor teach them, nor perform sacrifices for them, nor have intercourse with them.

sanskrit_iast: alam kṛtam kumāram kuśalī kṛta śirasam ahatena vāsasā saṃvītam aiṇeyena vājinena brāhmaṇam rauraveṇa kṣatriyam ājena vaiśyam |
meaning: अलम् कृतम् कुमारम् कुशली कृत शिरसम् अहतेन वाससा संवीतम् ऐणेयेन वाजिनेन ब्राह्मणम् रौरवेण क्षत्रियम् आजेन वैश्यम् ।
text: (Let him initiate) the youth who is adorned and whose (hair on the) head is arranged, who wears a (new) garment that has not yet been washed, or an antelope-skin, if he is a Brahmana, the skin of a spotted deer, if a Kshatriya, a goat's skin, if a Vaisya.

sanskrit_iast: yadi vāsāṃsi vasīran raktāni vasīran kāṣāyam brāhmaṇo māṃjiṣṭham kṣatriyo hāridram vaiśyaḥ |
meaning: यदि वासांसि वसीरन् रक्तानि वसीरन् काषायम् ब्राह्मणो मांजिष्ठम् क्षत्रियो हारिद्रम् वैश्यः ।
text: If they put on garments, they should put on dyed (garments): the Brahmana a reddish yellow one, the Kshatriya a light red one, the Vaisya a yellow one.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām mekhalā mauñjī brāhmaṇasya dhanur jyā kṣatriyasya āvī vaiśyasya |
meaning: तेषाम् मेखला मौञ्जी ब्राह्मणस्य धनुर् ज्या क्षत्रियस्य आवी वैश्यस्य ।
text: Their girdles are: that of a Brahmana made of Munga grass, that of a Kshatriya a bow-string, that of a Vaisya woollen.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām daṇḍāḥ pālāśo brāhmaṇasya audumbaraḥ kṣatriyaḥ bailvo vaiśyasya |
meaning: तेषाम् दण्डाः पालाशो ब्राह्मणस्य औदुम्बरः क्षत्रियः बैल्वो वैश्यस्य ।
text: Their staffs are: that of a Brahmana of Palasa wood, that of a Kshatriya of Udumbara wood, that of a Vaisya of Bilva wood.

sanskrit_iast: sarve vā sarveṣām |
meaning: सर्वे वा सर्वेषाम् ।
text: Or all (sorts of staffs are to be used) by (men of) all (castes).

sanskrit_iast: samanvārabdhe hutvā uttarato agneḥ prān mukha ācāryo avatiṣṭhate |
meaning: समन्वारब्धे हुत्वा उत्तरतो अग्नेः प्रान् मुख आचार्यो अवतिष्ठते ।
text: While (the student) takes hold of him, the teacher sacrifices and then stations himself to the north of the fire, with his face turned to the east.

sanskrit_iast: purastāt pratyan mukha itaraḥ |
meaning: पुरस्तात् प्रत्यन् मुख इतरः ।
text: To the east (of the fire) with his face to the west the other one.

sanskrit_iast: apām añjalī pūrayitvā tat savitur vṛṇīmaha iti pūrṇena asya pūrṇam avakṣārayaty āsicya devasya tvā savituḥ prasave aśvinor bāhubhyām pūṣṇo hastābhyām hastam gṛhṇāmy asāv iti tasya pāṇinā pāṇim sāṅguṣṭham gṛhṇīyāt |
meaning: अपाम् अञ्जली पूरयित्वा तत् सवितुर् वृणीमह इति पूर्णेन अस्य पूर्णम् अवक्षारयत्य् आसिच्य देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे अश्विनोर् बाहुभ्याम् पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम् हस्तम् गृह्णाम्य् असाव् इति तस्य पाणिना पाणिम् साङ्गुष्ठम् गृह्णीयात् ।
text: (The teacher then) fills the two hollows of (his own and the student's) joined hands with water, and with the verse, 'That we choose of Savitri' (Rig-veda V, 82, 1) he makes with the full (hollow of his own hands the water) flow down on the full (hollow of) his, (i.e. the student's hands.) Having (thus) poured (the water over his hands) he should with his (own) hand seize his (i.e. the student's) hand together with the thumb, with (the formula), 'By the impulse of the god Savitri, with the arms of the two Asvins, with Pushan's hands I seize thy hand, N.N.!'

sanskrit_iast: savitā te hastam agrabhīd asāv iti dvitīyam |
meaning: सविता ते हस्तम् अग्रभीद् असाव् इति द्वितीयम् ।
text: With (the words), 'Savitri has seized thy hand, N.N.!' a second time.

sanskrit_iast: agnir ācāryas tava asāv iti tṛtīyam |
meaning: अग्निर् आचार्यस् तव असाव् इति तृतीयम् ।
text: With (the words), 'Agni is thy teacher, N.N.!' a third time.

sanskrit_iast: ādityam īkṣayed deva savitar eṣa te brahma cārī tam gopāya sa mā mṛta ity ācāryaḥ |
meaning: आदित्यम् ईक्षयेद् देव सवितर् एष ते ब्रह्म चारी तम् गोपाय स मा मृत इत्य् आचार्यः ।
text: He should cause him to look at the sun while the teacher says, 'God Savitri, this is thy Brahmakarin; protect him; may he not die.'

sanskrit_iast: kasya brahma cāry asi prāṇasya brahma cāry asi kas tvā kam upanayate kāya tvā paridadāmi iti |
meaning: कस्य ब्रह्म चार्य् असि प्राणस्य ब्रह्म चार्य् असि कस् त्वा कम् उपनयते काय त्वा परिददामि इति ।
text: (And further the teacher says), 'Whose Brahmakarin art thou? The breath's Brahmakarin art thou. Who does initiate thee, and whom (does he initiate)? To whom shall I give thee in charge?'

sanskrit_iast: yuvā suvāsāḥ parivīta āgād ity ardharcena enam pradakṣiṇam āvartayet |
meaning: युवा सुवासाः परिवीत आगाद् इत्य् अर्धर्चेन एनम् प्रदक्षिणम् आवर्तयेत् ।
text: With the half verse, 'A youth, well attired, dressed came hither' (Rig-veda III, 8, 4) he should cause him to turn round from the left to the right.

sanskrit_iast: tasya adhyaṃsau pāṇī kṛtvā hṛdaya deśam ālabheta uttareṇa |
meaning: तस्य अध्यंसौ पाणी कृत्वा हृदय देशम् आलभेत उत्तरेण ।
text: Reaching with his two hands over his (i.e. the student's) shoulders (the teacher) should touch the place of his heart with the following (half verse).

sanskrit_iast: agnim parisamuhya brahma cārī tūṣṇīm samidham ādadhyāt tūṣṇīm vai prājāpatyam prājāpatyo brahma cārī bhavati iti vijñāyate |
meaning: अग्निम् परिसमुह्य ब्रह्म चारी तूष्णीम् समिधम् आदध्यात् तूष्णीम् वै प्राजापत्यम् प्राजापत्यो ब्रह्म चारी भवति इति विज्ञायते ।
text: Having wiped the ground round the fire, the student should put on a piece of wood silently. 'Silence indeed is what belongs to Pragapati. The student becomes belonging to Pragapati'--this is understood (in the Sruti).

sanskrit_iast: mantreṇa ha eke agnaye samidham āhārṣam bṛhate jātavedase | tayā tvam agne vardhasva samidhā brahmaṇā vayam svāhā iti |
meaning: मन्त्रेण ह एके अग्नये समिधम् आहार्षम् बृहते जातवेदसे । तया त्वम् अग्ने वर्धस्व समिधा ब्रह्मणा वयम् स्वाहा इति ।
text: Some (do this) with a Mantra: 'To Agni I have brought a piece of wood, to the great Gatavedas. Through that piece of wood increase thou, O Agni; through the Brahman (may) we (increase). Svaha!'

sanskrit_iast: samidham ādhāya agnim upaspṛśya mukham nimārṣṭi tris tejasā mā samanajmi iti |
meaning: समिधम् आधाय अग्निम् उपस्पृश्य मुखम् निमार्ष्टि त्रिस् तेजसा मा समनज्मि इति ।
text: Having put the fuel (on the fire) and having touched the fire, he three times wipes off his face with (the words), 'With splendour I anoint myself.'

sanskrit_iast: tejasā hy eva ātmānam samanakti iti vijñāyate |
meaning: तेजसा ह्य् एव आत्मानम् समनक्ति इति विज्ञायते ।
text: 'For with splendour does he anoint himself'--this is understood (in the Sruti).

sanskrit_iast: mayi medhām mayi prajām mayy agnis tejo dadhātu | mayi medhām may prajām mayi indra indriyam dadhātu | mayi medhām mayi prajām mayi sūryo bhrājo dadhātu | yat te agne tejas tena aham tejasvī bhūyāsam | yat te agne varcas tena aham varcasvī bhūyāsam | yat te agne haras tena aham harasvatī bhūyāsam ity upasthāya jānv ācya upasaṃgṛhya brūyād adhīhi bho sāvitrīm bho anubrūhi iti |
meaning: मयि मेधाम् मयि प्रजाम् मय्य् अग्निस् तेजो दधातु । मयि मेधाम् मय् प्रजाम् मयि इन्द्र इन्द्रियम् दधातु । मयि मेधाम् मयि प्रजाम् मयि सूर्यो भ्राजो दधातु । यत् ते अग्ने तेजस् तेन अहम् तेजस्वी भूयासम् । यत् ते अग्ने वर्चस् तेन अहम् वर्चस्वी भूयासम् । यत् ते अग्ने हरस् तेन अहम् हरस्वती भूयासम् इत्य् उपस्थाय जान्व् आच्य उपसंगृह्य ब्रूयाद् अधीहि भो सावित्रीम् भो अनुब्रूहि इति ।
text: 'On me may Agni bestow insight, on me offspring, on me splendour. 'On me may Indra bestow insight, on me offspring, on me strength (indriya). 'On me may Surya bestow insight, on me offspring, on me radiance. 'What thy splendour is, Agni, may I thereby become resplendent. 'What thy vigour is, Agni, may I thereby become vigorous. 'What thy consuming power is, Agni, may I thereby obtain consuming power'--with (these formulas) he should approach the fire, bend his knee, embrace (the teacher's feet), and say to him, 'Recite, sir! The Savitri, sir, recite!'

sanskrit_iast: tasya vāsasā pāṇibhyām ca pāṇī saṃgṛhya sāvitrīm anvāha paccho ardharcaśaḥ sarvām |
meaning: तस्य वाससा पाणिभ्याम् च पाणी संगृह्य सावित्रीम् अन्वाह पच्छो अर्धर्चशः सर्वाम् ।
text: Seizing with his (i.e. the student's) garment and with (his own) hands (the student's) hands (the teacher) recites the Savitri, (firstly) Pada by Pada, (then) hemistich by hemistich, (and finally) the whole (verse).

sanskrit_iast: yathā śakti vācayīta |
meaning: यथा शक्ति वाचयीत ।
text: He should make him recite (the Savitri) as far as he is able.

sanskrit_iast: hṛdaya deśe asya ūrdhva aṅgulim pāṇim upadadhāti mama vrate hṛdayam te dadhāmi mama cittam anu cittam te astu | mama vācam eka vrato juṣasva bṛhaspatiṣ ṭvā niyunaktu mahyam iti |
meaning: हृदय देशे अस्य ऊर्ध्व अङ्गुलिम् पाणिम् उपदधाति मम व्रते हृदयम् ते दधामि मम चित्तम् अनु चित्तम् ते अस्तु । मम वाचम् एक व्रतो जुषस्व बृहस्पतिष् ट्वा नियुनक्तु मह्यम् इति ।
text: On the place of his (i.e. the student's) heart (the teacher) lays his hand with the fingers upwards, with (the formula), 'Into my will I take thy heart; after my mind shall thy mind follow; in my word thou shalt rejoice with all thy will; may Brihaspati join thee to me.'

sanskrit_iast: mekhalām ābadhya daṇḍam pradāya brahmacaryam ādiśet |
meaning: मेखलाम् आबध्य दण्डम् प्रदाय ब्रह्मचर्यम् आदिशेत् ।
text: Having tied the girdle round him and given him the staff, he should impose the (observances of the) Brahmakarya on him--

sanskrit_iast: brahma cāry asy apo aśāna karma kuru divā mā svāpsīr ācārya adhīno vedam adhīṣva iti |
meaning: ब्रह्म चार्य् अस्य् अपो अशान कर्म कुरु दिवा मा स्वाप्सीर् आचार्य अधीनो वेदम् अधीष्व इति ।
text: (With the words), 'A Brahmakarin thou art. Eat water. Do the service. Do not sleep in the day-time. Devoted to the teacher study the Veda.'

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśa varṣāṇi veda brahma caryam grahaṇa antam vā |
meaning: द्वादश वर्षाणि वेद ब्रह्म चर्यम् ग्रहण अन्तम् वा ।
text: Twelve years lasts the Brahmakarya for (each) Veda, or until he has learnt it.

sanskrit_iast: sāyam prātar bhikṣeta |
meaning: सायम् प्रातर् भिक्षेत ।
text: Let him beg (food) in the evening and in the morning.

sanskrit_iast: sāyam prātaḥ samidham ādadhyāt |
meaning: सायम् प्रातः समिधम् आदध्यात् ।
text: Let him put fuel on (the fire) in the evening and in the morning.

sanskrit_iast: apratyākhyāyinam agre bhikṣeta |
meaning: अप्रत्याख्यायिनम् अग्रे भिक्षेत ।
text: Let him beg first of a man who will not refuse,

sanskrit_iast: apratyākhyāyinīm vā |
meaning: अप्रत्याख्यायिनीम् वा ।
text: Or of a woman who will not refuse.

sanskrit_iast: bhavān bhikṣām dadātv iti |
meaning: भवान् भिक्षाम् ददात्व् इति ।
text: (In begging he should use the words), 'Sir, give food!'

sanskrit_iast: anupravacanīyam iti vā |
meaning: अनुप्रवचनीयम् इति वा ।
text: Or, '(Sir, give) Anupravakaniya (food).'

sanskrit_iast: tad ācāryāya vedayīta |
meaning: तद् आचार्याय वेदयीत ।
text: That (which he has received) he should announce to his teacher.

sanskrit_iast: tiṣṭhed ahaḥ śeṣam |
meaning: तिष्ठेद् अहः शेषम् ।
text: He should stand the rest of the day.

sanskrit_iast: astamite brahma odanam anupravacanīyam śrapayitvā ācāryāya vedayīta |
meaning: अस्तमिते ब्रह्म ओदनम् अनुप्रवचनीयम् श्रपयित्वा आचार्याय वेदयीत ।
text: After sunset (the student) should cook the Brahmaudana (or boiled rice with which the Brahmanas are to be fed) for the Anupravakaniya sacrifice (the sacrifice to be performed after a part of the Veda has been studied), and should announce to the teacher (that it is ready).

sanskrit_iast: ācāryaḥ samanvārabdhe juhuyāt sadasaspatim adbhutam iti |
meaning: आचार्यः समन्वारब्धे जुहुयात् सदसस्पतिम् अद्भुतम् इति ।
text: The teacher should sacrifice, while the student takes hold of him, with the verse, 'The wonderful lord of the abode' (Rig-Veda I, 18, 6).

sanskrit_iast: sāvitryā dvitīyam |
meaning: सावित्र्या द्वितीयम् ।
text: A second time with the Savitri--

sanskrit_iast: yad yat kim ca ata ūrdhvam anūktam syāt |
meaning: यद् यत् किम् च अत ऊर्ध्वम् अनूक्तम् स्यात् ।
text: And whatever else has been studied afterwards.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣibhyas tṛtīyam |
meaning: ऋषिभ्यस् तृतीयम् ।
text: A third time to the Rishis.

sanskrit_iast: sauviṣṭakṛtam caturtham |
meaning: सौविष्टकृतम् चतुर्थम् ।
text: A fourth time (the oblation) to (Agni) Svishtakrit.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā veda samāptim vācayīta |
meaning: ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा वेद समाप्तिम् वाचयीत ।
text: Having given food to the Brahmanas he should cause them to pronounce the end of the Veda (study).

sanskrit_iast: ata ūrdhvam akṣāra alavaṇa āśī brahma cāry adaḥ śāyī trirātram dvādaśa rātram saṃvatsarma vā |
meaning: अत ऊर्ध्वम् अक्षार अलवण आशी ब्रह्म चार्य् अदः शायी त्रिरात्रम् द्वादश रात्रम् संवत्सर्म वा ।
text: From that time (the student) should eat no saline food; he should observe chastity, and should sleep on the ground through three nights, or twelve nights, or one year.

sanskrit_iast: carita vratāya medhā jananam karoti |
meaning: चरित व्रताय मेधा जननम् करोति ।
text: When he has fulfilled those observances, (the teacher) performs (for him) the 'production of intelligence,' (in the following way):

sanskrit_iast: aninditāyām diśy eka mūlam palāśam kuśa stambam vā palāśa apacāre pradakṣiṇam uda kumbhena triḥ pariṣiṃcantam vācayati suśravaḥ suśravā asi yathā tvam suśravaḥ suśravā asy evam mām suśravaḥ sauśravasam kuru | yathā tvam devānām yajñasya nidhipo asy evam aham manuṣyāṇama vedasya nidhipo bhūyāsam iti |
meaning: अनिन्दितायाम् दिश्य् एक मूलम् पलाशम् कुश स्तम्बम् वा पलाश अपचारे प्रदक्षिणम् उद कुम्भेन त्रिः परिषिंचन्तम् वाचयति सुश्रवः सुश्रवा असि यथा त्वम् सुश्रवः सुश्रवा अस्य् एवम् माम् सुश्रवः सौश्रवसम् कुरु । यथा त्वम् देवानाम् यज्ञस्य निधिपो अस्य् एवम् अहम् मनुष्याणम वेदस्य निधिपो भूयासम् इति ।
text: While (the student) towards an unobjectionable direction (of the horizon) sprinkles thrice (water) from the left to the right with a water-pot round a [paragraph continues] Palasa (tree) with one root, or round a Kusa bunch, if there is no Palasa, (the teacher) causes him to say, 'O glorious one, thou art glorious. As thou, O glorious one, art glorious, thus, O glorious one, lead me to glory. As thou art the preserver of the treasure of sacrifice for the gods, thus may I become the preserver of the treasure of the Veda for men.'

sanskrit_iast: etena vāpana ādi paridāna antam vrata ādeśanam vyākhyātam |
meaning: एतेन वापन आदि परिदान अन्तम् व्रत आदेशनम् व्याख्यातम् ।
text: Thereby, beginning with his having the hair cut, and ending with the giving in charge, the imposing of observances has been declared.

sanskrit_iast: ity anupeta pūrvasya |
meaning: इत्य् अनुपेत पूर्वस्य ।
text: Thus for one who has not been initiated before.

sanskrit_iast: atha upeta pūrvasya |
meaning: अथ उपेत पूर्वस्य ।
text: Now as regards one who has been initiated before:

sanskrit_iast: kṛta akṛtam keśa vapanam |
meaning: कृत अकृतम् केश वपनम् ।
text: The cutting of the hair is optional,

sanskrit_iast: medhā jananam ca |
meaning: मेधा जननम् च ।
text: And the 'production of intelligence.'

sanskrit_iast: aniruktam paridānam |
meaning: अनिरुक्तम् परिदानम् ।
text: On the giving in charge there are no express rules (in this case);

sanskrit_iast: kālaś ca |
meaning: कालश् च ।
text: And on the time.

sanskrit_iast: tat savitur vṛṇīmaha iti sāvitrīm |
meaning: तत् सवितुर् वृणीमह इति सावित्रीम् ।
text: (He should recite to him) as the Savitri (the Rik),'That we choose of god Savitri' (Rig-veda V, 82, 1).

sanskrit_iast: ṛtvijo vṛṇīte anyūna anatirikta aṅgān ye mātṛtaḥ pitṛtaś ca it yathā uktam purastāt |
meaning: ऋत्विजो वृणीते अन्यून अनतिरिक्त अङ्गान् ये मातृतः पितृतश् च इत् यथा उक्तम् पुरस्तात् ।
