text: He chooses priests (for officiating at a sacrifice) with neither deficient nor superfluous limbs, 'who on the mother's and on the father's side (&c.),' as it has been said above.

sanskrit_iast: yūna ṛtvijo vṛṇīta ity eke |
meaning: यून ऋत्विजो वृणीत इत्य् एके ।
text: Let him choose young men as officiating priests: thus (declare) some (teachers).

sanskrit_iast: brahmāṇam eva prathamam vṛṇīte atha hotāram atha adhvaryum atha udgātāram |
meaning: ब्रह्माणम् एव प्रथमम् वृणीते अथ होतारम् अथ अध्वर्युम् अथ उद्गातारम् ।
text: He chooses first the Brahman, then the Hotri, then the Adhvaryu, then the Udgatri.

sanskrit_iast: sarvān vā ye ahīna ekāhair yājayanti |
meaning: सर्वान् वा ये अहीन एकाहैर् याजयन्ति ।
text: Or all who officiate at the Ahina sacrifices and at those lasting one day.

sanskrit_iast: sadasyam saptadaśam kauṣītakinaḥ samāmananti sa karmaṇām upadraṣṭā bhavati iti |
meaning: सदस्यम् सप्तदशम् कौषीतकिनः समामनन्ति स कर्मणाम् उपद्रष्टा भवति इति ।
text: The Kaushitakinas prescribe the Sadasya as the seventeenth, saying, 'He is the looker-on at the performances.'

sanskrit_iast: tad uktam ṛbhyām yam ṛtvijo bahudhā kalpayanta iti |
meaning: तद् उक्तम् ऋभ्याम् यम् ऋत्विजो बहुधा कल्पयन्त इति ।
text: This has been said in the two Rikas, 'He whom the officiating priests, performing (the sacrifice) in many ways' (Rig-veda VIII, 58, I. 2).

sanskrit_iast: hotāram eva prathamam vṛṇīte |
meaning: होतारम् एव प्रथमम् वृणीते ।
text: He chooses the Hotri first.

sanskrit_iast: agnir me hotā sa me hotā hotāram tvā amum vṛṇa iti hotāram |
meaning: अग्निर् मे होता स मे होता होतारम् त्वा अमुम् वृण इति होतारम् ।
text: With (the formula), 'Agni is my Hotri; he is my Hotri; I choose thee N.N. as my Hotri' (he chooses) the Hotri.

sanskrit_iast: candramā me brahmā sa me brahmā brahmāṇam tvā amum vṛṇa iti brāhmaṇam | ādityo me adhvaryur ity adhvaryum |
meaning: चन्द्रमा मे ब्रह्मा स मे ब्रह्मा ब्रह्माणम् त्वा अमुम् वृण इति ब्राह्मणम् । आदित्यो मे अध्वर्युर् इत्य् अध्वर्युम् ।

sanskrit_iast: parjanyo ma udgātā ity udgātāram |
meaning: पर्जन्यो म उद्गाता इत्य् उद्गातारम् ।
text: With (the formula), 'Parganya is my Udgatri; (he is my Udgatri, &c.)'--the Udgatri.

sanskrit_iast: āpo me hotra āśaṃsinya it hotrakān |
meaning: आपो मे होत्र आशंसिन्य इत् होत्रकान् ।
text: With (the formula), 'The waters are my reciters of what belongs to the Hotrakas'--the Hotrakas.

sanskrit_iast: raśmayo me camasa adhvaryava iti camasa adhvaryūn |
meaning: रश्मयो मे चमस अध्वर्यव इति चमस अध्वर्यून् ।
text: With (the formula), 'The rays are my Kamasadhvaryus'--the Kamasadhvaryus.

sanskrit_iast: ākāśo me sadasya iti sadasyam |
meaning: आकाशो मे सदस्य इति सदस्यम् ।
text: With (the formula), 'The ether is my Sadasya'--the Sadasya.

sanskrit_iast: sa vṛto japen mahan me avoco bhargo me avoco bhago me avoco yaśo me avocaḥ stomam me avocaḥ klṛptam me avoco bhuktim me avocas tṛptim me avocaḥ sarvam me avoca iti |
meaning: स वृतो जपेन् महन् मे अवोचो भर्गो मे अवोचो भगो मे अवोचो यशो मे अवोचः स्तोमम् मे अवोचः क्लृप्तम् मे अवोचो भुक्तिम् मे अवोचस् तृप्तिम् मे अवोचः सर्वम् मे अवोच इति ।
text: He whom he has chosen should murmur, 'A great thing thou hast told me; splendour thou hast told me; fortune thou hast told me; glory thou hast told me; praise thou hast told me; success thou hast told me; enjoyment thou hast told me; satiating thou hast told me; everything thou hast told me.'

sanskrit_iast: japitvā agniṣ ṭe hotā sa te hotā hotā aham te mānuṣa iti hotā pratijānīte |
meaning: जपित्वा अग्निष् टे होता स ते होता होता अहम् ते मानुष इति होता प्रतिजानीते ।
text: Having murmured (this formula), the Hotri declares his assent (in the words), 'Agni is thy Hotri; he is thy Hotri; thy human Hotri am I.'

sanskrit_iast: candramās te brahmā sa te brahmā brahmā |
meaning: चन्द्रमास् ते ब्रह्मा स ते ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मा ।
text: 'Kandramas (the moon) is thy Brahman; he is thy Brahman (&c.)'--thus the Brahman.

sanskrit_iast: evam itare yathā ādeśam |
meaning: एवम् इतरे यथा आदेशम् ।
text: In the same way the others according to the prescriptions (given above).

sanskrit_iast: tan mām avatu tan mā āviśatu tena bhukṣiṣīya iti ca yājayiṣyan |
meaning: तन् माम् अवतु तन् मा आविशतु तेन भुक्षिषीय इति च याजयिष्यन् ।
text: And if (the priest who accepts the invitation) is going to perform the sacrifice (for the inviting person, he should add), 'May that bless me; may that enter upon me; may I thereby enjoy (bliss).'

sanskrit_iast: nyastam ārtvijyam akāryam ahīnasya nīca dakṣiṇasya vyādhitasya āturasya yakṣma gṛhītasya anudeśy abhiśastasya kṣipta yonir iti ca eteṣām |
meaning: न्यस्तम् आर्त्विज्यम् अकार्यम् अहीनस्य नीच दक्षिणस्य व्याधितस्य आतुरस्य यक्ष्म गृहीतस्य अनुदेश्य् अभिशस्तस्य क्षिप्त योनिर् इति च एतेषाम् ।
text: The functions of an officiating priest are not to be exercised, if abandoned (by another priest), or at an Ahina sacrifice with small sacrificial fee, or for a person that is sick, or suffering, or affected with consumption, or decried among the people in his village, or of despised extraction: for such persons (the functions of a Ritvig should not be exercised).

sanskrit_iast: soma pravākam paripṛcchet ko yajñaḥ ka ṛtvijaḥ kā dakṣiṇā iti |
meaning: सोम प्रवाकम् परिपृच्छेत् को यज्ञः क ऋत्विजः का दक्षिणा इति ।
text: He (who is chosen as a Ritvig) should ask the Somapravaka, 'What sacrifice is it? Who are the priests officiating? What is the fee for the sacrifice?'

sanskrit_iast: kalyāṇaiḥ saha samprayogaḥ |
meaning: कल्याणैः सह सम्प्रयोगः ।
text: If (all the conditions) are favourable, he should accept.

sanskrit_iast: na māṃsam aśnīyur na striyam upeyu ā krator apavargāt |
meaning: न मांसम् अश्नीयुर् न स्त्रियम् उपेयु आ क्रतोर् अपवर्गात् ।
text: Let (the officiating priests) eat no flesh nor have intercourse with a wife until the completion of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: etena agne brahmaṇā vāvṛdhasva iti dakṣiṇa agnāv ājya āhutim hutvā yathā artham pravrajet |
meaning: एतेन अग्ने ब्रह्मणा वावृधस्व इति दक्षिण अग्नाव् आज्य आहुतिम् हुत्वा यथा अर्थम् प्रव्रजेत् ।
text: 'By this prayer, O Agni, increase' (Rig-veda I, 31, 18)--with (this verse) let him offer (at the end of the sacrifice) an oblation of Agya in (his own) Dakshinagni, and go away where he likes;

sanskrit_iast: evam anāhita agnir gṛhya imām agne śaraṇim mīmṛṣo na ity etayā ṛcā |
meaning: एवम् अनाहित अग्निर् गृह्य इमाम् अग्ने शरणिम् मीमृषो न इत्य् एतया ऋचा ।
text: In the same way one who has not set up the (Srauta) fires, in his (sacred) domestic fire with this Rik, 'Forgive us, O Agni, this sin' (Rig-veda I, 31, 16).

sanskrit_iast: ṛtvijo vṛtvā madhu parkam āharet |
meaning: ऋत्विजो वृत्वा मधु पर्कम् आहरेत् ।
text: When he has chosen the Ritvigas, he should offer the Madhuparka (i.e. honey-mixture) to them (in the way described in Sutras 5 and following);

sanskrit_iast: snātakāya upasthitāya |
meaning: स्नातकाय उपस्थिताय ।
text: To a Snataka, when he comes to his house;

sanskrit_iast: rājñe ca |
meaning: राज्ञे च ।
text: And to a king;

sanskrit_iast: ācārya śvaśura pitṛvya mātulānām ca |
meaning: आचार्य श्वशुर पितृव्य मातुलानाम् च ।
text: And for a teacher, the father-in-law, a paternal uncle, and a maternal uncle.

sanskrit_iast: dadhani madhv ānīya |
meaning: दधनि मध्व् आनीय ।
text: He pours honey into curds,

sanskrit_iast: sarpir vā madhv alābhe |
meaning: सर्पिर् वा मध्व् अलाभे ।
text: Or butter, if he can get no honey.

sanskrit_iast: viṣṭaraḥ pādyam arghyam ācamanīyam madhu parko gaur ity eteṣām tris trir eka ekam vedayante |
meaning: विष्टरः पाद्यम् अर्घ्यम् आचमनीयम् मधु पर्को गौर् इत्य् एतेषाम् त्रिस् त्रिर् एक एकम् वेदयन्ते ।
text: A seat, the water for washing the feet, the Arghya water (i.e. perfumed water into which flowers have been thrown), the water for sipping, the honey-mixture, a cow: every one of these things they announce three times (to the guest).

sanskrit_iast: aham varṣma sajātānām vidyutām iva sūryaḥ | idam tam adhitiṣṭhāmi yo mā kaśca abhidāsati ity udag agre viṣṭara upaviśet |
meaning: अहम् वर्ष्म सजातानाम् विद्युताम् इव सूर्यः । इदम् तम् अधितिष्ठामि यो मा कश्च अभिदासति इत्य् उदग् अग्रे विष्टर उपविशेत् ।
text: With (the verse), 'I am the highest one among my people, as the sun among the thunderbolts. Here I tread on him whosoever infests me'--he should sit down on the seat (made of) northward-pointed (grass).

sanskrit_iast: ākramya vā |
meaning: आक्रम्य वा ।
text: Or (he should do so) after he has trodden on it.

sanskrit_iast: pādau prakṣālāpayīta |
meaning: पादौ प्रक्षालापयीत ।
text: He should make (his host) wash his feet.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇam agre brahmaṇāya prayacchet |
meaning: दक्षिणम् अग्रे ब्रह्मणाय प्रयच्छेत् ।
text: The right foot he should stretch out first to a Brahmana,

sanskrit_iast: savyam śūdrāya |
meaning: सव्यम् शूद्राय ।
text: The left to a Sudra.

sanskrit_iast: prakṣālita pādo arghyam añjalinā pratigṛhya atha ācamanīyena ācāmaty amṛta upastaraṇam asi iti |
meaning: प्रक्षालित पादो अर्घ्यम् अञ्जलिना प्रतिगृह्य अथ आचमनीयेन आचामत्य् अमृत उपस्तरणम् असि इति ।
text: When his feet have been washed, he receives the Arghya water in the hollow of his joined hands and then sips the water destined thereto, with (the formula), 'Thou art the first layer for Ambrosia.'

sanskrit_iast: madhu parkam āhriyamāṇam īkṣate mitrasya tvā cakṣuṣā pratīkṣa iti |
meaning: मधु पर्कम् आह्रियमाणम् ईक्षते मित्रस्य त्वा चक्षुषा प्रतीक्ष इति ।
text: He looks at the Madhuparka when it is brought to him, with (the formula), 'I look at thee with Mitra's eye.'

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave aśvinor bāhubhyām pūṣṇo hastābhyām pratigṛhṇāmi iti tad añjalinā pratigṛhya savye pāṇau kṛtvā madhu vātā ṛtāyata iti tṛcena avekṣya anāmikayā ca aṅguṣṭhena ca triḥ pradakṣiṇam āloḍya vasavas tvā gāyatreṇa chandasā bhakṣayantv iti purastān nimārṣṭi |
meaning: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे अश्विनोर् बाहुभ्याम् पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम् प्रतिगृह्णामि इति तद् अञ्जलिना प्रतिगृह्य सव्ये पाणौ कृत्वा मधु वाता ऋतायत इति तृचेन अवेक्ष्य अनामिकया च अङ्गुष्ठेन च त्रिः प्रदक्षिणम् आलोड्य वसवस् त्वा गायत्रेण छन्दसा भक्षयन्त्व् इति पुरस्तान् निमार्ष्टि ।
text: He accepts it with his joined hands with (the formula), 'By the impulse of the god Savitri, with the arms of the two Asvins, with the hands of Pushan I accept thee.' He then takes it into his left hand, looks at it with the three verses, 'Honey the winds to the righteous one' (Rig-veda I, 90, 6 seqq.), stirs it about three times from left to right with the fourth finger and the thumb, and wipes (his fingers) with (the formula), 'May the Vasus eat thee with the Gayatri metre'--to the east;

sanskrit_iast: rudrās tvā traiṣṭubhena chandasā bhakṣayantv iti dakṣiṇataḥ |
meaning: रुद्रास् त्वा त्रैष्टुभेन छन्दसा भक्षयन्त्व् इति दक्षिणतः ।
text: With (the formula), 'May the Rudras eat thee with the Trishtubh metre'--to the south;

sanskrit_iast: ādityās tvā jāgatena chandasā bhakṣayantv iti paścāt |
meaning: आदित्यास् त्वा जागतेन छन्दसा भक्षयन्त्व् इति पश्चात् ।
text: With (the formula), 'May the Adityas eat thee with the Gagati metre'--to the west;

sanskrit_iast: viśve tvā devā ānuṣṭubhena chandasā bhakṣayantv ity uttarataḥ |
meaning: विश्वे त्वा देवा आनुष्टुभेन छन्दसा भक्षयन्त्व् इत्य् उत्तरतः ।
text: With (the formula), 'May the Visve devas eat thee with the Anushtubh metre'--to the north.

sanskrit_iast: bhūtebhyas tvā iti madhyāt trir udgṛhya |
meaning: भूतेभ्यस् त्वा इति मध्यात् त्रिर् उद्गृह्य ।
text: With (the formula), 'To the beings thee'--he three times takes (some of the Madhuparka substance) out of the middle of it.

sanskrit_iast: virājo doho asi iti prathamam prāśnīyāt |
meaning: विराजो दोहो असि इति प्रथमम् प्राश्नीयात् ।
text: With (the formula), 'The milk of Virag art thou'--he should partake thereof the first time,

sanskrit_iast: virājo doham aśīya iti dvitīyam |
meaning: विराजो दोहम् अशीय इति द्वितीयम् ।
text: With, 'The milk of Virag may I obtain'--the second time,

sanskrit_iast: mayi dohaḥ padyāyai virāja iti tṛtīyam |
meaning: मयि दोहः पद्यायै विराज इति तृतीयम् ।
text: With, 'In me (may) the milk of Padya Virag (dwell)'--the third time.

sanskrit_iast: na sarvam |
meaning: न सर्वम् ।
text: (He should) not (eat) the whole (Madhuparka).

sanskrit_iast: na tṛptim gacchet |
meaning: न तृप्तिम् गच्छेत् ।
text: He should not satiate himself.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇāya udan ucchiṣṭam prayacchet |
meaning: ब्राह्मणाय उदन् उच्छिष्टम् प्रयच्छेत् ।
text: To a Brahmana, to the north, he should give the remainder.

sanskrit_iast: alābhe apsu |
meaning: अलाभे अप्सु ।
text: If that cannot be done, (he should throw it) into water.

sanskrit_iast: sarvam vā |
meaning: सर्वम् वा ।
text: Or (he may eat) the whole (Madhuparka).

sanskrit_iast: atha ācamanīyena anvācāmaty amṛta apidhānam asi iti |
meaning: अथ आचमनीयेन अन्वाचामत्य् अमृत अपिधानम् असि इति ।
text: He then makes a rinsing of his mouth follow (on the eating of the Madhuparka) with the water destined thereto, with (the formula), 'Thou art the covering of Ambrosia.'

sanskrit_iast: satyam yaśaḥ śrīr mayi śrīḥ śrayatām iti dvitīyam |
meaning: सत्यम् यशः श्रीर् मयि श्रीः श्रयताम् इति द्वितीयम् ।
text: With (the formula), 'Truth! Glory! Fortune! May fortune rest on me!'--a second time.

sanskrit_iast: ācānta udakāya gām vedayante |
meaning: आचान्त उदकाय गाम् वेदयन्ते ।
text: When he has sipped water, they announce to him the cow.

sanskrit_iast: hato me pāpmā pāpmā me hata it japitvīm kṛruta iti kārayiṣyan |
meaning: हतो मे पाप्मा पाप्मा मे हत इत् जपित्वीम् कृरुत इति कारयिष्यन् ।
text: Having murmured, 'Destroyed is my sin; my sin is destroyed,' (he says,) 'Om, do it,' if he chooses to have her killed.

sanskrit_iast: mātā rudrāṇām duhitā vasūnām iti japitvom utsṛjata ity utsrakṣyan |
meaning: माता रुद्राणाम् दुहिता वसूनाम् इति जपित्वोम् उत्सृजत इत्य् उत्स्रक्ष्यन् ।
text: Having murmured, 'The mother of the Rudras, the daughter of the Vasus' (Rig-veda VIII, 101, 15), [paragraph continues] (he says,) 'Om, let her loose,' if he chooses to let her loose.

sanskrit_iast: na amāṃso madhu parko bhavati bhavati |
meaning: न अमांसो मधु पर्को भवति भवति ।
text: Let the Madhuparka not be without flesh, without flesh.

sanskrit_iast: śrāvaṇyām paurṇamāsyām śravaṇā karma |
meaning: श्रावण्याम् पौर्णमास्याम् श्रवणा कर्म ।
text: On the full moon day of the Sravana month the Sravana ceremony (is performed).

sanskrit_iast: akṣata saktūnām navam kalaśam pūrayitvā darvīm ca bali haraṇīm nave śikye nidadhāti |
meaning: अक्षत सक्तूनाम् नवम् कलशम् पूरयित्वा दर्वीम् च बलि हरणीम् नवे शिक्ये निदधाति ।
text: Having filled a new jug with flour of fried barley, he lays (this jug) and a spoon for offering the Balis on new strings of a carrying pole (and thus suspends them).

sanskrit_iast: akṣata dhānāḥ kṛtvā sarpiṣa ardhā anakti |
meaning: अक्षत धानाः कृत्वा सर्पिष अर्धा अनक्ति ।
text: Having prepared fried barley grains, he smears half of them with butter.

sanskrit_iast: astamite sthālī pākam śrapayitvā eka kapālam ca puroḷāśam agne naya supathā rāye asmān iti catasṛbhiḥ pratyṛcam hutvā pāṇinā eka kapālam acyutāya bhaumāya svāhā iti |
meaning: अस्तमिते स्थाली पाकम् श्रपयित्वा एक कपालम् च पुरोऌआशम् अग्ने नय सुपथा राये अस्मान् इति चतसृभिः प्रत्यृचम् हुत्वा पाणिना एक कपालम् अच्युताय भौमाय स्वाहा इति ।
text: After sunset he prepares a mess of cooked food and a cake in one dish and sacrifices (the cooked food) with the four verses, 'Agni, lead us on a good path to wealth' (Rig-veda I, 189, 1 seqq.), verse by verse, and with his hand the (cake) in one dish with (the formula), 'To the steady One, the earth-demon, svaha!'

sanskrit_iast: avaplutaḥ syād āviḥ pṛṣṭho vā |
meaning: अवप्लुतः स्याद् आविः पृष्ठो वा ।
text: (The cake) should be (entirely) immersed (into the butter), or its back should be visible.

sanskrit_iast: mā no agne avasṛjo aghāya ity enam āśayena abhijuhoti |
meaning: मा नो अग्ने अवसृजो अघाय इत्य् एनम् आशयेन अभिजुहोति ।
text: With (the verse), 'Agni, do not deliver us to evil' (Rig-veda I, 189, 5) he sacrifices over it (the butter) in which it had lain.

sanskrit_iast: śam no bhavantu vājino haviṣvā ity aktā dhānā añjalinā |
meaning: शम् नो भवन्तु वाजिनो हविष्वा इत्य् अक्ता धाना अञ्जलिना ।
text: With (the verse), 'May the steeds at our invocation be for a blessing to us' (Rig-veda VII, 38, 7) (he sacrifices) the besmeared grains with his joined hands,

sanskrit_iast: amātyebhya itarā dadyāt |
meaning: अमात्येभ्य इतरा दद्यात् ।
text: The other (grains) he should give to his people.

sanskrit_iast: kalaśāt saktūnām darvīm pūrayitvā prāg upaniṣkramya śucau deśe apo avaninīya sarva deva janebhyaḥ svāhā iti hutvā namas karoti ye sarpāḥ pārthivā ye antarikṣyā ye divyā ye diśyās tebhya imam balim āhārṣam tebhya imam balim upākaromi iti |
meaning: कलशात् सक्तूनाम् दर्वीम् पूरयित्वा प्राग् उपनिष्क्रम्य शुचौ देशे अपो अवनिनीय सर्व देव जनेभ्यः स्वाहा इति हुत्वा नमस् करोति ये सर्पाः पार्थिवा ये अन्तरिक्ष्या ये दिव्या ये दिश्यास् तेभ्य इमम् बलिम् आहार्षम् तेभ्य इमम् बलिम् उपाकरोमि इति ।
text: Out of the jug he fills the spoon with flour, goes out (of the house) to the east, pours water on the ground on a clean spot, sacrifices with (the formula), 'To the divine hosts of the serpents svaha!' and does reverence to them with (the formula), 'The serpents which are terrestrial, which are aerial, which are celestial, which dwell in the directions (of the horizon)--to them I have brought this Bali; to them I give over this Bali.'

sanskrit_iast: pradakṣiṇam parītya paścād baler upaviśya sarpo asi sarpatām sarpāṇām adhipatir asy annena manuṣyāṃs trāyase apūpena sarpān yajñena devāṃs tvayi mā santam tvayi santaḥ sarpā mā hiṃsiṣur dhruva amum te paridadāmi |
meaning: प्रदक्षिणम् परीत्य पश्चाद् बलेर् उपविश्य सर्पो असि सर्पताम् सर्पाणाम् अधिपतिर् अस्य् अन्नेन मनुष्यांस् त्रायसे अपूपेन सर्पान् यज्ञेन देवांस् त्वयि मा सन्तम् त्वयि सन्तः सर्पा मा हिंसिषुर् ध्रुव अमुम् ते परिददामि ।
text: Having gone round (the Bali) from left to right, he sits down to the west of the Bali with (the words), 'The serpent art thou; the lord of the creeping serpents art thou; by food thou protectest men, by cake the serpents, by sacrifice the gods. To me, being in thee, the serpents being in thee should do no harm. I give over the firm one (i.e. the spoon) to thee.'

sanskrit_iast: dhruva amum te dhruva amum ta ity amātyān anupūrvam |
meaning: ध्रुव अमुम् ते ध्रुव अमुम् त इत्य् अमात्यान् अनुपूर्वम् ।
text: 'Firm one, (I give) N.N. (in charge) to thee! Firm one, (I give) N.N. (in charge) to thee!'--with (these words he gives) his people, man by man, (in charge to the serpent god);

sanskrit_iast: dhruva mām te paridadāmi ity ātmānam antataḥ |
meaning: ध्रुव माम् ते परिददामि इत्य् आत्मानम् अन्ततः ।
text: 'Firm one, I give myself in charge to thee!'--with these words himself at the end.

sanskrit_iast: na enam antarā vyaveyur ā paridānāt |
meaning: न एनम् अन्तरा व्यवेयुर् आ परिदानात् ।
text: Let no one step between it (i.e. the Bali, and the sacrificer), until the giving in charge has been performed.

sanskrit_iast: sarpa deva janebhyaḥ svāhā iti sāyam prātar balim hared ā pratyavarohaṇāt |
meaning: सर्प देव जनेभ्यः स्वाहा इति सायम् प्रातर् बलिम् हरेद् आ प्रत्यवरोहणात् ।
text: With (the formula), 'To the divine hosts of the serpents svaha!'--let him offer the Bali in the evening and in the morning, till the Pratyavarohana (i.e. the ceremony of the 'redescent').

sanskrit_iast: prasaṃkhyāya ha eke tāvato balīṃs tad ahar eva upaharanti |
meaning: प्रसंख्याय ह एके तावतो बलींस् तद् अहर् एव उपहरन्ति ।
text: Some count (the days till the Pratyavarohana) and offer the corresponding number of Balis already on that day (on which the Sravana ceremony is performed).

sanskrit_iast: āśvayujyām āśvayujī karma |
meaning: आश्वयुज्याम् आश्वयुजी कर्म ।
text: On the full moon day of Asvayuga the Asvayugi ceremony (is performed).

sanskrit_iast: niveśanam alam kṛtya snātāḥ śuci vāsasaḥ paśu pataye sthālī pākam nirupya juhuyuḥ paśu pataye śivāya śaṃkarāya pṛṣātakāya svāhā iti |
meaning: निवेशनम् अलम् कृत्य स्नाताः शुचि वाससः पशु पतये स्थाली पाकम् निरुप्य जुहुयुः पशु पतये शिवाय शंकराय पृषातकाय स्वाहा इति ।
text: Having adorned the house, having bathed and put on clean garments, they should pour out a mess of cooked food for Pasupati, and should sacrifice it with (the formula), To Pasupati, to Siva, to Samkara, to Prishataka svaha!'

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣātakam añjalinā juhuyād enam me pūryatām pūrṇam me mā upasadat pṛṣātakāya svāhā iti |
meaning: पृषातकम् अञ्जलिना जुहुयाद् एनम् मे पूर्यताम् पूर्णम् मे मा उपसदत् पृषातकाय स्वाहा इति ।
text: He should sacrifice with his joined hands a mixture of curds and butter (prishataka) with (the formula), 'May what is deficient be made full to me; may what is full not decay to me. To Prishataka svaha!'

sanskrit_iast: sajūr ṛtubhiḥ sajūr vidhābhiḥ sajūr indra agnibhyām svāhā | sajūr ṛtubhiḥ sajūr vidhābhiḥ sajūr dyāvā pṛthivībhyām svāhā ity āhita agner āgrayaṇa sthālī pākaḥ |
meaning: सजूर् ऋतुभिः सजूर् विधाभिः सजूर् इन्द्र अग्निभ्याम् स्वाहा । सजूर् ऋतुभिः सजूर् विधाभिः सजूर् द्यावा पृथिवीभ्याम् स्वाहा इत्य् आहित अग्नेर् आग्रयण स्थाली पाकः ।
text: 'United with the seasons, united with the manners, united with Indra and Agni, svaha! 'United with the seasons, united with the manners, united with the Visve devas, svaha! 'United with the seasons, united with the manners, united with Heaven and Earth, svaha!'--with (these formulas) a mess of cooked food is offered at the [paragraph continues] Agrayana sacrifice by one who has set up the (sacred Srauta) fires.

sanskrit_iast: anāhita agner api śāla agnau |
meaning: अनाहित अग्नेर् अपि शाल अग्नौ ।
text: Also by one who has not set up the (Srauta) fires (the same offering is performed) in the (sacred) domestic fire.

sanskrit_iast: mārgaśīrṣyām pratyavarohaṇam caturdaśyām |
meaning: मार्गशीर्ष्याम् प्रत्यवरोहणम् चतुर्दश्याम् ।
text: On the full moon of Margasirsha the 'redescent' (is performed)--on the fourteenth (Tithi),

sanskrit_iast: paurṇamāsyām vā |
meaning: पौर्णमास्याम् वा ।
text: Or on (the Tithi of) the full moon (itself).

sanskrit_iast: niveśanam punar navī kṛtya lepana staraṇa upastaraṇair astamite pāyasasya juhuyur apa śveta padā jahi pūrveṇa ca apareṇa ca | sapta ca vāruṇīr imāḥ sarvāś ca rāja bāndhavīḥ svāhā || na vai śvetaś ca abhyāgāre ahir jaghāna kiṃcana | śvetāya vaidārvāya namaḥ svāhā iti |
meaning: निवेशनम् पुनर् नवी कृत्य लेपन स्तरण उपस्तरणैर् अस्तमिते पायसस्य जुहुयुर् अप श्वेत पदा जहि पूर्वेण च अपरेण च । सप्त च वारुणीर् इमाः सर्वाश् च राज बान्धवीः स्वाहा ॥ न वै श्वेतश् च अभ्यागारे अहिर् जघान किंचन । श्वेताय वैदार्वाय नमः स्वाहा इति ।
text: Having again renovated the house by (giving a new) coating (to the walls), by spreading out (a new roof), and by levelling (the floor), they should sacrifice after sunset (oblations) of milk-rice with (the texts), 'Beat away, O white one, with thy foot, with the forefoot and with the hind-foot, these seven daughters of Varuna and all that belong to the king's tribe. Svaha! 'Within the dominion of the white one no serpent has killed anything. To the white one, the son of Vidarva, adoration! Svaha!'

sanskrit_iast: na atra sauviṣṭakṛt |
meaning: न अत्र सौविष्टकृत् ।
text: Here no oblation to (Agni) Svishtakrit (is made).

sanskrit_iast: abhayam naḥ prājāpatyebhyo bhūyād ity agnim īkṣamāṇo japati |
meaning: अभयम् नः प्राजापत्येभ्यो भूयाद् इत्य् अग्निम् ईक्षमाणो जपति ।
text: 'May we be secure from Pragapati's sons'--thus he murmurs while looking at the fire.

sanskrit_iast: śivo naḥ sumanā bhava iti hemantam manasā dhyāyāt |
meaning: शिवो नः सुमना भव इति हेमन्तम् मनसा ध्यायात् ।
text: (Saying), 'Be happy and friendly to us'--he should think in his mind of the winter.

sanskrit_iast: paścād agneḥ svastaraḥ svāstīrṇas tasminn upaviśya syonā pṛhivi bhava iti japitvā saṃviśet sāmātyaḥ prāk śirā udan mukhaḥ |
meaning: पश्चाद् अग्नेः स्वस्तरः स्वास्तीर्णस् तस्मिन्न् उपविश्य स्योना पृहिवि भव इति जपित्वा संविशेत् सामात्यः प्राक् शिरा उदन् मुखः ।
text: To the west of the fire is a well-spread layer (of straw); on that he should sit down, murmur (the verse), 'Be soft, O earth' (Rig-veda I, 22, 15), and lie down (on that layer) with his people, with the head to the east and the face to the north.

sanskrit_iast: yathā avakāśam itare |
meaning: यथा अवकाशम् इतरे ।
text: The others, as there is room.

sanskrit_iast: jyāyām jyāyān vā anantaraḥ |
meaning: ज्यायाम् ज्यायान् वा अनन्तरः ।
text: Or following on each other from the eldest to the youngest.

sanskrit_iast: mantravido mantrān japeyuḥ |
meaning: मन्त्रविदो मन्त्रान् जपेयुः ।
text: Those who know the Mantras, should murmur the Mantras.

sanskrit_iast: saṃhāya ato devā avantu na iti triḥ |
meaning: संहाय अतो देवा अवन्तु न इति त्रिः ।
text: Arising (they should) three times (murmur the verse), 'From that place may the gods bless us' (Rig-veda I, 22, 16).

sanskrit_iast: etām dakṣiṇā mukhāḥ pratyan mukhā udan mukhāś caturtham |
meaning: एताम् दक्षिणा मुखाः प्रत्यन् मुखा उदन् मुखाश् चतुर्थम् ।
text: The same (verse) a fourth time with their faces to the south, to the west, and to the north.

sanskrit_iast: saṃhāya sauryāṇi svastyayanāni ca japitvā annam saṃskṛtya brāhmān bhojayitvā svastyayanam vācayīta |
meaning: संहाय सौर्याणि स्वस्त्ययनानि च जपित्वा अन्नम् संस्कृत्य ब्राह्मान् भोजयित्वा स्वस्त्ययनम् वाचयीत ।
text: Having arisen, having murmured the hymns sacred to the Sun and the auspicious hymns, having prepared food and given to the Brahmanas to eat, he should cause (them) to pronounce auspicious words.

sanskrit_iast: hemanta śiśirayoś caturṇām apara pakṣāṇām aṣṭamīṣv aṣṭakāḥ |
meaning: हेमन्त शिशिरयोश् चतुर्णाम् अपर पक्षाणाम् अष्टमीष्व् अष्टकाः ।
text: On the eighth days of the four dark fortnights of (the two seasons of) winter and Sisira the Ashtakas (are celebrated).

sanskrit_iast: ekasyām vā |
meaning: एकस्याम् वा ।
text: Or on one (of these days).

sanskrit_iast: pūrve dyuḥ pitṛbhyo dadyāt |
meaning: पूर्वे द्युः पितृभ्यो दद्यात् ।
text: The day before, he should offer to the Fathers (i.e. Manes)--

sanskrit_iast: odanam kṛsaram pāyasam |
meaning: ओदनम् कृसरम् पायसम् ।
text: Boiled rice, boiled rice with sesamum seeds, rice-milk--

sanskrit_iast: catuḥ śarāvasya vā apūpān |
meaning: चतुः शरावस्य वा अपूपान् ।
text: Or cakes made of four Saravas (of ground grain)--

sanskrit_iast: udīratām avara utparāsa ity aṣṭābhir hutvā yāvatībhir vā kāmayīta |
meaning: उदीरताम् अवर उत्परास इत्य् अष्टाभिर् हुत्वा यावतीभिर् वा कामयीत ।
text: Sacrificing with the eight (verses), 'May the lower (Fathers) and the higher arise' (Rig-veda X, 15, 1 seqq.), or with as many (verses) as he likes.

sanskrit_iast: atha śvo bhūte aṣṭakāḥ paśunā sthālī pākena ca |
meaning: अथ श्वो भूते अष्टकाः पशुना स्थाली पाकेन च ।
text: Then on the next day the Ashtakas (are celebrated) with an animal (sacrifice) and with a mess of cooked food.

sanskrit_iast: apy anaḍuho yavasam āharet |
meaning: अप्य् अनडुहो यवसम् आहरेत् ।
text: He may also give grass to an ox,

sanskrit_iast: agninā vā kakṣam upoṣet |
meaning: अग्निना वा कक्षम् उपोषेत् ।
text: Or he may burn down brushwood with fire--

sanskrit_iast: eṣā me aṣṭakā iti |
meaning: एषा मे अष्टका इति ।
text: With (the words), 'This is my Ashtaka.'

sanskrit_iast: na tv eva anaṣṭakaḥ syāt |
meaning: न त्व् एव अनष्टकः स्यात् ।
text: But he should not omit celebrating the Ashtaka.

sanskrit_iast: tām ha eke vaiśvadevīm bruvata āgneyīm eke sauryām eke prājāpatyām eke rātri devatām eke nakṣatra devatām eka ṛtu devatām eke pitṛ devatām eke paśu devatām eke |
meaning: ताम् ह एके वैश्वदेवीम् ब्रुवत आग्नेयीम् एके सौर्याम् एके प्राजापत्याम् एके रात्रि देवताम् एके नक्षत्र देवताम् एक ऋतु देवताम् एके पितृ देवताम् एके पशु देवताम् एके ।
text: This (Ashtaka) some state to be sacred to the Visve devas, some to Agni, some to the Sun, some to Pragapati, some state that the Night is its deity, some that the Nakshatras are, some that the Seasons are, some that the Fathers are, some that cattle is.

sanskrit_iast: paśu kalpena paśum saṃjñapya prokṣaṇa upākaraṇa varjam vapām utkhidya juhuyād vaha vapām jāta vedaḥ pitṛbhyo yatra etān vettha nihitān pakāre | medasaḥ kulyā upa enānt sravantu satyā etā āśiṣaḥ santu sarvāḥ svāhā iti |
meaning: पशु कल्पेन पशुम् संज्ञप्य प्रोक्षण उपाकरण वर्जम् वपाम् उत्खिद्य जुहुयाद् वह वपाम् जात वेदः पितृभ्यो यत्र एतान् वेत्थ निहितान् पकारे । मेदसः कुल्या उप एनान्त् स्रवन्तु सत्या एता आशिषः सन्तु सर्वाः स्वाहा इति ।
text: Having killed the animal according to the ritual of the animal sacrifice, omitting the sprinkling (with water) and the touching of the animal with a fresh branch, he should draw out the omentum and sacrifice it with (the verse), 'Carry the omentum, Gatavedas, to the Fathers, where thou knowest them resting afar. May streams of fat flow to them; may all these wishes be fulfilled. Svaha!'

sanskrit_iast: ataḥ avadānānām sthālī pākasya ca agne naya supathā rāye asmān iti dve | grīṣmo hemanta ṛtavaḥ śivā no varṣāḥ śivā abhavā śaran naḥ | saṃvatsaro adhipatiḥ prāṇado no ahorātre kṛṇutām dūrgham āyuḥ svāhā | śāntā pṛthivī śivam antarikṣam dyaur no devy abhayam no astu | śivā diśaḥ pradiśa uddiśo na āpo vidyutaḥ paripāntu sarvataḥ svāhā | āpo marīcīḥ pravahantu no dhiyo dhātā samudro avahantu pāpam | bhūtam bhaviṣyad abhayam viśvam astu me brahma adhig uptaḥ svāra akṣarāṇi svāhā | viśva ādityā vasavaś ca devā rudrā goptāro marutaḥ saṃdantu | ūrjam prajām amṛtam pinvamānaḥ prajāpatir mayi parameṣṭhī dadhātu svāhā | prajāpate na tvad etāny anyaḥ |
meaning: अतः अवदानानाम् स्थाली पाकस्य च अग्ने नय सुपथा राये अस्मान् इति द्वे । ग्रीष्मो हेमन्त ऋतवः शिवा नो वर्षाः शिवा अभवा शरन् नः । संवत्सरो अधिपतिः प्राणदो नो अहोरात्रे कृणुताम् दूर्घम् आयुः स्वाहा । शान्ता पृथिवी शिवम् अन्तरिक्षम् द्यौर् नो देव्य् अभयम् नो अस्तु । शिवा दिशः प्रदिश उद्दिशो न आपो विद्युतः परिपान्तु सर्वतः स्वाहा । आपो मरीचीः प्रवहन्तु नो धियो धाता समुद्रो अवहन्तु पापम् । भूतम् भविष्यद् अभयम् विश्वम् अस्तु मे ब्रह्म अधिग् उप्तः स्वार अक्षराणि स्वाहा । विश्व आदित्या वसवश् च देवा रुद्रा गोप्तारो मरुतः संदन्तु । ऊर्जम् प्रजाम् अमृतम् पिन्वमानः प्रजापतिर् मयि परमेष्ठी दधातु स्वाहा । प्रजापते न त्वद् एतान्य् अन्यः ।
text: Then (follow oblations) of the Avadana portions and the cooked food, two with (the two verses), 'Agni, lead us on a good path to wealth' (Rig-veda I, 189, 1 seq.), (and other oblations with the texts), 'May summer, winter, the seasons be happy to us, happy the rainy season, safe to us the autumn. The year be our lord who gives breath to us; may days and nights produce long life. Svaha! 'Peaceful be the earth, happy the air, may the goddess Heaven give us safety. Happy be the quarters (of the horizon), the intermediate quarters, the upper quarters; may the waters, the lightnings protect us from all sides. Svaha! 'May the waters, the rays carry our prayers (to the gods); may the creator, may the ocean turn away evil; may the past and the future, (may) all be safe to me. Protected by Brahman may I pour forth songs. Svaha! 'May all the Adityas and the divine Vasus, the Rudras, the protectors, the Maruts sit down (here). May Pragapati, the abounding one, the highest ruler, bestow vigour, offspring, immortality on me. Svaha! 'Pragapati, no other one than Thou (Rig-veda X, 121, 10).'

sanskrit_iast: sauviṣṭakṛty aṣṭamī |
meaning: सौविष्टकृत्य् अष्टमी ।
text: The eighth (oblation) is that to (Agni) Svishtakrit.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇān bhojayed ity uktam |
meaning: ब्राह्मणान् भोजयेद् इत्य् उक्तम् ।
text: He should give to the Brahmanas to eat: this has been said.

sanskrit_iast: apare dyur anvaṣṭakyam |
meaning: अपरे द्युर् अन्वष्टक्यम् ।
text: On the following day the Anvashtakya (i.e. the ceremony following the Ashtaka, is performed).

sanskrit_iast: tasya eva māṃsasya prakalpya dakṣiṇā pravaṇe agnim upasamādhāya pariśritya uttarataḥ pariśritasya dvāram kṛtvā samūlam barhis trir apasalair avidhūnvan paristīrya havīṃṣy āsādayed odanam kṛsaram pāyasam dadhi manthān madhu manthāṃś ca |
meaning: तस्य एव मांसस्य प्रकल्प्य दक्षिणा प्रवणे अग्निम् उपसमाधाय परिश्रित्य उत्तरतः परिश्रितस्य द्वारम् कृत्वा समूलम् बर्हिस् त्रिर् अपसलैर् अविधून्वन् परिस्तीर्य हवींष्य् आसादयेद् ओदनम् कृसरम् पायसम् दधि मन्थान् मधु मन्थांश् च ।
text: Having prepared (a portion) of that same meat, having established the fire on a surface inclined towards the south, having fenced it in, and made a door on the north side of the enclosure, having strewn round (the fire) three times sacrificial grass with its roots, without tossing it, turning the left side towards the fire, he should put down the things to be offered, boiled rice, boiled rice with sesamum seeds, rice-milk, meal-pap with curds, and meal-pap with honey.

sanskrit_iast: piṇḍa pitṛ yajña kalpena |
meaning: पिण्ड पितृ यज्ञ कल्पेन ।
text: (The ceremony should be performed) according to the ritual of the Pindapitriyagna.

sanskrit_iast: hutvā madhu mantha varjam pitṛbhyo dadyāt |
meaning: हुत्वा मधु मन्थ वर्जम् पितृभ्यो दद्यात् ।
text: Having sacrificed (of those sorts of food) with the exception of the meal-pap with honey, let him give (lumps of those substances) to the Fathers.

sanskrit_iast: strībhyaś ca surā ca ācāmam ity adhikam |
meaning: स्त्रीभ्यश् च सुरा च आचामम् इत्य् अधिकम् ।
text: And to (their) wives, with the addition of rum and the scum of boiled rice.

sanskrit_iast: karṣūṣv eke dvayoḥ ṣaṭsu vā |
meaning: कर्षूष्व् एके द्वयोः षट्सु वा ।
text: Some (place the lumps to be offered) into pits, into two or into six:

sanskrit_iast: pūrvāsu pitṛbhyo dadyāt |
meaning: पूर्वासु पितृभ्यो दद्यात् ।
text: In those situated to the east he should give (the offerings) to the Fathers.

sanskrit_iast: aparāsu strībhyaḥ |
meaning: अपरासु स्त्रीभ्यः ।
text: In those to the west, to the wives.

sanskrit_iast: etena māghya āvarṣam proṣṭhapadyā apara pakṣe |
meaning: एतेन माघ्य आवर्षम् प्रोष्ठपद्या अपर पक्षे ।
text: Thereby the ceremony celebrated in the rainy season on the Magha day, in the dark fortnight after the full moon of Praushthapada (has been declared).

sanskrit_iast: māsi māsi ca evam pitṛbhyo ayukṣu pratiṣṭhāpayet |
meaning: मासि मासि च एवम् पितृभ्यो अयुक्षु प्रतिष्ठापयेत् ।
text: And thus he should offer (a celebration like the Anvashtakya) to the Fathers every month, observing uneven numbers (i.e. selecting a day with an uneven number, inviting an uneven number of Brahmanas, &c.).

sanskrit_iast: nava avarān bhojayet |
meaning: नव अवरान् भोजयेत् ।
text: He should give food at least to nine (Brahmanas),

sanskrit_iast: ayujo vā |
meaning: अयुजो वा ।
text: Or to an uneven number;

sanskrit_iast: yugmān vṛddhir pūteṣu |
meaning: युग्मान् वृद्धिर् पूतेषु ।
text: To an even number on auspicious occasions or on the performance of meritorious deeds (such as the consecration of ponds, &c.);

sanskrit_iast: ayugmān itareṣu |
meaning: अयुग्मान् इतरेषु ।
text: To an uneven number on other (occasions).

sanskrit_iast: pradakṣiṇam upacāro yavais tila arthaḥ |
meaning: प्रदक्षिणम् उपचारो यवैस् तिल अर्थः ।
text: The rite is performed from left to right. Barley is to be used instead of sesamum.

sanskrit_iast: ratham ārokṣyan nānā pāṇibhyām cakre abhimṛśed aham te pūrva pādāv ārabhe bṛhad rathantare te cakre |
meaning: रथम् आरोक्ष्यन् नाना पाणिभ्याम् चक्रे अभिमृशेद् अहम् ते पूर्व पादाव् आरभे बृहद् रथन्तरे ते चक्रे ।
text: When going to mount a chariot he should touch the wheels with his two hands separately with (the words), 'I touch thy two fore-feet. Thy two wheels are the Brihat and the Rathantara (Samans).'

sanskrit_iast: vāmadevyam akṣa ity akṣa adhiṣṭhāne |
meaning: वामदेव्यम् अक्ष इत्य् अक्ष अधिष्ठाने ।
text: 'Thy axle is the Vamadevya'--with (these words he touches) the two (naves) in which the axle rests.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇa pūrvābhyām ārohed vāyoṣ tvā vīryeṇa ārohāmi indrasya ojasā ādhipatyena iti |
meaning: दक्षिण पूर्वाभ्याम् आरोहेद् वायोष् त्वा वीर्येण आरोहामि इन्द्रस्य ओजसा आधिपत्येन इति ।
text: He should mount (the chariot) with the right foot first, with (the words), 'With Vayu's strength I mount thee, with Indra's power and sovereignty.'

sanskrit_iast: raśmīṃt sammṛśed araśmikān vā daṇḍena brahmaṇo vas tejasā saṃgṛhṇāmi satyana vā saṃgṛhṇāmi iti |
meaning: रश्मींत् सम्मृशेद् अरश्मिकान् वा दण्डेन ब्रह्मणो वस् तेजसा संगृह्णामि सत्यन वा संगृह्णामि इति ।
text: He should touch the reins, or if the horses have no reins, (he should touch) the horses with a staff, with (the words), 'With Brahman's splendour I seize you. With truth I seize you.'

sanskrit_iast: abhipravartamāneṣu japet sahasra sanim vājam abhivartasva ratha deva pravaha vanaspate vīḍvaṅgo hi bhūyā iti |
meaning: अभिप्रवर्तमानेषु जपेत् सहस्र सनिम् वाजम् अभिवर्तस्व रथ देव प्रवह वनस्पते वीड्वङ्गो हि भूया इति ।
text: When (the horses) put themselves in motion, he should murmur, 'Go forward to thousandfold successful vigour, divine chariot, carry us forward!'--(and the verse), 'Free, strong be thy limbs!' (Rig-veda VI, 47, 26.)

sanskrit_iast: etayā anyāny api vānaspatyāni |
meaning: एतया अन्यान्य् अपि वानस्पत्यानि ।
text: With this (verse he should touch also) other articles of wood.

sanskrit_iast: sthirau gāvau bhavatām vīḷu prakṣa iti ratha aṅgam abhimṛśet |
meaning: स्थिरौ गावौ भवताम् वीऌउ प्रक्ष इति रथ अङ्गम् अभिमृशेत् ।
text: 'May the two oxen be strong, the axle firm' (Rig-veda III, 53, i7)--with (this verse) he should touch (each) part of the chariot (alluded to in that verse).

sanskrit_iast: sutrāmāṇam pṛthivīm dyām anehasam iti nāvam |
meaning: सुत्रामाणम् पृथिवीम् द्याम् अनेहसम् इति नावम् ।
text: With (the verse), 'The earth, the good protectress, the unattained heaven' (Rig-veda X, 63, 10) (he should ascend) a ship.

sanskrit_iast: nava rathena yaśasvinam vṛkṣam hradam vā avidāsinam pradakṣiṇam kṛtvā phalavatīḥ śākhā āharet |
meaning: नव रथेन यशस्विनम् वृक्षम् ह्रदम् वा अविदासिनम् प्रदक्षिणम् कृत्वा फलवतीः शाखा आहरेत् ।
text: With a new chariot he should drive round a widely known tree or round a pool that does not dry up, with his right side turned towards it, and then should fetch branches which bear fruits,

sanskrit_iast: ayad vā kauṭumbam |
meaning: अयद् वा कौटुम्बम् ।
text: Or something else that belongs to the household.

sanskrit_iast: saṃsadam upayāyāt |
meaning: संसदम् उपयायात् ।
text: (He then) should drive (in that chariot) to an assembly.

sanskrit_iast: asmākam uttamam kṛthi ity ādityam īkṣamāṇo japitvā avarohet |
meaning: अस्माकम् उत्तमम् कृथि इत्य् आदित्यम् ईक्षमाणो जपित्वा अवरोहेत् ।
text: Having murmured, while looking at the sun, (the verse), 'Make our renown highest' (Rig-veda IV, 31, 15), he should descend.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣabham mā samānām ity abhikrāman |
meaning: ऋषभम् मा समानाम् इत्य् अभिक्रामन् ।
text: 'To the bull among my equals' (Rig-veda X, 166, 1)--(this verse he should murmur) while approaching (that assembly?).

sanskrit_iast: vayam adya indrasya proṣṭhā ity astam yāty āditye |
meaning: वयम् अद्य इन्द्रस्य प्रोष्ठा इत्य् अस्तम् यात्य् आदित्ये ।
text: 'May we be called to-day Indra's best friends' (Rig-veda I, 167, 10)--when the sun is setting.

sanskrit_iast: tad vo divo duhitaro vibhātīr iti vyuṣṭhāyām |
meaning: तद् वो दिवो दुहितरो विभातीर् इति व्युष्ठायाम् ।
text: 'Thus I address you, O daughters of heaven, while you arise' (Rig-veda IV, 51, 11)--when day appears.

sanskrit_iast: atha ato vāstu parīkṣā |
meaning: अथ अतो वास्तु परीक्षा ।
text: Now the examination of the ground (where he intends to build a house).

sanskrit_iast: anūkharam avivadiṣṇu bhūma |
meaning: अनूखरम् अविवदिष्णु भूम ।
text: (It must be) non-salinous soil of undisputed property,

sanskrit_iast: oṣadhi vanaspativat |
meaning: ओषधि वनस्पतिवत् ।
text: With herbs and trees,

sanskrit_iast: yasmin kuśa vīriṇam prabhūtam |
meaning: यस्मिन् कुश वीरिणम् प्रभूतम् ।
text: On which much Kusa and Virana grass grows.

sanskrit_iast: kaṇṭaki kṣīriṇas tu samūlān parikhāya udvāsayet |
meaning: कण्टकि क्षीरिणस् तु समूलान् परिखाय उद्वासयेत् ।
text: Plants with thorns and with milky juice he should dig out with their roots and remove them--

sanskrit_iast: apāmārgaḥ śākas tilvakaḥ parivyādha iti ca etāni |
meaning: अपामार्गः शाकस् तिल्वकः परिव्याध इति च एतानि ।
text: And in the same way the following (sorts of plants), viz. Apamarga, potherbs, Tilvaka, Parivyadha.

sanskrit_iast: yatra sarvata āpo madhye sametya pradakṣiṇam śayanīyam parītya prācyaḥ syanderann apravadatyas tat sarva samṛddham |
meaning: यत्र सर्वत आपो मध्ये समेत्य प्रदक्षिणम् शयनीयम् परीत्य प्राच्यः स्यन्देरन्न् अप्रवदत्यस् तत् सर्व समृद्धम् ।
text: A spot where the waters, flowing together from all sides to the centre of it, flow round the resting-place, having it on their right side, and then flow off to the east without noise--that possesses all auspicious qualities.

sanskrit_iast: samavasrave bhakta śaraṇam kārayte |
meaning: समवस्रवे भक्त शरणम् कारय्ते ।
text: Where the waters flow off, he should have the provision-room built.

sanskrit_iast: bahv annam ha bhavati |
meaning: बह्व् अन्नम् ह भवति ।
text: Thus it becomes rich in food.

sanskrit_iast: prakṣiṇā pravaṇe sabhām māpayet sā adyūtā ha bhavati |
meaning: प्रक्षिणा प्रवणे सभाम् मापयेत् सा अद्यूता ह भवति ।
text: On a spot which is inclined towards the south, he should have the assembly-room constructed; thus there will be no gambling in it.

sanskrit_iast: yuvānas tasyām kitavāḥ kalahinaḥ pramāyukā bhavanti |
meaning: युवानस् तस्याम् कितवाः कलहिनः प्रमायुका भवन्ति ।
text: (But others say that) in such (an assembly-room) the young people become gamblers, quarrelsome, and die early.

sanskrit_iast: yatra sarvatra āpaḥ prasyanderaṃt sā svastyayany adyūtā ca |
meaning: यत्र सर्वत्र आपः प्रस्यन्देरंत् सा स्वस्त्ययन्य् अद्यूता च ।
text: Where the waters flow together from all directions, that assembly-room (situated on such a spot) brings luck and is free from gambling.

sanskrit_iast: atha etair vāstu parīkṣeta |
meaning: अथ एतैर् वास्तु परीक्षेत ।
text: Now he should examine the ground in the following ways.

sanskrit_iast: jānu mātram gartam khātvā tair eva pāṃsubhiḥ pratipūrayet |
meaning: जानु मात्रम् गर्तम् खात्वा तैर् एव पांसुभिः प्रतिपूरयेत् ।
text: He should dig a pit knee-deep and fill it again with the same earth (which he has taken out of it).

sanskrit_iast: adhike praśastam same vārttam nyūne garhitam |
meaning: अधिके प्रशस्तम् समे वार्त्तम् न्यूने गर्हितम् ।
text: If (the earth) reaches out (of the pit, the ground is) excellent; if it is level, (it is) of middle quality; if it does not fill (the pit, it is) to be rejected.

sanskrit_iast: astamite apām pūrṇam parivāsayet |
meaning: अस्तमिते अपाम् पूर्णम् परिवासयेत् ।
text: After sunset he should fill (the pit) with water and leave it so through the night.

sanskrit_iast: sodake praśastam ārdre vārttam śuṣke garhitam |
meaning: सोदके प्रशस्तम् आर्द्रे वार्त्तम् शुष्के गर्हितम् ।
text: If (in the morning) there is water in it, (the ground is) excellent; if it is moist, (it is) of middle quality; if it is dry, (it is) to be rejected.

sanskrit_iast: śvetam madhura āsvādam sikata uttaram brāhmaṇasya |
meaning: श्वेतम् मधुर आस्वादम् सिकत उत्तरम् ब्राह्मणस्य ।
text: White (ground), of sweet taste, with sand on the surface, (should be elected) by a Brahmana.

sanskrit_iast: lohitam kṣatriyasya |
meaning: लोहितम् क्षत्रियस्य ।
text: Red (ground) for a Kshatriya.

sanskrit_iast: pītam vaiśyasya |
meaning: पीतम् वैश्यस्य ।
text: Yellow (ground) for a Vaisya.

sanskrit_iast: tat sahasra sītam kṛtvā yathā dik sama catur asram māpayet |
meaning: तत् सहस्र सीतम् कृत्वा यथा दिक् सम चतुर् अस्रम् मापयेत् ।
text: He should draw a thousand furrows on it and should have it measured off as quadrangular, with equal sides to each (of the four) directions;

sanskrit_iast: āyata catur asram vā |
meaning: आयत चतुर् अस्रम् वा ।
text: Or as an oblong quadrangle.

sanskrit_iast: tat śamī śākhayā udumbara śākhayā vā śaṃtātīyena triḥ pradakṣiṇam parivrajan prokṣati |
meaning: तत् शमी शाखया उदुम्बर शाखया वा शंतातीयेन त्रिः प्रदक्षिणम् परिव्रजन् प्रोक्षति ।
text: With a Sami branch or an Udumbara branch he sprinkles it (with water), going thrice round it, so that his right side is turned towards it, reciting the Santatiya hymn.

sanskrit_iast: avicchinnayā ca udaka dhārayā āpo hi ṣṭha mayobhuva iti tṛcena |
meaning: अविच्छिन्नया च उदक धारया आपो हि ष्ठ मयोभुव इति तृचेन ।
text: And (so he does again three times) pouring out water without interruption, with the three verses, 'O waters, ye are wholesome' (Rig-veda X, 9, 1 seqq.).

sanskrit_iast: vaṃśa antareṣu śaraṇāni kārayet |
meaning: वंश अन्तरेषु शरणानि कारयेत् ।
text: In the interstices between the bamboo staffs he should have the (single) rooms constructed.

sanskrit_iast: garteṣv avakām śīpālam ity avadhāpayen na ha asya dāhuko bhavati iti vijñāyate |
meaning: गर्तेष्व् अवकाम् शीपालम् इत्य् अवधापयेन् न ह अस्य दाहुको भवति इति विज्ञायते ।
text: Into the pits in which the posts are to stand, he should have an Avaka, i.e. (the water-plant called) Sipala put down; then fire will not befall him: thus it is understood (in the Sruti).

sanskrit_iast: madhyama sthūṇāyā garte avadhāya prāg agra udag agrān kuśān āstīrya vrīhi yavamatīr apa āsecayed acyutāya bhaumāya svāhā iti |
meaning: मध्यम स्थूणाया गर्ते अवधाय प्राग् अग्र उदग् अग्रान् कुशान् आस्तीर्य व्रीहि यवमतीर् अप आसेचयेद् अच्युताय भौमाय स्वाहा इति ।
text: Having put (that plant) into the pit in which the middle-post is to stand, he should spread (on it) eastward-pointed and northward-pointed Kusa grass and should sprinkle (on that grass) water into which rice and barley have been thrown, with (the words), 'To the steady one, the earth-demon, svaha!'

sanskrit_iast: atha enām ucchrīyamāṇām anumantrayeta iha eva tiṣṭha nimitā tilvakās tām irāvatīm | madhye poṣasva tiṣṭhanti imā tvā prāpann aghāyavaḥ || ā tvā kumāras taruṇa ā vatso jāyatām saha | ā tvā pariśritaḥ kumbha ā dadhnaḥ kalaśair ayann iti |
meaning: अथ एनाम् उच्छ्रीयमाणाम् अनुमन्त्रयेत इह एव तिष्ठ निमिता तिल्वकास् ताम् इरावतीम् । मध्ये पोषस्व तिष्ठन्ति इमा त्वा प्रापन्न् अघायवः ॥ आ त्वा कुमारस् तरुण आ वत्सो जायताम् सह । आ त्वा परिश्रितः कुम्भ आ दध्नः कलशैर् अयन्न् इति ।
text: He then should, when (the middle-post) is being erected, recite over it (the two verses), 'Stand here, fixed in the ground, prosperous, long-lasting (?), standing amid prosperity. May the malevolent ones not attain thee! 'To thee (may) the young child (come), to thee the calf . . .; to thee (may) the cup of Parisrut (come); (to thee) may they come with pots of curds.'

sanskrit_iast: vaṃśam ādhīyamānam |
meaning: वंशम् आधीयमानम् ।
text: (Over) the bamboo staff, when it is put on (the middle-post, he recites the hemistich),

sanskrit_iast: ṛtena sthūṇām adhiroha vaṃśa drāghīya āyuḥ prataram dadhāna iti |
meaning: ऋतेन स्थूणाम् अधिरोह वंश द्राघीय आयुः प्रतरम् दधान इति ।
text: 'Rightly ascend the post, O staff, bestowing on us long life henceforward.'

sanskrit_iast: sarvāsu catasṛṣu śilāsu maṇikam pratiṣṭhāpayet pṛthivyā adhi sambhava iti |
meaning: सर्वासु चतसृषु शिलासु मणिकम् प्रतिष्ठापयेत् पृथिव्या अधि सम्भव इति ।
text: On four stones, on which Durva grass has been spread, he should establish the water-barrel with (the words), 'Arise on the earth'--

sanskrit_iast: araṅgaro vāvadīti tredhā baddho varatrayā | irām u ha praśaṃsaty anirām apabādhatām iti vā |
meaning: अरङ्गरो वावदीति त्रेधा बद्धो वरत्रया । इराम् उ ह प्रशंसत्य् अनिराम् अपबाधताम् इति वा ।
text: Or with (the verse), 'The Arangara sounds, three times bound with the strap. It praises the welfare; may it drive away ill.'

sanskrit_iast: atha asminn apa āsecayed aitu rājā varuṇo revatībhir asmiṃt sthāne tiṣṭhatu modamānaḥ | irām vahanto ghṛtam ukṣamāṇā mitreṇa sākam saha saṃviśantv iti |
meaning: अथ अस्मिन्न् अप आसेचयेद् ऐतु राजा वरुणो रेवतीभिर् अस्मिंत् स्थाने तिष्ठतु मोदमानः । इराम् वहन्तो घृतम् उक्षमाणा मित्रेण साकम् सह संविशन्त्व् इति ।
text: He then should pour water into it with (the verse), 'Hither may king Varuna come with the plentiful (waters); at this place may he stay contented; bringing welfare, dropping ghee may they lie down together with Mitra.'

sanskrit_iast: atha enat śamayati |
meaning: अथ एनत् शमयति ।
text: He then 'appeases' it (in the following way).

sanskrit_iast: vrīhi yavamatībhir adbhir hiraṇyam avadhāya śaṃtāyīyena triḥ pradakṣiṇam parivrajan prokṣati |
meaning: व्रीहि यवमतीभिर् अद्भिर् हिरण्यम् अवधाय शंतायीयेन त्रिः प्रदक्षिणम् परिव्रजन् प्रोक्षति ।
text: He puts gold into water into which rice and barley have been thrown, and (with that water) he sprinkles it three times, going round it with his right side turned towards it, with the Santatiya hymn.

sanskrit_iast: avicchinnayā ca udaka dhārayā āpo hi ṣṭha mayobhuva iti tṛcena |
meaning: अविच्छिन्नया च उदक धारया आपो हि ष्ठ मयोभुव इति तृचेन ।
text: And (so he does again three times) pouring out water without interruption, with the three verses, 'O waters, ye are wholesome' (Rig-veda X, 9, I seqq.).

sanskrit_iast: madhye agārasya sthālī pākam śrapayitvā vāstoṣpate pratijānīhy asmān iti catasṛbhiḥ pratyṛcam hutvā annam saṃskṛtya brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā śivam vāstu śivam vāstv iti vācayīta |
meaning: मध्ये अगारस्य स्थाली पाकम् श्रपयित्वा वास्तोष्पते प्रतिजानीह्य् अस्मान् इति चतसृभिः प्रत्यृचम् हुत्वा अन्नम् संस्कृत्य ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा शिवम् वास्तु शिवम् वास्त्व् इति वाचयीत ।
text: In the middle of the house he should cook a mess of food, sacrifice (therefrom) with the four verses, 'Vastoshpati, accept us' (Rig-veda VII, 54, 1 seqq.), verse by verse, should prepare food, should give to the Brahmanas to eat, and should cause them to say, 'Lucky is the ground! Lucky is the ground!'

sanskrit_iast: uktam gṛha prapadanam |
meaning: उक्तम् गृह प्रपदनम् ।
text: It has been declared how he should enter the house (when returning from a journey).

sanskrit_iast: bījavato gṛhān prapadyeta |
meaning: बीजवतो गृहान् प्रपद्येत ।
text: The house, when he enters it, should be provided with seed-corn.

sanskrit_iast: kṣetram prakarṣayed uttaraiḥ proṣṭhapadaiḥ phālgunībhī rohiṇyā vā |
meaning: क्षेत्रम् प्रकर्षयेद् उत्तरैः प्रोष्ठपदैः फाल्गुनीभी रोहिण्या वा ।
text: He should have his field ploughed under the Nakshatras Uttarah Proshthapadas, (Uttarah) Phalgunyas, or Rohini.

sanskrit_iast: kṣetrasya anuvātam kṣetrasya patinā vayam iti pratyṛcam juhuyāj japed vā |
meaning: क्षेत्रस्य अनुवातम् क्षेत्रस्य पतिना वयम् इति प्रत्यृचम् जुहुयाज् जपेद् वा ।
text: In order that the wind may blow to him from the field, he should offer oblations with the hymn, 'Through the lord of the field' (Rig-veda IV, 57), verse by verse, or he should murmur (that hymn).

sanskrit_iast: gāḥ pratiṣṭhamānā anumantrayeta mayobhu vāto abhivātu usrā iti dvābhyām |
meaning: गाः प्रतिष्ठमाना अनुमन्त्रयेत मयोभु वातो अभिवातु उस्रा इति द्वाभ्याम् ।
text: He should speak over the cows when they go away, the two verses, 'May refreshing wind blow over the cows' (Rig-veda X, 169, I seq.).

sanskrit_iast: āyatīr yāsām ūdhaś catur bilam madhoḥ pūrṇam ghṛtasya ca | tā naḥ santu payasvatīr bahvīr goṣṭhe ghṛtācyaḥ | upa mā etu mayobhuva ūrjam ca ojaś ca bibhratīḥ | duhānā akṣitam payo mayi goṣṭhe niviśadhvam yathā bhavāmy uttamaḥ | yā deveṣu tanvam airayanta iti ca sūkta śeṣam |
meaning: आयतीर् यासाम् ऊधश् चतुर् बिलम् मधोः पूर्णम् घृतस्य च । ता नः सन्तु पयस्वतीर् बह्वीर् गोष्ठे घृताच्यः । उप मा एतु मयोभुव ऊर्जम् च ओजश् च बिभ्रतीः । दुहाना अक्षितम् पयो मयि गोष्ठे निविशध्वम् यथा भवाम्य् उत्तमः । या देवेषु तन्वम् ऐरयन्त इति च सूक्त शेषम् ।
text: When they come back, (he should recite the following verses,) 'May they whose udder with its four holes is full of honey and ghee, be milk-givers to us; (may they be) many in our stable, rich in ghee. 'Come hither to me, giving refreshment, bringing vigour and strength. Giving inexhaustible milk, rest in my stable that I may become the highest one' And, 'They who have raised their body up to the gods'--the rest of the hymn (Rig-veda X, 169, 3. 4).

sanskrit_iast: āgāvīyam eke |
meaning: आगावीयम् एके ।
text: Some recite (instead of the texts stated in Sutra 6) the Agaviya hymn.

sanskrit_iast: gaṇānām upatiṣṭheta aguru gavīnām bhūtāḥ stha praśastāḥ stha śobhanāḥ priyāḥ priyo vo bhūyāsam śam mayi jānīdhvam śam mayi jānīdhvam |
meaning: गणानाम् उपतिष्ठेत अगुरु गवीनाम् भूताः स्थ प्रशस्ताः स्थ शोभनाः प्रियाः प्रियो वो भूयासम् शम् मयि जानीध्वम् शम् मयि जानीध्वम् ।
text: He should approach their herds, if the cows do not belong to his Guru, with (the words), 'Prospering are ye; excellent are ye, beautiful, dear. May I become dear to you. May you see bliss in me.'

sanskrit_iast: atha ataḥ pañca yajñāḥ |
meaning: अथ अतः पञ्च यज्ञाः ।
text: Now (follow) the five sacrifices:

sanskrit_iast: deva yajño bhūta yajñaḥ pitṛ yajño brahma yajño manuṣya yajña iti |
meaning: देव यज्ञो भूत यज्ञः पितृ यज्ञो ब्रह्म यज्ञो मनुष्य यज्ञ इति ।
text: The sacrifice to the Gods, the sacrifice to the Beings, the sacrifice to the Fathers, the sacrifice to Brahman, the sacrifice to men.

sanskrit_iast: tad yad agnau juhoti sa deva yajño yad balim karoti sa bhūta yajño yat pitṛbhyo dadāti sa pitṛ yajño yat svādhyāyam adhīte sa brahma yajño yan manuṣyebhyo dadāti sa manuṣya yajña iti |
meaning: तद् यद् अग्नौ जुहोति स देव यज्ञो यद् बलिम् करोति स भूत यज्ञो यत् पितृभ्यो ददाति स पितृ यज्ञो यत् स्वाध्यायम् अधीते स ब्रह्म यज्ञो यन् मनुष्येभ्यो ददाति स मनुष्य यज्ञ इति ।
text: Here now, if he makes oblations over the (sacred) fire, this is the sacrifice to the Gods. If he makes Bali offerings, this is the sacrifice to the Beings. If he gives (Pinda offerings) to the Fathers, this is the sacrifice to the Fathers. If he studies (Vedic) texts, this is the sacrifice to Brahman. If he gives to men, this is the sacrifice to men.

sanskrit_iast: tān etān yajñān ahar ahaḥ kurvīta |
meaning: तान् एतान् यज्ञान् अहर् अहः कुर्वीत ।
text: These (five kinds of) sacrifices he should perform every day.

sanskrit_iast: atha svādhyāya vidhiḥ | prāg vā udag vā grāmān niṣkramya apa āplutya śucau deśe yajña upavīty ācamya aklinna vāsā darbhāṇām mahad upastīrya prāk kūlānām teṣu prān mukha upaviśya upastham kṛtvā dakṣiṇa uttarau pāṇī saṃdhāya pavitravantau | vijñāyate apām vā eṣa oṣadhīnām raso yad darbhāḥ sarasam eva tad brahma karoti | dyāvā pṛthivyoḥ saṃdhim īkṣamāṇaḥ sammīlya vā yathā vā yuktam ātmānam manyeta tathā yukto adhīyīta svādhyāyam |
meaning: अथ स्वाध्याय विधिः । प्राग् वा उदग् वा ग्रामान् निष्क्रम्य अप आप्लुत्य शुचौ देशे यज्ञ उपवीत्य् आचम्य अक्लिन्न वासा दर्भाणाम् महद् उपस्तीर्य प्राक् कूलानाम् तेषु प्रान् मुख उपविश्य उपस्थम् कृत्वा दक्षिण उत्तरौ पाणी संधाय पवित्रवन्तौ । विज्ञायते अपाम् वा एष ओषधीनाम् रसो यद् दर्भाः सरसम् एव तद् ब्रह्म करोति । द्यावा पृथिव्योः संधिम् ईक्षमाणः सम्मील्य वा यथा वा युक्तम् आत्मानम् मन्येत तथा युक्तो अधीयीत स्वाध्यायम् ।

sanskrit_iast: om pūrvā vyāhṛtayaḥ |
meaning: ओम् पूर्वा व्याहृतयः ।
text: The Vyahritis preceded by (the syllable) Om (are pronounced first).

sanskrit_iast: sāvitrīm anvāha paccho ardharcaśaḥ sarvām iti tṛtīyam |
meaning: सावित्रीम् अन्वाह पच्छो अर्धर्चशः सर्वाम् इति तृतीयम् ।
text: He (then) repeats the Savitri (Rig-Veda III, 62, 10), (firstly) Pada by Pada, (then) hemistich by hemistich, thirdly the whole.

sanskrit_iast: atha svādhyāyam adhīyīta ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāny atharva aṅgiraso brāhmaṇāni kalpān gāthā nārāśaṃsīr itihāsa purāṇāni iti |
meaning: अथ स्वाध्यायम् अधीयीत ऋचो यजूंषि सामान्य् अथर्व अङ्गिरसो ब्राह्मणानि कल्पान् गाथा नाराशंसीर् इतिहास पुराणानि इति ।
text: He then should recite for himself (the following texts, viz.) the Rikas, the Yagus, the Samans, the Atharvan and Angiras hymns, the Brahmanas, the Kalpa (Sutras), the Gathas, the (texts in honour of kings and heroes, called) Narasamsis, the Itihasas and Puranas.

sanskrit_iast: yad ṛco adhīte paya āhutibhir eva tad devatās tarpayati yad yajūṃṣi ghṛta āhutibhir yat sāmāni madhv āhutibhir yad atharva aṅgirasaḥ soma āhutibhir yad brāhmaṇāni kalpān gāthā nārāśaṃsīr itihāsa purāṇāni ity amṛta āhutibhiḥ |
meaning: यद् ऋचो अधीते पय आहुतिभिर् एव तद् देवतास् तर्पयति यद् यजूंषि घृत आहुतिभिर् यत् सामानि मध्व् आहुतिभिर् यद् अथर्व अङ्गिरसः सोम आहुतिभिर् यद् ब्राह्मणानि कल्पान् गाथा नाराशंसीर् इतिहास पुराणानि इत्य् अमृत आहुतिभिः ।

sanskrit_iast: sa yāvan manyeta tāvad adhītya etayā paridadhāti namo brahmaṇe namo astv agnaye namaḥ pṛthivyai nama oṣadhībhyaḥ | namo vāce namo vācas pataye namo viṣṇave mahate karomi iti |
meaning: स यावन् मन्येत तावद् अधीत्य एतया परिदधाति नमो ब्रह्मणे नमो अस्त्व् अग्नये नमः पृथिव्यै नम ओषधीभ्यः । नमो वाचे नमो वाचस् पतये नमो विष्णवे महते करोमि इति ।
text: After he has recited (those texts) as far as he thinks fit, he should finish with the following (verse), 'Adoration to Brahman! Adoration be to Agni! Adoration to the Earth! Adoration to the Herbs! Adoration to the Voice! Adoration to the Lord of the Voice! Adoration I bring to great Vishnu!'

sanskrit_iast: devatās tarpayati prajāpatir brahmā vedā devā ṛṣayaḥ sarvāṇi chandāṃsy om kāro vaṣaṭ kāro vyāhṛtayaḥ sāvitrī yajñā dyāvā pṛthivī antarikṣam aho rātrāṇi saṃkhyāḥ siddhāḥ samudrā nadyo girayaḥ kṣetra oṣadhi vanaspati gandharva apsaraso nāgā vayāṃsi gāvaḥ sādhyā viprā yakṣā rakṣāṃsi bhūtāny evam antāni |
meaning: देवतास् तर्पयति प्रजापतिर् ब्रह्मा वेदा देवा ऋषयः सर्वाणि छन्दांस्य् ओम् कारो वषट् कारो व्याहृतयः सावित्री यज्ञा द्यावा पृथिवी अन्तरिक्षम् अहो रात्राणि संख्याः सिद्धाः समुद्रा नद्यो गिरयः क्षेत्र ओषधि वनस्पति गन्धर्व अप्सरसो नागा वयांसि गावः साध्या विप्रा यक्षा रक्षांसि भूतान्य् एवम् अन्तानि ।
text: He satiates the deities: 'Pragapati, Brahman, the Vedas, the gods, the Rishis, all metres, the word Om, the word Vashat, the Vyahritis, the Savitri, the sacrifices, Heaven and Earth, the air, days and nights, the numbers, the Siddhas, the oceans, the rivers, the mountains, the fields, herbs, trees, Gandharvas and Apsaras, the snakes, the birds, the cows, the Sadhyas, the Vipras, the Yakshas, the Rakshas, the beings that have these (Rakshas, &c.) at their end.'

sanskrit_iast: atha ṛṣayaḥ śatarcino mādhyamā gṛtsamado viśvāmitro vāmadevo atrir bhāradvājo vasiṣṭhaḥ pragāthāḥ pāvamānyaḥ kṣudra sūktā mahā sūktā iti |
meaning: अथ ऋषयः शतर्चिनो माध्यमा गृत्समदो विश्वामित्रो वामदेवो अत्रिर् भारद्वाजो वसिष्ठः प्रगाथाः पावमान्यः क्षुद्र सूक्ता महा सूक्ता इति ।
text: Then the Rishis: 'The (Rishis) of the hundred (Rikas), the (Rishis) of the middle (Mandalas), Gritsamada, [paragraph continues] Visvamitra, Vamadeva, Atri, Bharadvaga, Vasishtha, the Pragathas, the Pavamana hymns, the (Rishis) of the short hymns, and of the long hymns.'

sanskrit_iast: prācīna āvītī |
meaning: प्राचीन आवीती ।
text: (Then) with the sacrificial cord suspended over the right shoulder:

sanskrit_iast: sumantu jaimini vaiśampāyana paila sūtra bhāṣya bhārata mahā bhārata dharma ācāryā jānanti bāhavi gārgya gautama śākalya bābhravya māṇḍavya māṇḍūkeyā gargī vācaknavī vaḍavā prātītheyī sulabhā maitreyī kaholam kauṣītakam mahā kauṣiṣītakam paiṅgyam mahā paiṅgyam suyajñam śāṃkhāyanam aitareyam mahā aitareyam śākalam bāṣkalam sujāta vaktram audavāhim audavāhim mahā audavāhim saujāmim śaunakam āśvalāyanam ye ca anye ācāryās te sarve tṛpyantv iti |
meaning: सुमन्तु जैमिनि वैशम्पायन पैल सूत्र भाष्य भारत महा भारत धर्म आचार्या जानन्ति बाहवि गार्ग्य गौतम शाकल्य बाभ्रव्य माण्डव्य माण्डूकेया गर्गी वाचक्नवी वडवा प्रातीथेयी सुलभा मैत्रेयी कहोलम् कौषीतकम् महा कौषिषीतकम् पैङ्ग्यम् महा पैङ्ग्यम् सुयज्ञम् शांखायनम् ऐतरेयम् महा ऐतरेयम् शाकलम् बाष्कलम् सुजात वक्त्रम् औदवाहिम् औदवाहिम् महा औदवाहिम् सौजामिम् शौनकम् आश्वलायनम् ये च अन्ये आचार्यास् ते सर्वे तृप्यन्त्व् इति ।
text: 'Sumantu, Gaimini, Vaisampayana, Paila, the Sutras, the Bhashyas, the Bharata, the Mahabharata, the teachers of law, Gananti, Bahavi, Gargya, Gautama, Sakalya, Babhravya, Mandavya, Mandukeya, Gargi Vakaknavi, Vadava Pratitheyi, Sulabha Maitreyi, Kahola Kaushitaka, Mahakaushitaka, Paingya, Mahapaingya, Suyagna Sankhayana, Aitareya, Mahaitareya, the Sakala (text), the Bashkala (text), Sugatavaktra, Audavahi, Mahaudavahi, Saugami, Saunaka, Asvalayana--and whatsoever other teachers there are, may they all satiate themselves.'

sanskrit_iast: pratipuruṣam pitṝṃs tarpayitvā gṛhān etya yad dadāti sa dakṣiṇā |
meaning: प्रतिपुरुषम् पितॄंस् तर्पयित्वा गृहान् एत्य यद् ददाति स दक्षिणा ।
text: After he has satiated the Fathers man by man, and has returned to his house, what he gives (then), that is the sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast: atha api vijñāyate sa yadi tiṣṭhan vrajann āsīnaḥ śayāno vā yam yam kratum adhīte tena tena ha asya kratunā iṣṭam bhavati |
meaning: अथ अपि विज्ञायते स यदि तिष्ठन् व्रजन्न् आसीनः शयानो वा यम् यम् क्रतुम् अधीते तेन तेन ह अस्य क्रतुना इष्टम् भवति ।
text: And it is also understood (in the Sruti), 'May he be standing, walking, sitting, or lying, (the texts belonging to) whatsoever sacrifice he repeats, that sacrifice indeed he has offered.'

sanskrit_iast: vijñāyate tasya dvāv anadhyāyau yad ātmā aśucir yad deśaḥ |
meaning: विज्ञायते तस्य द्वाव् अनध्यायौ यद् आत्मा अशुचिर् यद् देशः ।
text: It is understood (in the Sruti), 'Regarding this (Svadhyaya) there are two cases in which the study (of the sacred texts) is forbidden: when he is impure himself, and when the place is.'

sanskrit_iast: atha ato adhyāya upākaraṇam |
meaning: अथ अतो अध्याय उपाकरणम् ।
text: Now (follows) the Adhyayopakarana (i.e. the ceremony by which the annual course of study is opened);

sanskrit_iast: oṣadhīnām prādur bhāve śravaṇena śrāvaṇasya |
meaning: ओषधीनाम् प्रादुर् भावे श्रवणेन श्रावणस्य ।
text: When the herbs appear, (when the moon stands in conjunction) with Sravana, in the Sravana month,

sanskrit_iast: pañcamyām hastena vā |
meaning: पञ्चम्याम् हस्तेन वा ।
text: Or on the fifth (Tithi of that month), under (the Nakshatra) Hasta.

sanskrit_iast: ājya bhāgau hutvā ājya āhutīr juhuyāt sāvitrye brahmaṇe śraddhāyai medhāyai prajñāyai dhāraṇāyai sadasas pataye anumataye chandobhya ṛṣibhyaś ca iti |
meaning: आज्य भागौ हुत्वा आज्य आहुतीर् जुहुयात् सावित्र्ये ब्रह्मणे श्रद्धायै मेधायै प्रज्ञायै धारणायै सदसस् पतये अनुमतये छन्दोभ्य ऋषिभ्यश् च इति ।
text: Having sacrificed the two Agya portions, he should offer Agya oblations (to the following deities, viz.) Savitri, Brahman, Belief, Insight, Wisdom, Memory, Sadasaspati, Anumati, the metres, and the Rishis.

sanskrit_iast: atha dadhi saktūn juhoti |
meaning: अथ दधि सक्तून् जुहोति ।
text: He then sacrifices grains with curds (with the following texts):

sanskrit_iast: agnim īḍe purohitam ity ekā |
meaning: अग्निम् ईडे पुरोहितम् इत्य् एका ।
text: 'I praise Agni the Purohita'--this one verse (Rig-Veda I, 1, 1),

sanskrit_iast: kuṣumbhakas tad abravīd āvadaṃs tvam śakune bhadram āvada gṛṇānā jamadagninā dhāmam te viśvam bhuvanam adhiśritam gantā no yajñam yajñiyāḥ suśami yo naḥ svo araṇaḥ praticakṣva vicakṣva agne yāhi marut sakhā yat te rājam śṛtam havir iti dvṛcāḥ |
meaning: कुषुम्भकस् तद् अब्रवीद् आवदंस् त्वम् शकुने भद्रम् आवद गृणाना जमदग्निना धामम् ते विश्वम् भुवनम् अधिश्रितम् गन्ता नो यज्ञम् यज्ञियाः सुशमि यो नः स्वो अरणः प्रतिचक्ष्व विचक्ष्व अग्ने याहि मरुत् सखा यत् ते राजम् शृतम् हविर् इति द्वृचाः ।
text: 'The Kushumbhaka (mungoose?) has said it'--'If thou criest, O bird, announce luck to us Sung by Gamadagni'--'In thy abode the whole world rests' [paragraph continues] --'Come to our sacrifice, O you that are worthy of sacrifice, with care'--'Whosoever, be he ours, be he alien'--'Look on, look about'--'Come here, Agni, the Maruts' friend'--'The oblation, O king, cooked for thee'--each time two verses;

sanskrit_iast: samānī va ākūtir ity ekā |
meaning: समानी व आकूतिर् इत्य् एका ।
text: 'United is your will' (Rig-veda X, 191, 4)--this one verse;

sanskrit_iast: tat śamyor āvṛṇīmaha ity ekā |
meaning: तत् शम्योर् आवृणीमह इत्य् एका ।
text: 'That blessing and bliss we choose'--this one verse.

sanskrit_iast: adhyeṣyamāṇo adhyāpyair anvārabdha etābhyo devatābhyo hutvā sauviṣṭakṛtam hutvā dadhi saktūn prāśya tato mārjanam |
meaning: अध्येष्यमाणो अध्याप्यैर् अन्वारब्ध एताभ्यो देवताभ्यो हुत्वा सौविष्टकृतम् हुत्वा दधि सक्तून् प्राश्य ततो मार्जनम् ।
text: When he intends to study (the Veda together with pupils), he should, while the pupils take hold of him, sacrifice to those deities, and sacrifice to (Agni) Svishtakrit, and partake of the grains with curds; then (follows) the 'cleaning.'

sanskrit_iast: apareṇa agnim prāk kūuleṣu darbheṣu upaviśya uda pātre darbhān kṛtvā brahma añjali kṛto japet |
meaning: अपरेण अग्निम् प्राक् कूउलेषु दर्भेषु उपविश्य उद पात्रे दर्भान् कृत्वा ब्रह्म अञ्जलि कृतो जपेत् ।
text: Sitting down to the west of the fire on Darbha grass, the tufts of which are directed towards the east, he should put Darbha blades into a water-pot, and making a Brahmangali (i.e. joining his hands as a sign of veneration for the Brahman), he should murmur (the following texts):

sanskrit_iast: om pūrvā vyāhṛtayaḥ sāvitrīm ca trir abhyasya veda ādim ārabhet |
meaning: ओम् पूर्वा व्याहृतयः सावित्रीम् च त्रिर् अभ्यस्य वेद आदिम् आरभेत् ।
text: The Vyahritis preceded by (the syllable) Om (stand first); (these) and the Savitri he should repeat three times and then recite the beginning of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast: tathā utsarge |
meaning: तथा उत्सर्गे ।
text: In the same way at the Utsarga (i.e. at the ceremony performed at the end of the term of Vedic study).

sanskrit_iast: ṣaṇ māsān adhīyīta |
meaning: षण् मासान् अधीयीत ।
text: He should study six months.

sanskrit_iast: samāvṛtto brahma āri kalpena |
meaning: समावृत्तो ब्रह्म आरि कल्पेन ।
text: One who has performed the Samavartana (should live during that time) according to the regulations for Brahmakarins.

sanskrit_iast: yathā nyāyam itare |
meaning: यथा न्यायम् इतरे ।
text: The others according to the rules.

sanskrit_iast: jāyā upeyā ity eke |
meaning: जाया उपेया इत्य् एके ।
text: Some say that he should have intercourse with his wife.

sanskrit_iast: prājāpatyam tat |
meaning: प्राजापत्यम् तत् ।
text: That (is a practice) sacred to Pragapati.

sanskrit_iast: vārṣikam ity etad ācakṣate |
meaning: वार्षिकम् इत्य् एतद् आचक्षते ।
text: This (Upakarana) they call varshika (i.e. belonging to the rainy season).

sanskrit_iast: madhyama aṣṭakāyām etābhyo devatābhyo annena hutvā apo abhyavayanti |
meaning: मध्यम अष्टकायाम् एताभ्यो देवताभ्यो अन्नेन हुत्वा अपो अभ्यवयन्ति ।
text: On the middle Ashtaka they offer food to those deities, and descend into water.

sanskrit_iast: etā eva devatās tarpayanti |
meaning: एता एव देवतास् तर्पयन्ति ।
text: They satiate those same deities (with water oblations),

sanskrit_iast: ācāryān ṛṣīn pitṝṃś ca |
meaning: आचार्यान् ऋषीन् पितॄंश् च ।
text: (And besides) the Akaryas, the Rishis, and the Fathers.

sanskrit_iast: etad utsarjanam |
meaning: एतद् उत्सर्जनम् ।
text: This is the Utsargana.

sanskrit_iast: atha kāmyānām sthāne kāmyāś caravaḥ |
meaning: अथ काम्यानाम् स्थाने काम्याश् चरवः ।
text: Instead of the Kamya ceremonies (i.e. the ceremonies, prescribed in the Srauta-sutra, by which special wishes are attained, oblations of) boiled (rice) grains, for the attainment of those wishes, (should be made by the Grihya sacrificer).

sanskrit_iast: tān eva kāmān āpnoti |
meaning: तान् एव कामान् आप्नोति ।
text: He attains (thereby) those same wishes.

sanskrit_iast: atha vyādhitasya āturasya yakṣma gṛhītasya vā ṣaḍ āhutiś caruḥ |
meaning: अथ व्याधितस्य आतुरस्य यक्ष्म गृहीतस्य वा षड् आहुतिश् चरुः ।
text: For a person that is sick, or suffering, or affected with consumption, a mess of boiled (rice) grains in six oblations (should he offered)--

sanskrit_iast: muñcāmi tvā haviṣā jīvanāya kam ity etena |
meaning: मुञ्चामि त्वा हविषा जीवनाय कम् इत्य् एतेन ।
text: With this (hymn), 'I loosen thee by sacrificial food, that thou mayst live' (Rig-veda X, 161).

sanskrit_iast: svapnam amanojñam dṛṣṭvā adyā no deva savitar iti dvābhyām yac ca goṣu duhṣvapnyam iti pañcabhir ādityam upatiṣṭheta |
meaning: स्वप्नम् अमनोज्ञम् दृष्ट्वा अद्या नो देव सवितर् इति द्वाभ्याम् यच् च गोषु दुह्ष्वप्न्यम् इति पञ्चभिर् आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठेत ।
text: If he has seen a bad dream, he should worship the sun with the two verses, 'To-day, god Savitri' (Rig-veda V, 82, 4, 5), and with the five verses, 'What bad dreams there are among the cows' (Rig-veda VIII, 47, 14 seqq.),

sanskrit_iast: yo me rājan yujyo vā sakhā vā iti vā |
meaning: यो मे राजन् युज्यो वा सखा वा इति वा ।
text: Or with (the verse), 'Whosoever, O king, be it a companion or a friend' (Rig-veda II, 28, 10).

sanskrit_iast: kṣutvā jṛmbhitvā amanojñam dṛṣṭvā pāpakam gandham āghrāya akṣi spandane karṇa dhvanane ca sucakṣā aham akṣībhyām bhūyāsam suvarcā mukhena suśrut karṇābhyām mayi dakṣa kratū iti japet |
meaning: क्षुत्वा जृम्भित्वा अमनोज्ञम् दृष्ट्वा पापकम् गन्धम् आघ्राय अक्षि स्पन्दने कर्ण ध्वनने च सुचक्षा अहम् अक्षीभ्याम् भूयासम् सुवर्चा मुखेन सुश्रुत् कर्णाभ्याम् मयि दक्ष क्रतू इति जपेत् ।
text: When he has sneezed, yawned, seen a disagreeable sight, smelt a bad smell, when his eye palpitates, and when he hears noises in his ears, he should murmur, 'Well-eyed may I become with my eyes, well-vigoured with my face, well-hearing with my ears. May will and insight dwell in me!'

sanskrit_iast: agamanīyām gatvā ayājyam yājayitvā bhojyam bhuktvā apratigrāhyam pratigṛhya caityam yūpam ca upahatya punar mām aitv indriyam punar āyuḥ punar bhagaḥ | punar draviṇam aitu mām punar brāhmaṇam aitu mām svāhā | ime ye dhiṣṇyāso agnayo yathā sthānam iha kalpatām | vaiśvānaro vāvṛdhāno antar yacchatu me mano hṛdy antaram amṛtasya ketuḥ svāhā ity ājya āhutī juhuyāt |
meaning: अगमनीयाम् गत्वा अयाज्यम् याजयित्वा भोज्यम् भुक्त्वा अप्रतिग्राह्यम् प्रतिगृह्य चैत्यम् यूपम् च उपहत्य पुनर् माम् ऐत्व् इन्द्रियम् पुनर् आयुः पुनर् भगः । पुनर् द्रविणम् ऐतु माम् पुनर् ब्राह्मणम् ऐतु माम् स्वाहा । इमे ये धिष्ण्यासो अग्नयो यथा स्थानम् इह कल्पताम् । वैश्वानरो वावृधानो अन्तर् यच्छतु मे मनो हृद्य् अन्तरम् अमृतस्य केतुः स्वाहा इत्य् आज्य आहुती जुहुयात् ।
text: If he has gone to a wife to whom he ought not to go, or if he has performed a sacrifice for a person for whom he ought not to do so, or has eaten forbidden food, or accepted what he ought not to accept, or pushed against a piled-up (fire altar) or against a sacrificial post, he should sacrifice two Agya oblations with (the verses), 'May my faculties return into me, may life return, may prosperity return; may my goods return to me; may the divine power return into me. Svaha! 'These fires that are stationed on the (altars called) Dhishnyas, may they be here in good order, each on its right place. (Agni) Vaisvanara, grown strong, the standard of immortality, may he govern my mind in my heart. Svaha!'

sanskrit_iast: samidhau vā |
meaning: समिधौ वा ।
text: Or (he may sacrifice) two pieces of wood,

sanskrit_iast: japed vā |
meaning: जपेद् वा ।
text: Or murmur (the same two verses without any oblation).

sanskrit_iast: avyādhitam cet svapantam ādityo abhyastam iyād vāg yato anupaviśan rātri śeṣam bhūtvā yena sūrya jyotiṣā bādhase tama iti pañcabhir ādityam upatiṣṭhate |
meaning: अव्याधितम् चेत् स्वपन्तम् आदित्यो अभ्यस्तम् इयाद् वाग् यतो अनुपविशन् रात्रि शेषम् भूत्वा येन सूर्य ज्योतिषा बाधसे तम इति पञ्चभिर् आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठते ।
text: If the sun sets while he is sleeping without being sick, he should spend the rest of the night keeping silence, without sitting down, and should worship the sun (when it rises) with the five (verses), 'The light, O sun, by which thou destroyest darkness' (Rig-veda X, 37, 4 seq.).

sanskrit_iast: abhyudiyac ced akarma śrāntam anabhirūpeṇa karmaṇā vāg yata iti samānam uttarābhiś catasṛbhir upasthānam |
meaning: अभ्युदियच् चेद् अकर्म श्रान्तम् अनभिरूपेण कर्मणा वाग् यत इति समानम् उत्तराभिश् चतसृभिर् उपस्थानम् ।
text: If (the sun) rises (while he is sleeping without being sick), being fatigued without having done any work, or having done work that is not becoming, he should keep silence, &c., as before, and perform his worship (to the sun) with the following four (verses, Rig-veda X, 37, 9 seq.).

sanskrit_iast: yajña upavītī nitya udakaḥ saṃdhyām upāsīta vāg yataḥ |
meaning: यज्ञ उपवीती नित्य उदकः संध्याम् उपासीत वाग् यतः ।
text: Invested with the sacrificial cord, constantly fulfilling the prescribed duties regarding the use of water, he should perform the Sandhya (or twilight devotion), observing silence.

sanskrit_iast: sāyam uttara apara abhimukho anvaṣṭama deśam sāvitrīm japed ardha astamite maṇḍala ā nakṣatra darśanāt |
meaning: सायम् उत्तर अपर अभिमुखो अन्वष्टम देशम् सावित्रीम् जपेद् अर्ध अस्तमिते मण्डल आ नक्षत्र दर्शनात् ।
text: In the evening he should, turning his face to the north-west, to the region between the chief (west) point and the intermediate (north-western) point (of the horizon), murmur the Savitri, (beginning) when the sun is half set, until the stars appear.

sanskrit_iast: evam prātaḥ |
meaning: एवम् प्रातः ।
text: In the same way in the morning--

sanskrit_iast: prān mukhas tiṣṭhann ā maṇḍala darśanāt |
meaning: प्रान् मुखस् तिष्ठन्न् आ मण्डल दर्शनात् ।
text: Standing, with his face turned to the east, until the disk (of the sun) appears.

sanskrit_iast: kapotaś ced agāram upahanyād anupated vā devāḥ kapota iti pratyṛcam juhuyāj japed vā |
meaning: कपोतश् चेद् अगारम् उपहन्याद् अनुपतेद् वा देवाः कपोत इति प्रत्यृचम् जुहुयाज् जपेद् वा ।
text: If a dove flies against his house or towards it, he should sacrifice with (the hymn), 'O gods, the dove' (Rig-veda X, 165), verse by verse, or should murmur (that hymn).

sanskrit_iast: vayam u tvā pathaspata ity artha caryām cariṣyan |
meaning: वयम् उ त्वा पथस्पत इत्य् अर्थ चर्याम् चरिष्यन् ।
text: 'We have thee, O Lord of the path' (Rig-veda VI, 53)--if he is going out for doing some business.

sanskrit_iast: sam pūṣan viduṣā iti naṣṭam adhijigamiṣan mūḷho vā |
meaning: सम् पूषन् विदुषा इति नष्टम् अधिजिगमिषन् मूऌहो वा ।
text: 'Bring us together, Pushan, with a knowing one' (Rig-Veda VI, 54)--if he wishes to find something lost, or if he has strayed.

sanskrit_iast: sam pūṣann adhvana iti mahāntam adhvānam eṣyan pratibhayam vā |
meaning: सम् पूषन्न् अध्वन इति महान्तम् अध्वानम् एष्यन् प्रतिभयम् वा ।
text: 'Journey over the ways, Pushan' (Rig-veda I, 42)--if he is going out on a long or dangerous way.

sanskrit_iast: atha etāny upakalpayīta samāvartamāno maṇim kuṇḍale vastra yugam chatram upānad yugam daṇḍam srajam unmardanam anulepanam āñjanam uṣṇīṣam ity ātmane ca ācāryāya ca |
meaning: अथ एतान्य् उपकल्पयीत समावर्तमानो मणिम् कुण्डले वस्त्र युगम् छत्रम् उपानद् युगम् दण्डम् स्रजम् उन्मर्दनम् अनुलेपनम् आञ्जनम् उष्णीषम् इत्य् आत्मने च आचार्याय च ।
text: Now when returning (home from his teacher) he should get the following things, viz. a jewel (to be tied round the neck), two ear-rings, a pair of garments, a parasol, a pair of shoes, a staff, a wreath, (pounded seed of the Karanga fruit) for rubbing with, ointment, eye salve, a turban; (all that) for himself and for the teacher.

sanskrit_iast: yady ubhayor na vindeta ācāryāya eva |
meaning: यद्य् उभयोर् न विन्देत आचार्याय एव ।
text: If he cannot get it for both, only for the teacher.

sanskrit_iast: samidham tv āhared aparājitāyām diśi yajñiyasya vṛkṣasya |
meaning: समिधम् त्व् आहरेद् अपराजितायाम् दिशि यज्ञियस्य वृक्षस्य ।
text: He then should get a piece of wood of a tree which is sacrificially pure, in a north-eastern direction--

sanskrit_iast: ārdrām anna adya kāmaḥ puṣṭi kāmas tejas kāmo vā brahma varcasa kāma upavātām |
meaning: आर्द्राम् अन्न अद्य कामः पुष्टि कामस् तेजस् कामो वा ब्रह्म वर्चस काम उपवाताम् ।
text: Sappy (wood) if he wishes for the enjoyment of food, or for prosperity, or for splendour; dry (wood), if for holy lustre,

sanskrit_iast: ubhayīm ubhaya kāmaḥ |
meaning: उभयीम् उभय कामः ।
text: (Wood) which is both (sappy and dry, in its different parts), if (he wishes) for both.

sanskrit_iast: upari samidham kṛtvā gām annam ca brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāya gaudānikam karma kurvīta |
meaning: उपरि समिधम् कृत्वा गाम् अन्नम् च ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रदाय गौदानिकम् कर्म कुर्वीत ।
text: Having put the piece of wood on high, and having given a cow and food to the Brahmanas, he should perform the ceremony of shaving the beard.

sanskrit_iast: ātmani mantrānt samnamayet |
meaning: आत्मनि मन्त्रान्त् सम्नमयेत् ।
text: He should alter the texts so that they refer to himself.

sanskrit_iast: eka klītakena |
meaning: एक क्लीतकेन ।
text: With Ekaklitaka (he should perform the rubbing).

sanskrit_iast: śīta uṣṇābhir adbihḥ snātvā yuvam vastrāṇi pīvasā vasāthe ity ahate vāsasī ācchādya aśmanas tejo asi cakṣur me pāhi iti cakṣuṣī āñjayīta |
meaning: शीत उष्णाभिर् अद्बिह्ः स्नात्वा युवम् वस्त्राणि पीवसा वसाथे इत्य् अहते वाससी आच्छाद्य अश्मनस् तेजो असि चक्षुर् मे पाहि इति चक्षुषी आञ्जयीत ।
text: Having washed himself with lukewarm water, and having put on two (new) garments which have not yet been washed, with (the verse), 'Garments with fat splendour you put on, (Mitra and Varuna)' (Rig-veda I, 152, 1); he should anoint his eyes with (the words), 'The sharpness of the stone art thou; protect my eye.'

sanskrit_iast: aśmanas tejo asi śrotram me pāhi iti kuṇḍale ābadhnīta |
meaning: अश्मनस् तेजो असि श्रोत्रम् मे पाहि इति कुण्डले आबध्नीत ।
text: With (the words), 'The sharpness of the stone art thou; protect my ear'--he should tie on the two ear-rings.

sanskrit_iast: anulepanena pāṇī pralipya mukham agre brāhmaṇo anulimpet |
meaning: अनुलेपनेन पाणी प्रलिप्य मुखम् अग्रे ब्राह्मणो अनुलिम्पेत् ।
text: After having salved his two hands with ointment, a Brahmana should salve his head first,

sanskrit_iast: bāhū rājanyaḥ |
meaning: बाहू राजन्यः ।
text: A Raganya his two arms,

sanskrit_iast: udaram vaiśyaḥ |
meaning: उदरम् वैश्यः ।
text: A Vaisya the belly,

sanskrit_iast: upastham strī |
meaning: उपस्थम् स्त्री ।
text: A woman her secret parts,

sanskrit_iast: ūrū saraṇa jīvanaḥ |
meaning: ऊरू सरण जीवनः ।
text: Persons who gain their livelihood by running, their thighs.

sanskrit_iast: anārtā asy anārto aham bhūyāsam iti srajam apibadhnīta |
meaning: अनार्ता अस्य् अनार्तो अहम् भूयासम् इति स्रजम् अपिबध्नीत ।
text: With (the formula), 'Free from pain art thou, free from pain may I become'--he should put on the wreath.

sanskrit_iast: na mālā uktām |
meaning: न माला उक्ताम् ।
text: Not (such a wreath) which is called mala.

sanskrit_iast: mālā iti ced brūyuḥ srag ity abhidhāpayīta |
meaning: माला इति चेद् ब्रूयुः स्रग् इत्य् अभिधापयीत ।
text: If they call it mala, he should cause them to call it srag.

sanskrit_iast: devānām pratiṣṭhe sthaḥ sarvato mā pātam ity upānahāv āsthāya divaś chadmā asi iti chatram ādatte |
meaning: देवानाम् प्रतिष्ठे स्थः सर्वतो मा पातम् इत्य् उपानहाव् आस्थाय दिवश् छद्मा असि इति छत्रम् आदत्ते ।
text: With (the formula), 'The standing-places of the gods are you; protect me from all sides'--he steps into the shoes, and with (the formula), 'The heaven's covering art thou'--he takes the parasol.

sanskrit_iast: veṇur asi vānaspatyo asi sarvato mā pāhi iti vaiṇavam daṇḍam |
meaning: वेणुर् असि वानस्पत्यो असि सर्वतो मा पाहि इति वैणवम् दण्डम् ।
text: With (the formula), 'Reed thou art; from the tree thou descendest; protect me from all sides'--(he takes) a staff of reed.

sanskrit_iast: āyuṣyam it sūktena maṇim kaṇṭhe pratimucya uṣṇīṣam kṛtvā tiṣṭhant samidham ādadhyāt |
meaning: आयुष्यम् इत् सूक्तेन मणिम् कण्ठे प्रतिमुच्य उष्णीषम् कृत्वा तिष्ठन्त् समिधम् आदध्यात् ।
text: Having with the hymn 'Giving life' tied the jewel to his neck and arranged the turban (on his head), he should standing put the piece of wood (on the fire).

sanskrit_iast: smṛtam nindā ca vidyā ca śraddhā prajñā ca pañcamī | iṣṭam dattam adhītam ca kṛtam satyam śrutam vratam | yad agneḥ sa indrasya saprajāpatikasya saṛṣikasya saṛṣi rājanyasya sākāśasya sātīkāśasya sānukāśasya sapratīkāśasya sadeva manuṣyasya sagandharva apsaraskasya saha araṇyaiś ca paśubhir grāmyaiś ca yan ma ātmana ātmani vratam tan me sarva vratam idam aham agne sarva vrato bhavāmi svāhā iti |
meaning: स्मृतम् निन्दा च विद्या च श्रद्धा प्रज्ञा च पञ्चमी । इष्टम् दत्तम् अधीतम् च कृतम् सत्यम् श्रुतम् व्रतम् । यद् अग्नेः स इन्द्रस्य सप्रजापतिकस्य सऋषिकस्य सऋषि राजन्यस्य साकाशस्य सातीकाशस्य सानुकाशस्य सप्रतीकाशस्य सदेव मनुष्यस्य सगन्धर्व अप्सरस्कस्य सह अरण्यैश् च पशुभिर् ग्राम्यैश् च यन् म आत्मन आत्मनि व्रतम् तन् मे सर्व व्रतम् इदम् अहम् अग्ने सर्व व्रतो भवामि स्वाहा इति ।
