text: (He says), 'Memory and reproach and knowledge, faith, and wisdom as the fifth, what is sacrificed, and what is given, and what is studied, and what is done, truth, learning, vow-- 'The vow which belongs to Agni together with Indra, with Pragapati, with the Rishis, with the royal ones among the Rishis, with the Fathers, with the royal ones among the Fathers, with the human beings, with the royal ones among the human beings, with shine, over-shine, after-shine, counter-shine, with gods and men, with Gandharvas and Apsaras, with wild animals and domestic animals,--the vow, belonging to my own self, dwelling in my own self, that is my universal vow. Hereby, O Agni, I become addicted to the universal vow. Svaha!'

sanskrit_iast: mama agne varca iti pratyṛcam samidho abhyādadhyāt |
meaning: मम अग्ने वर्च इति प्रत्यृचम् समिधो अभ्यादध्यात् ।
text: With (the hymn), 'Mine, Agni, be vigour' (Rig-veda X, 128, 1), verse by verse, he should put pieces of wood (on the fire).

sanskrit_iast: yatra enam pūjayiṣyanto bhavanti tatra etām rātrīm vaset |
meaning: यत्र एनम् पूजयिष्यन्तो भवन्ति तत्र एताम् रात्रीम् वसेत् ।
text: He should pass that night at a place where they will do honour to him.

sanskrit_iast: vidyā ante gurum arthena nimantrya kṛta anujñātasya vā snānam |
meaning: विद्या अन्ते गुरुम् अर्थेन निमन्त्र्य कृत अनुज्ञातस्य वा स्नानम् ।
text: When, after having finished his (task of) learning, he has offered something to the teacher, or has received his permission, he should take a bath (which signifies the end of his studentship).

sanskrit_iast: tasya etāni vratāni bhavanti |
meaning: तस्य एतानि व्रतानि भवन्ति ।
text: He (i.e. the Snataka) has to keep the following observances:

sanskrit_iast: na naktam snāyān na nagnaḥ snāyān na nagnaḥ śayīta na nagnām striyam īkṣeta anyatra maithunād varṣati na dhāven na vṛkṣam ārohen na kūpam avarohen na bāhubhyām nadīm taren na saṃśayam abhyāpadyeta mahad vai bhūtam snātako bhavati iti vijñāyate |
meaning: न नक्तम् स्नायान् न नग्नः स्नायान् न नग्नः शयीत न नग्नाम् स्त्रियम् ईक्षेत अन्यत्र मैथुनाद् वर्षति न धावेन् न वृक्षम् आरोहेन् न कूपम् अवरोहेन् न बाहुभ्याम् नदीम् तरेन् न संशयम् अभ्यापद्येत महद् वै भूतम् स्नातको भवति इति विज्ञायते ।

sanskrit_iast: gurave prasrakṣyamāṇo nāma prabruvīta |
meaning: गुरवे प्रस्रक्ष्यमाणो नाम प्रब्रुवीत ।
text: If (a student) wishes to be dismissed (by his teacher), he should pronounce before the teacher his (i.e. the teacher's?) name--

sanskrit_iast: idam vatsyāmo bho iti |
meaning: इदम् वत्स्यामो भो इति ।
text: (And should say), 'Here we will dwell, sir!'

sanskrit_iast: uccair ūrdhvam nāmnaḥ |
meaning: उच्चैर् ऊर्ध्वम् नाम्नः ।
text: With a loud voice (the words) following after the name.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇa apānayor upāṃśu |
meaning: प्राण अपानयोर् उपांशु ।
text: 'Of inhalation and exhalation'--(this he says) with a low voice,

sanskrit_iast: ā mandrair indra haribhir iti ca |
meaning: आ मन्द्रैर् इन्द्र हरिभिर् इति च ।
text: And (the verse), 'Come hither, Indra, with thy lovely-sounding, fallow-coloured (horses)' (Rig-veda III, 45, 1).

sanskrit_iast: ato vṛddho japati prāṇa apānayor uruvyacāstayā prapadye devāya savitre paridadāmi ity ṛcam ca |
meaning: अतो वृद्धो जपति प्राण अपानयोर् उरुव्यचास्तया प्रपद्ये देवाय सवित्रे परिददामि इत्य् ऋचम् च ।
text: The aged one then murmurs, 'To inhalation and exhalation I, the wide-extended one, resort with thee. To the god Savitri I give thee in charge'--and the verse.

sanskrit_iast: samāpya om prāk svasti iti japitvā mahi trīṇām ity anumantrya |
meaning: समाप्य ओम् प्राक् स्वस्ति इति जपित्वा महि त्रीणाम् इत्य् अनुमन्त्र्य ।
text: When he has finished (that verse), and has muttered, 'Om! Forwards! Blessing!' and recited (over the student the hymn), 'The great bliss of the three' (Rig-veda X, 185)--(he should dismiss him).

sanskrit_iast: evam atiṣṛṣṭasya na kutaścid bhayam bhavati iti vijñāyate |
meaning: एवम् अतिषृष्टस्य न कुतश्चिद् भयम् भवति इति विज्ञायते ।
text: On one who has been thus dismissed, danger comes from no side--thus it is understood (in the Sruti).

sanskrit_iast: vayasām amanojñā vācaḥ śrutvā kanidradaj januṣam prabruvāṇa iti sūkte japed devīm vācam ajanayanta devā iti ca |
meaning: वयसाम् अमनोज्ञा वाचः श्रुत्वा कनिद्रदज् जनुषम् प्रब्रुवाण इति सूक्ते जपेद् देवीम् वाचम् अजनयन्त देवा इति च ।
text: If he hears (on his way) disagreeable voices of birds, he should murmur the two hymns, 'Shrieking, manifesting his being' (Rig-veda II, 42, 43), and (the verse), 'The divine voice have the gods created' (Rig-veda VIII, 100, 11).

sanskrit_iast: stuhi śrutam gartasadam yuvānam iti mṛgasya |
meaning: स्तुहि श्रुतम् गर्तसदम् युवानम् इति मृगस्य ।
text: 'Praise the renowned youth who sits on the war-chariot' (Rig-veda II, 33, 11)--if (he hears disagreeable voices) of deer.

sanskrit_iast: yasyā diśo bibhīyād yasmād vā tām diśam ulmukam ubhayataḥ pradīptam pratyasyen mantham vā prasavyam āloḍya abhayam mitrāvaruṇā mahyam astv arciṣā śatrūn dahatam pratītya | mā jñātāram mā pratiṣṭhām vindantu mitho bhindānā upayantu mṛtyum iti |
meaning: यस्या दिशो बिभीयाद् यस्माद् वा ताम् दिशम् उल्मुकम् उभयतः प्रदीप्तम् प्रत्यस्येन् मन्थम् वा प्रसव्यम् आलोड्य अभयम् मित्रावरुणा मह्यम् अस्त्व् अर्चिषा शत्रून् दहतम् प्रतीत्य । मा ज्ञातारम् मा प्रतिष्ठाम् विन्दन्तु मिथो भिन्दाना उपयन्तु मृत्युम् इति ।
text: From the direction, or from the (being) from which he expects danger, towards that direction he should throw a fire-brand, burning on both sides, or having twirled about a churning-stick from the right to the left, with (the words), 'Safety be to me, Mitra and Varuna; encounter the foes and burn them up with your flame. May they find none who knows them and no support; divided by discord may they go to death'--

sanskrit_iast: saṃsṛṣṭam dhanam ubhayam samākṛtam iti mantham nyañcam karoti |
meaning: संसृष्टम् धनम् उभयम् समाकृतम् इति मन्थम् न्यञ्चम् करोति ।
text: He turns the churning-stick downwards with (the verse), 'The combined wealth of both, heaped together' (Rig-veda X, 84, 7).

sanskrit_iast: sarvato bhayād anājñātād aṣṭāv ājya āhutīr juhuyāt pṛthivī vṛtā sāgninā vṛtā tayā vṛtayā vartryā yasmād bhayād bibhemi tad vāraye svāhā | antarikṣam vṛtam tad vāyunā vṛtam tena vṛtena vartreṇa yasmād bhayād bibhemi tad vāraye svāhā | dyaur vṛtā sādityena vṛtā tayā vṛtayā vartryā yasmād bhayād bibhemi tad vāraye svāhā | āpo vṛtās tā varuṇena vṛtās tābhir vṛtābhir vartrībhir yasmād bhayād bibhemi tad vāraye svāhā | prajā vṛtās tāḥ prāṇena vṛtās tābhir vṛtābhir vartrībhir yasmād bhayād bibhemi tad vāraye svāhā | vedā vṛtā te chandobhir vṛtās tair vṛtair vartrair yasmād bibhemi tad vāraye svāhā | sarvam vṛtam tad brahmaṇā vṛtam tena vṛtena vartreṇa yasmād bhayād bibhemi tad vāraye svāhā iti |
meaning: सर्वतो भयाद् अनाज्ञाताद् अष्टाव् आज्य आहुतीर् जुहुयात् पृथिवी वृता साग्निना वृता तया वृतया वर्त्र्या यस्माद् भयाद् बिभेमि तद् वारये स्वाहा । अन्तरिक्षम् वृतम् तद् वायुना वृतम् तेन वृतेन वर्त्रेण यस्माद् भयाद् बिभेमि तद् वारये स्वाहा । द्यौर् वृता सादित्येन वृता तया वृतया वर्त्र्या यस्माद् भयाद् बिभेमि तद् वारये स्वाहा । आपो वृतास् ता वरुणेन वृतास् ताभिर् वृताभिर् वर्त्रीभिर् यस्माद् भयाद् बिभेमि तद् वारये स्वाहा । प्रजा वृतास् ताः प्राणेन वृतास् ताभिर् वृताभिर् वर्त्रीभिर् यस्माद् भयाद् बिभेमि तद् वारये स्वाहा । वेदा वृता ते छन्दोभिर् वृतास् तैर् वृतैर् वर्त्रैर् यस्माद् बिभेमि तद् वारये स्वाहा । सर्वम् वृतम् तद् ब्रह्मणा वृतम् तेन वृतेन वर्त्रेण यस्माद् भयाद् बिभेमि तद् वारये स्वाहा इति ।
text: If unknown danger from all sides (menaces him), he should sacrifice eight Agya oblations with (the formulas), 'Prithivi (the earth) is covered; she is covered by Agni. By her, the covered one, the covering one, I ward off the danger of which I am in fear. Svaha! 'Antariksha (the air) is covered; it is covered by Vayu. By it, the covered, the covering, I ward off the danger of which I am in fear. Svaha! 'Dyaus (the heaven) is covered; she is covered by Aditya (the sun). By her, &c. 'The quarters (of the horizon) are covered; they are covered by Kandramas (the moon). By them, &c. 'The waters are covered; they are covered by Varuna. By them, &c. 'The creatures are covered; they are covered by Prana (the breath). By them, &c. 'The Vedas are covered; they are covered by the metres. By them, &c. 'All is covered; it is covered by Brahman. By it, &c. Svaha!'

sanskrit_iast: atha aparājitāyām diśy avasthāya svasty ātreyam japati yata indra bhayāmaha iti ca sūkta śeṣam |
meaning: अथ अपराजितायाम् दिश्य् अवस्थाय स्वस्त्य् आत्रेयम् जपति यत इन्द्र भयामह इति च सूक्त शेषम् ।
text: Then, stationing himself towards the north, east, he murmurs the Svasti-Atreya and, 'Of what we are in fear, Indra' (Rig-veda VIII, 61, 13 seqq.), down to the end of the hymn.

sanskrit_iast: saṃgrāme samupoḷhe rājānam samnāhayet |
meaning: संग्रामे समुपोऌहे राजानम् सम्नाहयेत् ।
text: When a battle is beginning, (the royal Purohita) should cause the king to put on his armour (in the following way).

sanskrit_iast: ā tvā ahārṣam iti paścād rathasya avasthāya |
meaning: आ त्वा अहार्षम् इति पश्चाद् रथस्य अवस्थाय ।
text: (The Purohita) stations himself to the west of (the king's) chariot with (the hymn?), 'I have brought thee hither; be here' (Rig-veda X, 173).

sanskrit_iast: jīmūtasya iva bhavati pratīkam iti kavacam prayacchet |
meaning: जीमूतस्य इव भवति प्रतीकम् इति कवचम् प्रयच्छेत् ।
text: With (the verse), 'Like a thunder-cloud is his countenance' (Rig-veda VI, 75, 1), he should tender the coat of mail to him.

sanskrit_iast: uttarayā dhanuḥ |
meaning: उत्तरया धनुः ।
text: With the following (verse) the bow.

sanskrit_iast: uttarām vācayet |
meaning: उत्तराम् वाचयेत् ।
text: The following (verse) he should cause him to repeat.

sanskrit_iast: svayam caturthīm japet |
meaning: स्वयम् चतुर्थीम् जपेत् ।
text: He should murmur himself the fourth.

sanskrit_iast: pañcamyā iṣudhim prayacchet |
meaning: पञ्चम्या इषुधिम् प्रयच्छेत् ।
text: With the fifth he should tender the quiver to him.

sanskrit_iast: abhipravartamāne ṣaṣṭhīm |
meaning: अभिप्रवर्तमाने षष्ठीम् ।
text: When (the king) starts, the sixth.

sanskrit_iast: saptamyā aśvān |
meaning: सप्तम्या अश्वान् ।
text: The seventh (he recites) over the horses.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭamīm iṣūn avekṣamāṇam vācayati |
meaning: अष्टमीम् इषून् अवेक्षमाणम् वाचयति ।
text: The eighth he should cause (the king) to repeat while looking at the arrows;

sanskrit_iast: ahir iva bhogaiḥ paryeti bāhum iti taḷam nahyamānam |
meaning: अहिर् इव भोगैः पर्येति बाहुम् इति तऌअम् नह्यमानम् ।
text: (The verse), 'Like a serpent it encircles the arm with its windings' (Rig-veda VI, 75, 14), when he ties to his arm the leather (by which the arm is protected against the bow-string).

sanskrit_iast: atha enam sārayamāṇam upāruhya abhīvartam vācayati pra yo vām mitrā varuṇa iti ca dve
meaning: अथ एनम् सारयमाणम् उपारुह्य अभीवर्तम् वाचयति प्र यो वाम् मित्रा वरुण इति च द्वे
text: He then mounts up to (the king on his chariot), while he is driving, and causes him to repeat the Abhivarta hymn (Rig-veda X, 174) and the two verses, 'He who, Mitra and Varuna' (Rig-veda VIII, 101, 3 seq.).

sanskrit_iast: atha enam anvīkṣeta apratirathe śāsa sauparṇaiḥ |
meaning: अथ एनम् अन्वीक्षेत अप्रतिरथे शास सौपर्णैः ।
text: He then should look at him with the Apratiratha, Sasa, and Sauparna hymns.

sanskrit_iast: pradhārayantu madhuno ghṛtasya ity etat sauparṇam |
meaning: प्रधारयन्तु मधुनो घृतस्य इत्य् एतत् सौपर्णम् ।
text: The Sauparna is (the hymn), 'May the streams of honey and ghee flow forwards.'

sanskrit_iast: sarvā diśo anuparyāyāt |
meaning: सर्वा दिशो अनुपर्यायात् ।
text: (The king) should drive (in his chariot successively) to all quarters (of the horizon).

sanskrit_iast: ādityam auśanasam vā avasthāya prayodhayet |
meaning: आदित्यम् औशनसम् वा अवस्थाय प्रयोधयेत् ।
text: He should commence the battle in the line of battle invented by Aditya or by Usanas.

sanskrit_iast: upaśvāsaya pṛthivīm uta dyām iti tṛcena dundubhim abhimṛśet |
meaning: उपश्वासय पृथिवीम् उत द्याम् इति तृचेन दुन्दुभिम् अभिमृशेत् ।
text: He should touch the drum with the three verses, 'Fill earth and heaven with thy roar' (Rig-veda VI, 47, 29 seqq.).

sanskrit_iast: avasṛṣṭā parāpata iti iṣūn visarjayet |
meaning: अवसृष्टा परापत इति इषून् विसर्जयेत् ।
text: With (the verse), 'Shot off fall down' (Rig-veda VI, 75, 16), he should shoot off the arrows.

sanskrit_iast: yatra bāṇāḥ sampatanti iti yudhyamāneṣu japet |
meaning: यत्र बाणाः सम्पतन्ति इति युध्यमानेषु जपेत् ।
text: 'Where the arrows fly' (l.l. v. 17)--this (verse) he should murmur while they are fighting.

sanskrit_iast: saṃśiṣyād vā saṃśiṣyād vā |
meaning: संशिष्याद् वा संशिष्याद् वा ।
text: Or he should teach (the king the texts mentioned). Or he should teach (the king).

sanskrit_iast: āhita agnim ced upatapet prācyām udīcyām aparājitāyām vā diśy udavasyet |
meaning: आहित अग्निम् चेद् उपतपेत् प्राच्याम् उदीच्याम् अपराजितायाम् वा दिश्य् उदवस्येत् ।
text: If disease befalls one who has set up the (sacred Srauta) fires, he should leave his home (and go away) to the eastern, or northern, or north-eastern direction.

sanskrit_iast: grāma kāmā agnaya ity udāharanti |
meaning: ग्राम कामा अग्नय इत्य् उदाहरन्ति ।
text: 'The sacred fires are fond of the village'--thus it is said.

sanskrit_iast: āśaṃsanta enam grāmam ājigamiṣanto agadam kuryur iti ha vijñāyate |
meaning: आशंसन्त एनम् ग्रामम् आजिगमिषन्तो अगदम् कुर्युर् इति ह विज्ञायते ।
text: Longing for it, desirous of returning to the village they might restore him to health-thus it is understood (in the Sruti).

sanskrit_iast: agadaḥ somena paśunā iṣṭyā iṣṭvā āvasyet |
meaning: अगदः सोमेन पशुना इष्ट्या इष्ट्वा आवस्येत् ।
text: Being restored to health, he should offer a Soma sacrifice, or an animal sacrifice, or an ordinary sacrifice, and take his dwelling (again in the village).

sanskrit_iast: aniṣṭvā vā |
meaning: अनिष्ट्वा वा ।
text: Or without such a sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: saṃsthite bhūmi bhāgam khānayed dakṣiṇa pūrvasyām diśi dakṣiṇa aparasyām vā |
meaning: संस्थिते भूमि भागम् खानयेद् दक्षिण पूर्वस्याम् दिशि दक्षिण अपरस्याम् वा ।
text: If he dies, one should have a piece of ground dug up to the south-east or to the south-west--

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇā pravaṇam prāg dakṣiṇā pravaṇam vā |
meaning: दक्षिणा प्रवणम् प्राग् दक्षिणा प्रवणम् वा ।
text: At a place which is inclined towards the south or towards the south-east.

sanskrit_iast: pratyag dakṣiṇā pravaṇam ity eke |
meaning: प्रत्यग् दक्षिणा प्रवणम् इत्य् एके ।
text: According to some (teachers), inclined towards south-west.

sanskrit_iast: yāvān udbāhukaḥ puruṣas tāvad āyāmam |
meaning: यावान् उद्बाहुकः पुरुषस् तावद् आयामम् ।
text: (The piece of ground dug up should be) of the length of a man with upraised arms,

sanskrit_iast: vyāma mātram tiryak |
meaning: व्याम मात्रम् तिर्यक् ।
text: Of the breadth of one Vyama (fathom),

sanskrit_iast: vitasty avāk |
meaning: वितस्त्य् अवाक् ।
text: Of the depth of one Vitasti (span).

sanskrit_iast: abhita ākāśam śmaśānam |
meaning: अभित आकाशम् श्मशानम् ।
text: The cemetery should be free from all sides.

sanskrit_iast: bahula oṣadhikam |
meaning: बहुल ओषधिकम् ।
text: It should be fertile in herbs.

sanskrit_iast: kaṇṭaki kṣīriṇas tv iti yathā uktam purastāt |
meaning: कण्टकि क्षीरिणस् त्व् इति यथा उक्तम् पुरस्तात् ।
text: But plants with thorns and with milky juice, &c., as stated above.

sanskrit_iast: yatra sarvata āpaḥ prasyanderann etad ādahanasya lakṣaṇam śmaśānasya |
meaning: यत्र सर्वत आपः प्रस्यन्देरन्न् एतद् आदहनस्य लक्षणम् श्मशानस्य ।
text: From which the waters flow off to all sides: this is a characteristic required for the cemetery (smasana) where the body is to be burned.

sanskrit_iast: keśa śmaśru loma nakhāni vāpayanti ity uktam purastāt |
meaning: केश श्मश्रु लोम नखानि वापयन्ति इत्य् उक्तम् पुरस्तात् ।
text: 'They cut off (from the dead body) the hair, the beard, the hairs of the body, and the nails'--this has been stated above.

sanskrit_iast: vigulpham barhir ājyam ca |
meaning: विगुल्फम् बर्हिर् आज्यम् च ।
text: (They should provide) plenty of sacrificial grass and of butter.

sanskrit_iast: dadhany atra sarpir ānayanti |
meaning: दधन्य् अत्र सर्पिर् आनयन्ति ।
text: They here pour clarified butter into curds.

sanskrit_iast: etat pitryam pṛṣad ājyam |
meaning: एतत् पित्र्यम् पृषद् आज्यम् ।
text: This is the 'sprinkled butter' used for the Fathers (i.e. Manes).

sanskrit_iast: atha etām diśam agnīn nayanti yajña pātrāṇi ca |
meaning: अथ एताम् दिशम् अग्नीन् नयन्ति यज्ञ पात्राणि च ।
text: (The relations of the dead person) now carry (his sacred) fires and (his) sacrificial vessels in that direction.

sanskrit_iast: anvañcam pretam ayujo amithunāḥ pravayasaḥ |
meaning: अन्वञ्चम् प्रेतम् अयुजो अमिथुनाः प्रवयसः ।
text: After them aged persons forming an odd number, men and women not going together, (carry) the dead body.

sanskrit_iast: pīṭha cakreṇa go yuktena ity eke |
meaning: पीठ चक्रेण गो युक्तेन इत्य् एके ।
text: Some (say) that (the dead body should be carried) in a cart with a seat, drawn by cows.

sanskrit_iast: anustaraṇīm |
meaning: अनुस्तरणीम् ।
text: (Some prescribe) a she-animal for covering (the dead body with its limbs):

sanskrit_iast: gām |
meaning: गाम् ।
text: A cow,

sanskrit_iast: ajām vā eka varṇām |
meaning: अजाम् वा एक वर्णाम् ।
text: Or a she-goat of one colour.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇām eke |
meaning: कृष्णाम् एके ।
text: Some (take) a black one.

sanskrit_iast: savye bāhau baddhvā anusaṃkālayanti |
meaning: सव्ये बाहौ बद्ध्वा अनुसंकालयन्ति ।
text: They tie (a rope) to its left fore-foot and lead it behind (the dead body).

sanskrit_iast: anvañco amātyā adho nivītāḥ pravṛtta śikhā jyeṣṭha prathamāḥ kaniṣṭha jaghanyāḥ |
meaning: अन्वञ्चो अमात्या अधो निवीताः प्रवृत्त शिखा ज्येष्ठ प्रथमाः कनिष्ठ जघन्याः ।
text: Then follow the relations (of the dead person), wearing their sacrificial cords below (round their body), with the hair-locks untied, the older fines first, the younger ones last.

sanskrit_iast: prāpya evam bhūmi bhāgam kartā udakena śamī śākhayā triḥ prasavyam āyatanam parivrajan prokṣaty apeta vīta vi ca sarpatāta iti |
meaning: प्राप्य एवम् भूमि भागम् कर्ता उदकेन शमी शाखया त्रिः प्रसव्यम् आयतनम् परिव्रजन् प्रोक्षत्य् अपेत वीत वि च सर्पतात इति ।
text: When they have thus arrived at the place, the performer (of the rites) walks three times round the spot with his left side turned towards it, and with a Sami branch sprinkles water on it, with (the verse), 'Go away, withdraw, and depart from here' (Rig-veda X, 14, 9).

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇa pūrva uddhānta āhavanīyam nidadhāti |
meaning: दक्षिण पूर्व उद्धान्त आहवनीयम् निदधाति ।
text: To the south-east, on an elevated corner (of that place), he places the Ahavaniya fire,

sanskrit_iast: uttara paścime gārhapatyam |
meaning: उत्तर पश्चिमे गार्हपत्यम् ।
text: To the north-west the Garhapatya fire,

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇa paścime dakṣiṇam |
meaning: दक्षिण पश्चिमे दक्षिणम् ।
text: To the south-west the Dakshina fire.

sanskrit_iast: atha enam antar vedi idhma citim cinoti yo jānāti |
meaning: अथ एनम् अन्तर् वेदि इध्म चितिम् चिनोति यो जानाति ।
text: After that a person that knows (how to do it), piles up between the fires a pile of fuel.

sanskrit_iast: tasmin barhir āstīrya kṛṣṇa ajinam ca uttara loma tasmin pretam saṃveśayanty uttareṇa gārhapatyam hṛtvā āhavanīyam abhiśirasam |
meaning: तस्मिन् बर्हिर् आस्तीर्य कृष्ण अजिनम् च उत्तर लोम तस्मिन् प्रेतम् संवेशयन्त्य् उत्तरेण गार्हपत्यम् हृत्वा आहवनीयम् अभिशिरसम् ।
text: After sacrificial grass and a black antelope's skin with the hair outside has been spread out there, they place the dead body thereon, which they have carried so as to pass by the Garhapatya fire on its north-side, turning its head towards the Ahavaniya.

sanskrit_iast: uttarataḥ patnīm |
meaning: उत्तरतः पत्नीम् ।
text: To the north (of the body they place) the wife (of the deceased),

sanskrit_iast: dhanuś ca kṣatriyāya |
meaning: धनुश् च क्षत्रियाय ।
text: And a bow for a Kshatriya.

sanskrit_iast: tām utthāpayed devaraḥ pati sthānīyo antevāsī jarad dāso vā udīrṣva nāry abhi jīva lokam iti |
meaning: ताम् उत्थापयेद् देवरः पति स्थानीयो अन्तेवासी जरद् दासो वा उदीर्ष्व नार्य् अभि जीव लोकम् इति ।
text: Her brother-in-law, being a representative of her husband, or a pupil (of her husband), or an aged servant, should cause her to rise (from that place) with (the verse), 'Arise, O wife, to the world of life' (Rig-veda X, 18, 8).

sanskrit_iast: kartā vṛṣale japet |
meaning: कर्ता वृषले जपेत् ।
text: The performer (of the rites) should murmur (that verse), if a Sudra (makes her rise from the pile).

sanskrit_iast: dhanur hastād ādadāno mṛtasya iti dhanuḥ |
meaning: धनुर् हस्ताद् आददानो मृतस्य इति धनुः ।
text: With (the verse), 'Taking the bow out of the hand of the deceased' (Rig-veda X, 18, 9), (he takes away) the bow.

sanskrit_iast: uktam vṛṣale |
meaning: उक्तम् वृषले ।
text: It has been stated (what is to be done) in case a Sudra (should perform this act).

sanskrit_iast: adhijyam kṛtvā saṃcitim acitvā saṃśīrya anupraharet |
meaning: अधिज्यम् कृत्वा संचितिम् अचित्वा संशीर्य अनुप्रहरेत् ।
text: Having bent the bow, he should, before the piling up (of the things mentioned below, which are put on the dead body) is done, break it to pieces, and throw it (on the pile).

sanskrit_iast: atha etāni pātrāṇi yojayet |
meaning: अथ एतानि पात्राणि योजयेत् ।
text: He should then put the following (sacrificial) implements (on the dead body).

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇe haste juhūm |
meaning: दक्षिणे हस्ते जुहूम् ।
text: Into the right hand the (spoon called) Guhu.

sanskrit_iast: savya upabhṛtam |
meaning: सव्य उपभृतम् ।
text: Into the left the (other spoon called) Upabhrit.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇe pārśve sphyam savye agni hotra havaṇīm |
meaning: दक्षिणे पार्श्वे स्फ्यम् सव्ये अग्नि होत्र हवणीम् ।
text: On his right side the (wooden sacrificial sword called) Sphya, on his left (side) the Agnihotrahavani (i.e. the ladle with which the Agnihotra oblations are sacrificed).

sanskrit_iast: urasi dhruvām śirasi kapālāni datsu grāvṇaḥ |
meaning: उरसि ध्रुवाम् शिरसि कपालानि दत्सु ग्राव्णः ।
text: On his chest the (big sacrificial ladle called) Dhruva. On his head the dishes. On his teeth the pressing-stones.

sanskrit_iast: nāsikayoḥ sruvau |
meaning: नासिकयोः स्रुवौ ।
text: On the two sides of his nose the two (smaller sacrificial ladles called) Sruvas.

sanskrit_iast: bhittvā ca ekam |
meaning: भित्त्वा च एकम् ।
text: Or, if there is only one (Sruva), breaking it (in two pieces).

sanskrit_iast: karṇayoḥ prāśitra haraṇe |
meaning: कर्णयोः प्राशित्र हरणे ।
text: On his two ears the two Prasitraharanas (i.e. the vessels into which the portion of the sacrificial food belonging to the Brahman is put).

sanskrit_iast: bhittvā ca ekam |
meaning: भित्त्वा च एकम् ।
text: Or, if there is only one (Prasitraharana), breaking it (in two pieces).

sanskrit_iast: udare pātrīm |
meaning: उदरे पात्रीम् ।
text: On his belly the (vessel called) Patri,

sanskrit_iast: samavattadhānam ca camasam |
meaning: समवत्तधानम् च चमसम् ।
text: And the cup into which the cut-off portions (of the sacrificial food) are put.

sanskrit_iast: upasthe śamyām |
meaning: उपस्थे शम्याम् ।
text: On his secret parts the (staff called) Samya.

sanskrit_iast: araṇī ūrvoḥ |
meaning: अरणी ऊर्वोः ।
text: On his thighs the two kindling woods.

sanskrit_iast: ulūkhala musale jaṅghayoḥ |
meaning: उलूखल मुसले जङ्घयोः ।
text: On his legs the mortar and the pestle.

sanskrit_iast: pādayoś śūrpe |
meaning: पादयोश् शूर्पे ।
text: On his feet the two baskets.

sanskrit_iast: chittvā ca ekam |
meaning: छित्त्वा च एकम् ।
text: Or, if there is only one (basket), tearing it (in two pieces).

sanskrit_iast: āsecanavanti pṛṣad ājyasya pūrayanti |
meaning: आसेचनवन्ति पृषद् आज्यस्य पूरयन्ति ।
text: Those (of the implements) which have a hollow (into which liquids can be poured), are filled with sprinkled butter.

sanskrit_iast: amā putro dṛṣad upale kurvīta |
meaning: अमा पुत्रो दृषद् उपले कुर्वीत ।
text: The son (of the deceased person) should take the under and the upper mill-stone for himself.

sanskrit_iast: lauhāyasam ca kaulālam |
meaning: लौहायसम् च कौलालम् ।
text: And the implements made of copper, iron, and earthenware.

sanskrit_iast: anustaraṇyā vapām utkhidya śiro mukham pracchādayed agner varma pari gobhir vyayasva iti |
meaning: अनुस्तरण्या वपाम् उत्खिद्य शिरो मुखम् प्रच्छादयेद् अग्नेर् वर्म परि गोभिर् व्ययस्व इति ।
text: Taking out the omentum of the she-animal he should cover therewith the head and the mouth (of the dead person) with the verse, 'Put on the armour (which will protect thee) against Agni, by (that which comes from) the cows' (Rig-veda X, 16, 7).

sanskrit_iast: vṛkkā uddhṛtya pāṇyor ādadhyād ati drava sārameyau śvānāv iti dakṣiṇe dakṣiṇam savye savyam |
meaning: वृक्का उद्धृत्य पाण्योर् आदध्याद् अति द्रव सारमेयौ श्वानाव् इति दक्षिणे दक्षिणम् सव्ये सव्यम् ।
text: Taking out the kidneys (of the animal) he should lay them into the hands (of the dead body) with the verse, 'Escape the two hounds, the sons of Sarama' (Rig-veda X, 14, 10), the right (kidney) into the right (hand), the left into the left.

sanskrit_iast: hṛdaye hṛdayam |
meaning: हृदये हृदयम् ।
text: The heart (of the animal he puts) on the heart (of the deceased).

sanskrit_iast: piṇḍyau ca eke |
meaning: पिण्ड्यौ च एके ।
text: And two lumps (of flour or rice), according to some (teachers).

sanskrit_iast: vṛkka apacāra ity eke |
meaning: वृक्क अपचार इत्य् एके ।
text: (Only) if there are no kidneys, according to some (teachers).

sanskrit_iast: sarvām yathā aṅgam vinikṣipya carmaṇā pracchādya imam agne camasam mā vijihvara iti praṇītā praṇayanam anumantrayate |
meaning: सर्वाम् यथा अङ्गम् विनिक्षिप्य चर्मणा प्रच्छाद्य इमम् अग्ने चमसम् मा विजिह्वर इति प्रणीता प्रणयनम् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text: Having distributed the whole (animal), limb by limb (placing its different limbs on the corresponding limbs of the deceased), and having covered it with its hide, he recites, when the Pranita water is carried forward, (the verse), 'Agni, do not overturn this cup' (Rig-veda X, 16, 8).

sanskrit_iast: savyam jān ācya dakṣiṇa agnāv ājya āhutīr juhuyād agnaye svāhā kāmāya svāhā lokāya svāhā anumataye svāhā iti |
meaning: सव्यम् जान् आच्य दक्षिण अग्नाव् आज्य आहुतीर् जुहुयाद् अग्नये स्वाहा कामाय स्वाहा लोकाय स्वाहा अनुमतये स्वाहा इति ।
text: Bending his left knee he should sacrifice Agya oblations into the Dakshina fire with (the formulas), 'To Agni svaha! To Kama svaha! To the world svaha! To Anumati svaha!'

sanskrit_iast: pañcamīm urasi pretasya asmād vai tvam ajāyathā ayam tvad adhi jāyatām asau svargāya lokāya svāhā iti |
meaning: पञ्चमीम् उरसि प्रेतस्य अस्माद् वै त्वम् अजायथा अयम् त्वद् अधि जायताम् असौ स्वर्गाय लोकाय स्वाहा इति ।
text: A fifth (oblation) on the chest of the deceased with (the formula), 'From this one verily thou hast been born. May he now be born out of thee, N.N.! To the heaven-world svaha!'

sanskrit_iast: preṣyati yugapad agnīn prajvālayata iti |
meaning: प्रेष्यति युगपद् अग्नीन् प्रज्वालयत इति ।
text: He gives order, 'Light the fires together.'

sanskrit_iast: āhavanīyaś cet pūrvam prāpnuyāt svarga loka enam prāpad iti vidyād rātsyaty asāv amutra evam ayam asminn iti putraḥ |
meaning: आहवनीयश् चेत् पूर्वम् प्राप्नुयात् स्वर्ग लोक एनम् प्रापद् इति विद्याद् रात्स्यत्य् असाव् अमुत्र एवम् अयम् अस्मिन्न् इति पुत्रः ।
text: If the Ahavaniya fire reaches (the body) first, he should know, 'It has reached him in the heaven-world. He will live there in prosperity, and so will this one, i.e. his son, in this world.'

sanskrit_iast: gārhapatyaś cet pūrvam prāpnuyād antarikṣa loka enam prāpad iti vidyād rātsyaty asāv amutra evam ayam asminn iti putraḥ |
meaning: गार्हपत्यश् चेत् पूर्वम् प्राप्नुयाद् अन्तरिक्ष लोक एनम् प्रापद् इति विद्याद् रात्स्यत्य् असाव् अमुत्र एवम् अयम् अस्मिन्न् इति पुत्रः ।
text: If the Garhapatya fire reaches (the body) first, he should know, 'It has reached him in the air-world. He will live there in prosperity, and so will this one, i.e. his son, in this world.'

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇa agniś cet pūrvam prāpnuyān manuṣya loka enam prāpad iti vidyād rātsyaty asāv amitra evam ayam asminn iti putraḥ |
meaning: दक्षिण अग्निश् चेत् पूर्वम् प्राप्नुयान् मनुष्य लोक एनम् प्रापद् इति विद्याद् रात्स्यत्य् असाव् अमित्र एवम् अयम् अस्मिन्न् इति पुत्रः ।
text: If the Dakshina fire reaches (the body) first, he should know, 'It has reached him in the world of men. He will live there in prosperity, and so will this one, i.e. his son, in this world.'

sanskrit_iast: yugapat prāptau parām ṛddhim vadanti |
meaning: युगपत् प्राप्तौ पराम् ऋद्धिम् वदन्ति ।
text: If (the three fires) reach (the body) in the same moment, they say that this signifies the highest luck.

sanskrit_iast: tam dahyamānam anumantrayate prehi prehi pathibhiḥ pūrvebhir iti samānam |
meaning: तम् दह्यमानम् अनुमन्त्रयते प्रेहि प्रेहि पथिभिः पूर्वेभिर् इति समानम् ।
text: While (the body) is burning, he recites over it the same texts, 'Go on, go on, on the ancient paths' (Rig-veda X, 14, 7).

sanskrit_iast: sa evaṃvidā dahyamānaḥ saha eva dhūmena svargam lokam eti iti ha vijñāyate |
meaning: स एवंविदा दह्यमानः सह एव धूमेन स्वर्गम् लोकम् एति इति ह विज्ञायते ।
text: Being burnt by a person who knows this, he goes to the heaven-world together with the smoke (of the funeral pile)--thus it is understood (in the Sruti).

sanskrit_iast: uttara purastād āhavanīyasya jānu mātram gartam khātvā avakām śīpālam ity avadhāpayet tato ha vā eṣa niṣkramya saha eva dhūmena svargam lokam eti iti ha vijñāyate |
meaning: उत्तर पुरस्ताद् आहवनीयस्य जानु मात्रम् गर्तम् खात्वा अवकाम् शीपालम् इत्य् अवधापयेत् ततो ह वा एष निष्क्रम्य सह एव धूमेन स्वर्गम् लोकम् एति इति ह विज्ञायते ।
text: To the north-east of the Ahavaniya fire he should have a knee-deep pit dug and should have an Avaka, i.e. (the water-plant called) Sipala put down into it. From that (pit) he (i.e. the deceased) goes out and together with the smoke he goes up to the heaven-world--thus it is understood (in the Sruti).

sanskrit_iast: ime jīva vi mṛtair āvavṛtrann iti savya āvṛto vrajanty anavekṣamāṇāḥ |
meaning: इमे जीव वि मृतैर् आववृत्रन्न् इति सव्य आवृतो व्रजन्त्य् अनवेक्षमाणाः ।
text: After he has recited (the verse), 'These living ones have separated from the dead' (Rig-veda X, 18, 3), they turn round from right to left and go away without looking back.

sanskrit_iast: yatra udakam avahad bhavati tat prāpya sakṛd unmajjya eka añjalim utsṛjya tasya gotram nāma ca gṛhītvā uttīrya anyāni vāsāṃsi paridhāya sakṛd enāny āpīḍya udag daśāni visṛjya āsata ā nakṣatra darśanāt |
meaning: यत्र उदकम् अवहद् भवति तत् प्राप्य सकृद् उन्मज्ज्य एक अञ्जलिम् उत्सृज्य तस्य गोत्रम् नाम च गृहीत्वा उत्तीर्य अन्यानि वासांसि परिधाय सकृद् एनान्य् आपीड्य उदग् दशानि विसृज्य आसत आ नक्षत्र दर्शनात् ।
text: When they have come to a place where standing water is, having once (plunged into it and) emerged from it, they pour out one handful (of water), pronounce the Gotra name and the proper name (of the deceased), go out (of the water), put on other garments, wring out (the old garments) once, lay them away with their skirts to the north, and sit down until the stars appear.

sanskrit_iast: ādityasya vā dṛśyamāne praviśeyuḥ |
meaning: आदित्यस्य वा दृश्यमाने प्रविशेयुः ।
text: Or they may enter (their houses), when still (a part) of the sun-disk is seen,

sanskrit_iast: kaniṣṭha prathamā jyeṣṭha jaghanyāḥ |
meaning: कनिष्ठ प्रथमा ज्येष्ठ जघन्याः ।
text: The younger ones first, the older ones last.

sanskrit_iast: prāpya agāram aśmānam agnim gomayam akṣatāṃs tilān apa upaspṛśanti |
meaning: प्राप्य अगारम् अश्मानम् अग्निम् गोमयम् अक्षतांस् तिलान् अप उपस्पृशन्ति ।
text: When they have come to the houses, they touch a stone, the fire, cow's dung, fried barley, sesamum seeds, and water.

sanskrit_iast: na etasyām rātryām annam paceran |
meaning: न एतस्याम् रात्र्याम् अन्नम् पचेरन् ।
text: Let them not cook food during that night.

sanskrit_iast: krīta utpannena vā varteran |
meaning: क्रीत उत्पन्नेन वा वर्तेरन् ।
text: Let them subsist on bought or ready-made food.

sanskrit_iast: trirātram akṣāra alavaṇa aśinaḥ syuḥ |
meaning: त्रिरात्रम् अक्षार अलवण अशिनः स्युः ।
text: Let them eat no saline food for three nights.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśa rātram vā mahā guruṣu dāna adhyayane varjayeran |
meaning: द्वादश रात्रम् वा महा गुरुषु दान अध्ययने वर्जयेरन् ।
text: Let them optionally for twelve nights avoid the distribution of gifts and the study (of Vedic texts), if one of the chief Gurus (has died).

sanskrit_iast: daśāham sapiṇḍeṣu |
meaning: दशाहम् सपिण्डेषु ।
text: Ten days after (the death of) Sapindas,

sanskrit_iast: gurau ca asapiṇḍe |
meaning: गुरौ च असपिण्डे ।
text: And of a Guru who is no Sapinda,

sanskrit_iast: aprattāsu ca strīṣu |
meaning: अप्रत्तासु च स्त्रीषु ।
text: And of unmarried female relations.

sanskrit_iast: trirātram itareṣv ācāryeṣu |
meaning: त्रिरात्रम् इतरेष्व् आचार्येषु ।
text: Three nights after (the death of) other teachers,

sanskrit_iast: jñātau ca asapiṇḍe |
meaning: ज्ञातौ च असपिण्डे ।
text: And of a relation who is no Sapinda,

sanskrit_iast: prattāsu ca strīṣu |
meaning: प्रत्तासु च स्त्रीषु ।
text: And of married female relations,

sanskrit_iast: adanta jāte |
meaning: अदन्त जाते ।
text: Of a child that has no teeth,

sanskrit_iast: aparijāte ca |
meaning: अपरिजाते च ।
text: And of a dead-born child.

sanskrit_iast: ekāham sabrahmacāriṇi |
meaning: एकाहम् सब्रह्मचारिणि ।
text: One day, after (the death of) a fellow-pupil,

sanskrit_iast: samāna grāmīye ca śrotriye |
meaning: समान ग्रामीये च श्रोत्रिये ।
text: And of a Srotriya of the same village.

sanskrit_iast: saṃcayanam ūrdhvam daśamyāḥ kṛṣṇa pakṣasya ayujāsv eka nakṣatre |
meaning: संचयनम् ऊर्ध्वम् दशम्याः कृष्ण पक्षस्य अयुजास्व् एक नक्षत्रे ।
text: The gathering (of the bones is performed) after the tenth (Tithi from the death), (on a Tithi) with an odd number, of the dark fortnight, under a single Nakshatra.

sanskrit_iast: alakṣaṇe kumbhe pumāṃsam alakṣaṇāyām striyam |
meaning: अलक्षणे कुम्भे पुमांसम् अलक्षणायाम् स्त्रियम् ।
text: A man into a male urn without special marks, a woman into a female one without special marks.

sanskrit_iast: ayujo amithunāḥ pravayasaḥ |
meaning: अयुजो अमिथुनाः प्रवयसः ।
text: Aged persons of an odd number, not men and women together (gather the bones).

sanskrit_iast: kṣīra udakena śamī śākhayā triḥ prasavyam parivrajan prokṣati śītike śītikāvatī iti |
meaning: क्षीर उदकेन शमी शाखया त्रिः प्रसव्यम् परिव्रजन् प्रोक्षति शीतिके शीतिकावती इति ।
text: The performer of the ceremony walks three times round the spot with his left side turned towards it, and sprinkles on it with a Sami branch milk mixed with water, with the verse, 'O cool one, O thou that art full of coolness' (Rig-veda X, 16, 14).

sanskrit_iast: aṅguṣṭha upakaniṣṭhikābhyām eka ekam asthy asaṃhrādayanto avadadhyuḥ |
meaning: अङ्गुष्ठ उपकनिष्ठिकाभ्याम् एक एकम् अस्थ्य् असंह्रादयन्तो अवदध्युः ।
text: With the thumb and the fourth finger they should put each single bone (into the, urn) without making a noise,

sanskrit_iast: pādau pūrvam śira uttaram |
meaning: पादौ पूर्वम् शिर उत्तरम् ।
text: The feet first, the head last.

sanskrit_iast: susaṃcitam saṃcitya pavanena sampūya yatra sarvatra āpo na abhisyanderann anyā varṣābhyas tatra garte avadadhyur upasarpa mātaram bhūmim etām iti |
meaning: सुसंचितम् संचित्य पवनेन सम्पूय यत्र सर्वत्र आपो न अभिस्यन्देरन्न् अन्या वर्षाभ्यस् तत्र गर्ते अवदध्युर् उपसर्प मातरम् भूमिम् एताम् इति ।
text: Having well gathered them and purified them with a winnowing basket, they should put (the urn) into a pit, at a place where the waters from the different sides do not flow together, except rain water, with (the verse), 'Go to thy mother Earth there' (Rig-veda X, 18, 10).

sanskrit_iast: uttarayā pāṃsūn avakiret |
meaning: उत्तरया पांसून् अवकिरेत् ।
text: With the following (verse) he should throw earth (into the pit).

sanskrit_iast: avakīrta uttarām |
meaning: अवकीर्त उत्तराम् ।
text: After he has done so, (he should repeat) the following (verse).

sanskrit_iast: ut te stabhnāmi iti kapālena apidhāya atha anavekṣam pratyāvrajya apa upaspṛśya śrāddham asmai dadyuḥ |
meaning: उत् ते स्तभ्नामि इति कपालेन अपिधाय अथ अनवेक्षम् प्रत्याव्रज्य अप उपस्पृश्य श्राद्धम् अस्मै दद्युः ।
text: Having covered (the urn) with a lid with (the verse), 'I fasten to thee' (Rig-veda X, 18, 13), they then should go away without looking back, should bathe in water, and perform a Sraddha for the deceased.

sanskrit_iast: guruṇā abhimṛtā anyato vā apakṣīyamāṇā amāvāsyāyām śānti karma kurvīran |
meaning: गुरुणा अभिमृता अन्यतो वा अपक्षीयमाणा अमावास्यायाम् शान्ति कर्म कुर्वीरन् ।
text: They who have lost a Guru by death, or are afflicted by other misfortune, should perform on the new-moon day an expiatory ceremony.

sanskrit_iast: purodayād agnim saha bhasmānam saha āyatanam dakṣiṇā hareyuḥ kravyādam agnim prahiṇomi dūram ity ardharcena |
meaning: पुरोदयाद् अग्निम् सह भस्मानम् सह आयतनम् दक्षिणा हरेयुः क्रव्यादम् अग्निम् प्रहिणोमि दूरम् इत्य् अर्धर्चेन ।
text: Before sunrise they should carry their fire together with its ashes and with its receptacle to the south with the half-verse, 'I send far away the flesh-devouring Agni' (Rig-veda X, 16, 9).

sanskrit_iast: tam catuṣpathe nyupya yatra vā triḥ prasavyam pariyanti savyaiḥ pāṇibhiḥ savyān ūrūn āghnānāḥ |
meaning: तम् चतुष्पथे न्युप्य यत्र वा त्रिः प्रसव्यम् परियन्ति सव्यैः पाणिभिः सव्यान् ऊरून् आघ्नानाः ।
text: Having thrown that (fire) down at a place where four roads meet or somewhere else, they walk round it three times, turning their left sides towards it, beating their left thighs with their left hands.

sanskrit_iast: atha anavekṣam pratyāvrajya apa upaspṛśya keśa śmaśru loma nakhāni vāpayitvā upakalpayīran navān maṇikān kumbhān ācamanīyāṃś ca śamī sumano mālinaḥ śamīmayam idhmam śamīmayy āvaraṇī paridhīṃś ca anaḍuham gomayam carma ca nava nītam aśmānam ca yāvatyo yuvatayas tāvanti kuśa piñjūlāni |
meaning: अथ अनवेक्षम् प्रत्याव्रज्य अप उपस्पृश्य केश श्मश्रु लोम नखानि वापयित्वा उपकल्पयीरन् नवान् मणिकान् कुम्भान् आचमनीयांश् च शमी सुमनो मालिनः शमीमयम् इध्मम् शमीमय्य् आवरणी परिधींश् च अनडुहम् गोमयम् चर्म च नव नीतम् अश्मानम् च यावत्यो युवतयस् तावन्ति कुश पिञ्जूलानि ।
text: They then should return home without looking back, bathe in water, have their hair, their beards the hair of their bodies, and their nails cut, and furnish themselves with new jars, pots, vessels for rinsing the mouth, wreathed with garlands of Sami flowers, with fuel of Sami wood, with two pieces of Sami wood for kindling fire, and with branches to be laid round the fire, with bull's dung and a bull's hide, fresh butter, a stone, and as many bunches of Kusa grass as there are young women (in the house).

sanskrit_iast: agni velāyām agnim janayed iha eva ayam itaro jāta vedā ity ardharcena |
meaning: अग्नि वेलायाम् अग्निम् जनयेद् इह एव अयम् इतरो जात वेदा इत्य् अर्धर्चेन ।
text: At the time of the Agni(-hotra) he should kindle fire with the hemistich, 'Here may this other Gatavedas' (Rig-veda X, 16, 9).

sanskrit_iast: tam dīpayamānā āsata ā śānta rātrād āyuṣmatām kathāḥ kīrtayanto māṅgalyāni itihāsa purāṇāni ity ākhyāpayamānāḥ |
meaning: तम् दीपयमाना आसत आ शान्त रात्राद् आयुष्मताम् कथाः कीर्तयन्तो माङ्गल्यानि इतिहास पुराणानि इत्य् आख्यापयमानाः ।
text: Keeping that (fire) burning, they sit till the silence of the night, repeating the tales of the aged, and getting stories of auspicious contents, Itihasas and Puranas, told to them.

sanskrit_iast: uparateṣu śabdeṣu sampraviṣṭeṣu vā gṛham niveśanam vā dakṣiṇād dvāra pakṣāt prakramya avicchinām udaka dhārām haret tantum tanvan rajaso bhānum anvihi ity ā uttarasmāt |
meaning: उपरतेषु शब्देषु सम्प्रविष्टेषु वा गृहम् निवेशनम् वा दक्षिणाद् द्वार पक्षात् प्रक्रम्य अविच्छिनाम् उदक धाराम् हरेत् तन्तुम् तन्वन् रजसो भानुम् अन्विहि इत्य् आ उत्तरस्मात् ।
text: When all sounds have ceased, or when (the others) have gone to the house or the resting-place, (the performer of the ceremony) should pour out an uninterrupted stream of water, beginning at the south side of the door, with (the verse), 'Spinning the thread follow the light of the aerial space' (Rig-veda X, 53, 6), (going round the house), ending at the north side of the door.

sanskrit_iast: atha agnim upasamādhāya paścād asya anaḍuham carma āstīrya prāg grīvam uttara loma tasminn amātyān ārohayed ārohata āyur jarasam vṛṇānā iti |
meaning: अथ अग्निम् उपसमाधाय पश्चाद् अस्य अनडुहम् चर्म आस्तीर्य प्राग् ग्रीवम् उत्तर लोम तस्मिन्न् अमात्यान् आरोहयेद् आरोहत आयुर् जरसम् वृणाना इति ।
text: Having then given its place to the fire, and having spread to the west of it a bull's hide with the neck to the east, with the hair outside, he should cause the people belonging to the house to step on that (hide) with (the verse), 'Arise to long life, choosing old age' (Rig-veda X, 18, 6).

sanskrit_iast: imam jīvebhyaḥ paridhim dadhāmi iti paridhim paridadhyāt |
meaning: इमम् जीवेभ्यः परिधिम् दधामि इति परिधिम् परिदध्यात् ।
text: With (the verse), 'This I lay round the living' (Rig-veda X, 18, 4), he should lay branches round (the fire).

sanskrit_iast: antar mṛtyum dadhatām parvatena ity uttarato aśmānam agneḥ kṛtvā param mṛtyo anu parehi panthām iti catasṛbhiḥ pratyṛcam hutvā yathā ahāny anupūrvam bhavanti ity amātyān īkṣeta |
meaning: अन्तर् मृत्युम् दधताम् पर्वतेन इत्य् उत्तरतो अश्मानम् अग्नेः कृत्वा परम् मृत्यो अनु परेहि पन्थाम् इति चतसृभिः प्रत्यृचम् हुत्वा यथा अहान्य् अनुपूर्वम् भवन्ति इत्य् अमात्यान् ईक्षेत ।
text: After having with (the words), 'A mountain (i.e. a stone) they shall place between themselves and death,' placed a stone to the north of the fire, and having sacrificed with the four (verses), 'Go hence, O death, on another way' (Rig-veda X, 18, 1-4), verse by verse, he should look at his people with (the verse), 'As the days follow each other' (ibid. 5).

sanskrit_iast: yuvatayaḥ pṛthak pāṇibhyām darbha taruṇakair nava nītena aṅguṣṭha upakaniṣṭhikābhyām akṣiṇī ājya parācyo visṛjeyuḥ |
meaning: युवतयः पृथक् पाणिभ्याम् दर्भ तरुणकैर् नव नीतेन अङ्गुष्ठ उपकनिष्ठिकाभ्याम् अक्षिणी आज्य पराच्यो विसृजेयुः ।
text: The young women (belonging to the house) should, with each hand separately, with their thumbs and fourth fingers, with young Darbha blades, salve their eyes with fresh butter, and throw (the Darbha blades) away, turning their faces away.

sanskrit_iast: imā nārīr avidhavāḥ supatnīr ity añjānā īkṣeta |
meaning: इमा नारीर् अविधवाः सुपत्नीर् इत्य् अञ्जाना ईक्षेत ।
text: (The performer of the ceremony) should look at them, while they are salving themselves, with (the verse), 'These women, being no widows, having noble husbands' (Rig-veda X, 18, 7).

sanskrit_iast: aśmanvatī rīyate saṃrabhadhvam ity aśmānam kartā prathamo abhimṛśet |
meaning: अश्मन्वती रीयते संरभध्वम् इत्य् अश्मानम् कर्ता प्रथमो अभिमृशेत् ।
text: With (the verse), 'Carrying stones, (the river) streams forward; take hold of each other' (Rig-veda X, 53, 8)--the performer (of the ceremony) first should touch the stone.

sanskrit_iast: piṅgalo anaḍvān pariṇeyaḥ syād ity udāharanti |
meaning: पिङ्गलो अनड्वान् परिणेयः स्याद् इत्य् उदाहरन्ति ।
text: A tawny-coloured bull should he lead round--thus they say.

sanskrit_iast: atha upaviśanti yatra abhiraṃsyamānā bhavanty ahatena vāsasā pracchādya |
meaning: अथ उपविशन्ति यत्र अभिरंस्यमाना भवन्त्य् अहतेन वाससा प्रच्छाद्य ।
text: They then sit down at a place where they intend to tarry, having put on garments that have not yet been washed.

sanskrit_iast: āsate asvapanta ā udayāt |
meaning: आसते अस्वपन्त आ उदयात् ।
text: (There) they sit, avoiding to sleep, till sunrise.

sanskrit_iast: udita āditye sauryāṇi svastyayanāni ca japitvā annam saṃskṛtya apa naḥ śośucad agham iti pratyṛcam hutvā brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā svastyayanam vācayīta |
meaning: उदित आदित्ये सौर्याणि स्वस्त्ययनानि च जपित्वा अन्नम् संस्कृत्य अप नः शोशुचद् अघम् इति प्रत्यृचम् हुत्वा ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा स्वस्त्ययनम् वाचयीत ।
text: After sunrise, having murmured the hymns sacred to the sun and the auspicious hymns, having prepared food, having made oblations with (the hymn), 'May he drive evil away from us with his shine' (Rig-veda I, 97), verse by verse, having given to the Brahmanas to eat, he should cause (them) to pronounce auspicious words.

sanskrit_iast: gauḥ kaṃso ahatam vāsaś ca dakṣiṇā |
meaning: गौः कंसो अहतम् वासश् च दक्षिणा ।
text: A cow, a cup of metal, and a garment that has not yet been washed, constitute the sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast: atha ataḥ pārvaṇe śrāddhe kāmya ābhyudayika eka uddiṣṭe vā |
meaning: अथ अतः पार्वणे श्राद्धे काम्य आभ्युदयिक एक उद्दिष्टे वा ।
text: Now at a Sraddha ceremony, at that which is celebrated on the Parvan day, or for the attainment of special wishes, or at the Abhyudayika Sraddha (i.e. the Sraddha celebrated when some good luck has happened), or at the Ekoddishta Sraddha (the Sraddha directed to a single dead person)--

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇām śruta śīla vṛtta sampannān ekena vā kāle jñāpitān snātān kṛta pacchaucān ācāntān udan mukhān pitṛvad upaveśya eka ekam eka ekasya dvau dvau trīṃs trīn vā |
meaning: ब्राह्मणाम् श्रुत शील वृत्त सम्पन्नान् एकेन वा काले ज्ञापितान् स्नातान् कृत पच्छौचान् आचान्तान् उदन् मुखान् पितृवद् उपवेश्य एक एकम् एक एकस्य द्वौ द्वौ त्रींस् त्रीन् वा ।

sanskrit_iast: vṛddhau phala bhūyastvam |
meaning: वृद्धौ फल भूयस्त्वम् ।

sanskrit_iast: na tv eva ekam sarveṣām |
meaning: न त्व् एव एकम् सर्वेषाम् ।

sanskrit_iast: kāmam anādye |
meaning: कामम् अनाद्ये ।

sanskrit_iast: piṇḍair vyākhyātam |
meaning: पिण्डैर् व्याख्यातम् ।

sanskrit_iast: apaḥ pradāya |
meaning: अपः प्रदाय ।
text: Having given water (to the Brahmanas),

sanskrit_iast: darbhān dvi guṇa bhugnān āsanam pradāya |
meaning: दर्भान् द्वि गुण भुग्नान् आसनम् प्रदाय ।
text: Having given to them double-folded Darbha blades, and a seat,

sanskrit_iast: apaḥ pradāya |
meaning: अपः प्रदाय ।
text: Having (again) given water (to them),

sanskrit_iast: taijasa aśmamaya mṛnmayeṣu triṣu pātreṣv eka dravyeṣu vā darbha antarhiteṣv apa āsicya |
meaning: तैजस अश्ममय मृन्मयेषु त्रिषु पात्रेष्व् एक द्रव्येषु वा दर्भ अन्तर्हितेष्व् अप आसिच्य ।

sanskrit_iast: śam no devīr abhiṣṭaya ity anumantritāsu tilān āvapati tilo asi soma devatyo gosave deva nirmitaḥ | pratnavadbhiḥ prattaḥ svadhayā pitṝn imāṃl lokān prīṇayā hi naḥ svadhā nama iti |
meaning: शम् नो देवीर् अभिष्टय इत्य् अनुमन्त्रितासु तिलान् आवपति तिलो असि सोम देवत्यो गोसवे देव निर्मितः । प्रत्नवद्भिः प्रत्तः स्वधया पितॄन् इमांल् लोकान् प्रीणया हि नः स्वधा नम इति ।

sanskrit_iast: itara pāṇy aṅguṣṭha antareṇa upavītitvād dakṣiṇena vā savya upagṛhītena pitar idam te arghyam pitāmaha idam te arghyam prapitāmaha idam te arghyam ity apūrvam |
meaning: इतर पाण्य् अङ्गुष्ठ अन्तरेण उपवीतित्वाद् दक्षिणेन वा सव्य उपगृहीतेन पितर् इदम् ते अर्घ्यम् पितामह इदम् ते अर्घ्यम् प्रपितामह इदम् ते अर्घ्यम् इत्य् अपूर्वम् ।

sanskrit_iast: tāḥ pratigrāhayiṣyaṃt sakṛt sakṛt svadhā arghyā iti |
meaning: ताः प्रतिग्राहयिष्यंत् सकृत् सकृत् स्वधा अर्घ्या इति ।
text: When he is going to hand over that (Arghya water to the Brahmanas who represent the Fathers, he says once each time), 'Svadha! The Arghya water!'

sanskrit_iast: prasṛṣṭā anumantrayeta yā divyā āpaḥ pṛthivī sambabhūvur yā antarikṣyā uta pārthivīyāḥ | hiraṇya varṇā yajñiyās tā na āpaḥ śam syonā bhavantv iti saṃsravān samavanīya tābhir adbhiḥ putra kāmo mukham anakti |
meaning: प्रसृष्टा अनुमन्त्रयेत या दिव्या आपः पृथिवी सम्बभूवुर् या अन्तरिक्ष्या उत पार्थिवीयाः । हिरण्य वर्णा यज्ञियास् ता न आपः शम् स्योना भवन्त्व् इति संस्रवान् समवनीय ताभिर् अद्भिः पुत्र कामो मुखम् अनक्ति ।
text: Over (the Arghya water) which has been poured out, he should recite the verse, 'The celestial waters which have been produced on the earth, the aerial waters and the waters which are terrestrial, the gold-coloured ones, apt for sacrifice, may these waters bring us luck and be kind to us.' Pouring together what has been left (in the three Arghya vessels) he moistens his face with that water, if he desires that a son should be born to him.

sanskrit_iast: na uddharet prathamam pātram pitṝṇām arghya pātitam | āvṛtās tatra tiṣṭhanti pitaraḥ śaunako abravīt |
meaning: न उद्धरेत् प्रथमम् पात्रम् पितॄणाम् अर्घ्य पातितम् । आवृतास् तत्र तिष्ठन्ति पितरः शौनको अब्रवीत् ।
text: 'He should not take up the first vessel, into which the Arghya water for the Fathers has been poured. Hidden the Fathers dwell therein: thus Saunaka has said.'

sanskrit_iast: etasmin kāle gandha mālya dhūpa dīpa ācchādanānām pradānam |
meaning: एतस्मिन् काले गन्ध माल्य धूप दीप आच्छादनानाम् प्रदानम् ।
text: In that moment the gifts of perfumes, garlands, incense, lights, and clothes are offered (to the Brahmanas).

sanskrit_iast: uddhṛtya ghṛta aktam annam anujñāpayaty agnau kariṣye karavai karavāṇi iti vā |
meaning: उद्धृत्य घृत अक्तम् अन्नम् अनुज्ञापयत्य् अग्नौ करिष्ये करवै करवाणि इति वा ।
text: Having taken some food (of the Sthalipaka prepared for the Pindapitriyagna), and having besmeared it with ghee, he asks (the Brahmanas) for their permission by saying, 'I shall offer it in the fire,' or, 'I will sacrifice my offering in the fire,' or, 'I will offer it in the fire.'

sanskrit_iast: pratyabhyanujñā kriyatām kuruṣva kurv iti |
meaning: प्रत्यभ्यनुज्ञा क्रियताम् कुरुष्व कुर्व् इति ।
text: The permission (is given in the words), 'It may be offered,' or, 'Sacrifice thy offering,' or, Offer it.'

sanskrit_iast: atha agnau juhoti yathā uktam purastāt |
meaning: अथ अग्नौ जुहोति यथा उक्तम् पुरस्तात् ।
text: He then sacrifices in the fire as stated above,

sanskrit_iast: abhyanujñāyām pāṇiṣv eva vā |
meaning: अभ्यनुज्ञायाम् पाणिष्व् एव वा ।
text: Or, if they give their permission, in the hands (of the Brahmanas).

sanskrit_iast: agni mukhā vai devāḥ pāṇi mukhāḥ pitara iti ha brāhmaṇam |
meaning: अग्नि मुखा वै देवाः पाणि मुखाः पितर इति ह ब्राह्मणम् ।
text: 'The mouth of the gods verily is the fire, the mouth of the Fathers is the hand'--thus says the Brahmana.

sanskrit_iast: yadi pāṇiṣv ācānteṣv anyad annam anudiśati |
meaning: यदि पाणिष्व् आचान्तेष्व् अन्यद् अन्नम् अनुदिशति ।
text: If in the hands, he assigns to them other food, after they have sipped water.

sanskrit_iast: annam anne |
meaning: अन्नम् अन्ने ।
text: The food (is put together) with the food.

sanskrit_iast: sṛṣṭam dattam ṛdhnukam iti |
meaning: सृष्टम् दत्तम् ऋध्नुकम् इति ।
text: It is said, 'What is given away and offered, that brings prosperity.'

sanskrit_iast: tṛptām jñātvā madhumatīḥ śrāvayed akṣann amīmadanta iti ca |
meaning: तृप्ताम् ज्ञात्वा मधुमतीः श्रावयेद् अक्षन्न् अमीमदन्त इति च ।
text: When he sees that they are satiated, he should recite (the verses) containing the wordṃa dh u, and (the verse), 'They have eaten, they have enjoyed themselves' (Rig-veda I, 82, 2).

sanskrit_iast: sampannam iti pṛṣṭvā yad yad annam upayuktam tat tat sthālī pākena saha piṇḍa artham uddhṛtya śeṣam nivedayet |
meaning: सम्पन्नम् इति पृष्ट्वा यद् यद् अन्नम् उपयुक्तम् तत् तत् स्थाली पाकेन सह पिण्ड अर्थम् उद्धृत्य शेषम् निवेदयेत् ।
text: Having asked them, 'Relished?' and having taken the food, whatever food he has used, together with the Sthalipaka, in order to make lumps thereof, he should offer the rest (to the Brahmanas).

sanskrit_iast: abhimate anumate vā bhuktavatsv anācānteṣu piṇḍān nidadhyāt |
meaning: अभिमते अनुमते वा भुक्तवत्स्व् अनाचान्तेषु पिण्डान् निदध्यात् ।
text: After they have either accepted (that rest of food), or left it (to him), and have finished eating, he should, before they have sipped water, put down the lumps for the Fathers.

sanskrit_iast: ācānteṣv eke |
meaning: आचान्तेष्व् एके ।
text: After they have sipped water, according to some (teachers).

sanskrit_iast: prakīrya annam upavīya om svadhā ucyatām iti visṛjet |
meaning: प्रकीर्य अन्नम् उपवीय ओम् स्वधा उच्यताम् इति विसृजेत् ।
text: Having strewn the food on the ground and suspended the sacrificial cord over his left shoulder, he should dismiss the Brahmanas, (saying to them), 'Say Om! Svadha!'

sanskrit_iast: astu svadhā iti vā |
meaning: अस्तु स्वधा इति वा ।
text: Or, 'So be it! Svadha!'

sanskrit_iast: atha śūlagavaḥ |
meaning: अथ शूलगवः ।
text: Now the spit-ox (sacrificed to Rudra).

sanskrit_iast: śaradi vasante vā ārdrayā |
meaning: शरदि वसन्ते वा आर्द्रया ।
text: In autumn or in spring, under the (Nakshatra) Ardra.

sanskrit_iast: śreṣṭham svasya yūthasya |
meaning: श्रेष्ठम् स्वस्य यूथस्य ।
text: The best of his herd,

sanskrit_iast: akuṣṭipṛṣat |
meaning: अकुष्टिपृषत् ।
text: (An ox) which is neither leprous nor speckled;

sanskrit_iast: kalmāṣam ity eke |
meaning: कल्माषम् इत्य् एके ।
text: One with black spots, according to some;

sanskrit_iast: kāmam kṛṣṇam ālohavāṃś cet |
meaning: कामम् कृष्णम् आलोहवांश् चेत् ।
text: If he likes, a black one, if its colour inclines to copper-colour.

sanskrit_iast: vrīhi yavamatībhir adbhir abhiṣicya |
meaning: व्रीहि यवमतीभिर् अद्भिर् अभिषिच्य ।
text: He sprinkles it with water, into which he has thrown rice and barley,

sanskrit_iast: śirasta ā bhasataḥ |
meaning: शिरस्त आ भसतः ।
text: From head to tail,

sanskrit_iast: rudrāya mahā devāya juṣṭo vardhasva iti |
meaning: रुद्राय महा देवाय जुष्टो वर्धस्व इति ।
text: With (the formula), 'Grow up, agreeable to Rudra the great god.'

sanskrit_iast: tam vardhayet sampanna dantam ṛṣabham vā |
meaning: तम् वर्धयेत् सम्पन्न दन्तम् ऋषभम् वा ।
text: He should let it grow up. When it has cut its teeth, or when it has become a bull--

sanskrit_iast: yajñiyāyām diśi |
meaning: यज्ञियायाम् दिशि ।
text: To a quarter (of the horizon) which is sacrificially pure,

sanskrit_iast: asaṃdarśane grāmāt |
meaning: असंदर्शने ग्रामात् ।
text: At a place which cannot be seen from the village,

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvam ardha rātrāt |
meaning: ऊर्ध्वम् अर्ध रात्रात् ।
text: After midnight,

sanskrit_iast: udita ity eke |
meaning: उदित इत्य् एके ।
text: According to some, after sunrise.

sanskrit_iast: vaidyam caritravantam brahmāṇam upaveśya sapalāśām ārdra śākhām yūpam nikhāya vratatyau kuśa rajjū vā raśane anyatarayā yūpam parivīya anyatarayā ardha śirasi paśum baddhvā yūpe raśanāyām vā niyunakti yasmai namas tasmai tvā juṣṭam niyunajmi iti |
meaning: वैद्यम् चरित्रवन्तम् ब्रह्माणम् उपवेश्य सपलाशाम् आर्द्र शाखाम् यूपम् निखाय व्रतत्यौ कुश रज्जू वा रशने अन्यतरया यूपम् परिवीय अन्यतरया अर्ध शिरसि पशुम् बद्ध्वा यूपे रशनायाम् वा नियुनक्ति यस्मै नमस् तस्मै त्वा जुष्टम् नियुनज्मि इति ।
text: Having caused a Brahman who is versed in learning and knows the practice (of this sacrifice), to sit down, having driven a fresh branch with leaves into the ground as a sacrificial post, (having taken) two creeping plants or two Kusa ropes as two girdles, and having wound the one round the sacrificial post, and tied the other round the middle of the animal's head, he binds it to the sacrificial post or to the girdle (which he had tied to that post) with (the formula), 'Agreeable to him to whom adoration (is brought), I bind thee.'

sanskrit_iast: prokṣaṇa ādi samānam paśunā |
meaning: प्रोक्षण आदि समानम् पशुना ।
text: The sprinkling with water and what follows is the same as at the animal sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: viśeṣān vakṣyāmaḥ |
meaning: विशेषान् वक्ष्यामः ।
text: We shall state what is different.

sanskrit_iast: pātryā palāśena vā vapām juhuyād iti vijñāyate |
meaning: पात्र्या पलाशेन वा वपाम् जुहुयाद् इति विज्ञायते ।
text: Let him sacrifice the omentum with the Patri or with a leaf--thus it is understood (in the Sruti)--

sanskrit_iast: harāya mṛdāya śarvāya śivāya bhavāya mahā devāya ugrāya bhīmāya paśu pataye rudrāya śaṃkarāya īśānāya svāhā iti |
meaning: हराय मृदाय शर्वाय शिवाय भवाय महा देवाय उग्राय भीमाय पशु पतये रुद्राय शंकराय ईशानाय स्वाहा इति ।
text: With (the formulas), 'To Hara, Mrida, Sarva, Siva, Bhava, Mahadeva, Ugra, Bhima, Pasupati, Rudra, Sankara, Isana svaha!'

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍbhir vā uttaraiḥ |
meaning: षड्भिर् वा उत्तरैः ।
text: Or with the last six (parts of that formula),

sanskrit_iast: rudrāya svāhā iti vā |
meaning: रुद्राय स्वाहा इति वा ।
text: Or with (the formula), 'To Rudra svaha!'

sanskrit_iast: catasṛṣu catasṛṣu kuśa sūnāsu catasṛṣu dikṣu balim hared yās te rudra pūrvasyām diśi senās tābhya enan namas te astu māmā hiṃsīr ity evam pratidiśam tv ādeśanam |
meaning: चतसृषु चतसृषु कुश सूनासु चतसृषु दिक्षु बलिम् हरेद् यास् ते रुद्र पूर्वस्याम् दिशि सेनास् ताभ्य एनन् नमस् ते अस्तु मामा हिंसीर् इत्य् एवम् प्रतिदिशम् त्व् आदेशनम् ।
text: Let him make Bali offerings towards the four quarters (of the horizon), to each on four rings of Kusa net-work, with (the formulas), 'The hosts, Rudra, which thou hast towards the eastern direction, to them this (offering is brought). Adoration to thee! Do no harm to me!' In this way the assigning (of the offerings is performed) according to the different quarters (of the horizon).

sanskrit_iast: caturbhiḥ sūktaiś catasro diśa upatiṣṭheta kad rudrāya imā rudrāyā te pitaram ā rudrāya sthira dhanvana iti |
meaning: चतुर्भिः सूक्तैश् चतस्रो दिश उपतिष्ठेत कद् रुद्राय इमा रुद्राया ते पितरम् आ रुद्राय स्थिर धन्वन इति ।

sanskrit_iast: tuṣān phalī karaṇāṃś ca puccham carma śiraḥ pādān ity agnāv anupraharet |
meaning: तुषान् फली करणांश् च पुच्छम् चर्म शिरः पादान् इत्य् अग्नाव् अनुप्रहरेत् ।
text: The husks and chaff (of the rice), the tail, the skin, the head, the feet (of the sacrificial animal) he should throw into the fire.

sanskrit_iast: bhogam carmaṇā kurvīta iti śāṃvatyaḥ |
meaning: भोगम् चर्मणा कुर्वीत इति शांवत्यः ।
text: He should turn the skin to some use, according to Samvatya.

sanskrit_iast: uttarato agner darbha vītāsu kuśa sūnāsu vā śoṇitam ninayet śvāsinīr ghoṣiṇīr vicinvatīḥ samaśnuvatīḥ sarpā yad vo atra tadd haradhvam iti |
meaning: उत्तरतो अग्नेर् दर्भ वीतासु कुश सूनासु वा शोणितम् निनयेत् श्वासिनीर् घोषिणीर् विचिन्वतीः समश्नुवतीः सर्पा यद् वो अत्र तद्द् हरध्वम् इति ।
text: To the north of the fire, on rows of Darbha grass, or on rings of Kusa net-work, he should pour out the blood (of the sacrificial animal) with (the formula), 'Hissing ones! Noisy ones! Searching ones! Seizing ones! Serpents! What here belongs to you, take that.'

sanskrit_iast: atha udann āvṛtya śvāsinīr ghoṣiṇīr vicinvatīḥ samaśnuvīḥ sarpā yad vo atra tadd haradhvam iti sarpebhyo yat tatra asṛg ūvadhyam vā avasrutam bhavati tadd haranti sarpāḥ |
meaning: अथ उदन्न् आवृत्य श्वासिनीर् घोषिणीर् विचिन्वतीः समश्नुवीः सर्पा यद् वो अत्र तद्द् हरध्वम् इति सर्पेभ्यो यत् तत्र असृग् ऊवध्यम् वा अवस्रुतम् भवति तद्द् हरन्ति सर्पाः ।
text: Then, turning to the north, (he assigns it) to the serpents (in the words), 'Hissing ones! Noisy ones! Searching ones! Seizing ones! Serpents! What here belongs to you, take that.' Then the serpents take whatever has flowed down there of blood or of the contents of stomach and entrails.

sanskrit_iast: sarvāṇi ha vā asya nāma dheyāni sarvāḥ senāḥ sarvāṇy ucchrayaṇāni ity evaṃvid yajamānam prīṇāti |
meaning: सर्वाणि ह वा अस्य नाम धेयानि सर्वाः सेनाः सर्वाण्य् उच्छ्रयणानि इत्य् एवंविद् यजमानम् प्रीणाति ।
text: All names, all hosts, all exaltations belong to him;--to a sacrificer who knows that, he gives joy.

sanskrit_iast: na asya bruvāṇam cana hinasti iti vijñāyate |
meaning: न अस्य ब्रुवाणम् चन हिनस्ति इति विज्ञायते ।
text: Even to a man who only with words sets forth (some part) of that (ceremony), he will do no harm; thus it is understood (in the Sruti).

sanskrit_iast: na asya prāśnīyāt |
meaning: न अस्य प्राश्नीयात् ।
text: He should not partake of that (sacrifice).

sanskrit_iast: na asya grāmam āhareyur abhimāruko ha eṣa devaḥ prajā bhavati iti |
meaning: न अस्य ग्रामम् आहरेयुर् अभिमारुको ह एष देवः प्रजा भवति इति ।
text: They should not take anything belonging to it into the village. For this god will do harm to (human) creatures.

sanskrit_iast: amātyān antataḥ pratiṣedhayet |
meaning: अमात्यान् अन्ततः प्रतिषेधयेत् ।
text: He should keep away his people from the vicinity (of the place where he has sacrificed).

sanskrit_iast: niyogāt tu prāśnīyāt svastyayana iti |
meaning: नियोगात् तु प्राश्नीयात् स्वस्त्ययन इति ।
text: On an express injunction, however, he should partake (of that sacrificial food), for it will bring luck.

sanskrit_iast: sa eṣa śūlagavo dhanyo lokyaḥ puṇyaḥ putryaḥ paśavya āyuṣyo yaśasyaḥ |
meaning: स एष शूलगवो धन्यो लोक्यः पुण्यः पुत्र्यः पशव्य आयुष्यो यशस्यः ।

sanskrit_iast: iṣṭvā anyam utsṛjet |
meaning: इष्ट्वा अन्यम् उत्सृजेत् ।

sanskrit_iast: śaṃtātīyam japan gṛhān iyāt |
meaning: शंतातीयम् जपन् गृहान् इयात् ।

sanskrit_iast: paśūnām upatāpa etam eva devam madhye goṣṭhasya yajeta |
meaning: पशूनाम् उपताप एतम् एव देवम् मध्ये गोष्ठस्य यजेत ।

sanskrit_iast: sthālī pākam sarva hutam |
meaning: स्थाली पाकम् सर्व हुतम् ।
text: A mess of cooked food, which he sacrifices in its entirety.

sanskrit_iast: barhir ājyam ca anuprahṛtya dhūmato gā ānayet |
meaning: बर्हिर् आज्यम् च अनुप्रहृत्य धूमतो गा आनयेत् ।
text: Having thrown the sacrificial grass and the Agya into the fire, he should lead his cows through the smoke.

sanskrit_iast: śaṃtātīyam japan paśūnām madhyam iyāt |
meaning: शंतातीयम् जपन् पशूनाम् मध्यम् इयात् ।
text: Murmuring the Santatiya hymn, he should go in the midst of his cattle.

sanskrit_iast: namaḥ śaunakāya namaḥ śaunakāya |
meaning: नमः शौनकाय नमः शौनकाय ।
text: Adoration to Saunaka! Adoration to Saunaka!
